dtt.title: Data-to-text reporting
dtt.purpose: Express facts, relationships, and scope from structured input in report text.

skills.name: Population-specific organization
skills.action: Present distinct eligible population groups separately, associating each with its supplied eligibility or age wording and its own stated purpose when available.

all_of: Information is available for at least two distinguishable eligible population groups.
A purpose or effect is stated for each group.

preserve: Keep population groups and their purposes distinct.
Retain qualifications such as “help protect” and “help prevent”; do not make those purposes interchangeable.
Preserve age and eligibility qualifications when supplied.

not_an_attempt: Listing population or age mentions without organizing them as distinct eligible groups.
Combining groups so that their separately stated purposes are lost.
required_elements: At least two distinguishable population groups presented separately.
The stated purpose associated with each group.

all_of: A treatment mention is available.
At least two population or age mentions are available.
Condition or disease mentions are available.
exclude_if: The source does not specify which populations are eligible.
The source does not link a purpose to each population.
required_information: Verified eligible population groups and any associated age ranges.
Verified purpose or clinical-effect wording for each group, including any distinction between protection and prevention.

skills.name: Accessible mechanism explanation
skills.action: Explain a supplied treatment mechanism in accessible language, describing the stated response and its stated relationship to an effect.

all_of: A treatment mechanism is available.

preserve: Do not add a mechanism or effect that the source does not provide.
Retain the target's qualified protective wording rather than strengthening it.

not_an_attempt: Saying only that a treatment works without explaining its mechanism.
Naming a mechanism without stating a supplied effect or relationship to that effect.
required_elements: An accessible description of the supplied mechanism.
The supplied effect or relationship between the mechanism and an effect.

all_of: A treatment mention is available.
exclude_if: The source does not supply a mechanism and its relationship to the stated effect.
required_information: Verified mechanism-of-action information.
Verified information connecting that mechanism to the stated clinical effect.

skills.name: Identity through linked medicine and substance descriptions
skills.action: Introduce a product by describing its medicine category, naming its active substance, and classifying that substance in connected wording.

all_of: A product, a medicine category, an active substance, and a classification of that substance are available.

preserve: Keep distinct the product's medicine category, the active-substance relationship, and the substance's classification.
Do not infer these relationships from co-occurring entity mentions alone.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product without connecting it to a medicine category or substance.
Listing a substance and classification without connecting them to the product and to each other.
required_elements: Describe the product's medicine category.
Identify its active substance.
Classify that substance in connected wording.

all_of: A product mention, a medicine-category mention, a substance mention, and a classification mention are available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify which substance is the product's active substance.
The source does not verify the substance's classification.
required_information: Verified identification of the named substance as the product's active substance.
Verified classification of that substance, such as its medicine class.

skills.name: Qualified treatment purpose with a condition gloss
skills.action: State a product's treatment purpose by naming the treated condition and, when available, its population qualification; present a plain-language description before a more specific condition name or abbreviation when both are supplied.

all_of: A product and a condition for which it is used are available.

preserve: Retain stated population restrictions and their scope.
Preserve the relationship between the plain-language description and the specific condition name or abbreviation without implying equivalence from co-occurrence alone.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition without connecting it to the product's treatment purpose.
Presenting a plain-language description and a specific name or abbreviation as equivalent when that relationship is not supplied.
required_elements: Explicitly connect the product to treatment of the condition.
Include a supplied population qualification, if any.
When both a plain-language description and a specific name or abbreviation are used, connect them and present the plain-language description first.

all_of: A product mention and a condition mention are available.
Verified information connects the product to treatment of that condition and specifies any population restriction.
If a plain-language gloss or abbreviation is used, its relation to the specific condition is supplied.
exclude_if: The source provides only a condition mention, without a verified treatment indication.
The source does not verify the stated population restriction.
required_information: The verified therapeutic indication linking the product and condition.
Verified population eligibility, including whether the use is restricted to adults.
If describing or abbreviating the condition, verified information that the descriptions refer to the same condition.

skills.name: Accessible, assistance-framed mechanism explanation
skills.action: Explain how a product works in accessible, patient-directed language by describing a supplied mechanism as helping the patient's immune system act against the relevant disease, when that is an accurate rendering of the supplied mechanism.

all_of: A product and a relevant disease or condition are available.

preserve: Retain the target's accessible, assistance-framed wording and direct address where appropriate.
Do not recast the explanation as certain success, cure, or prevention, and do not infer a mechanism from product or disease mentions alone.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a product and disease without explaining how the product works.
Giving only technical mechanism terminology when an accessible explanation is available and appropriate.
Strengthening an assistance-framed explanation into a guaranteed outcome or claim of cure.
required_elements: Connect the explanation to how the product works.
Express the supplied mechanism in accessible language.
Retain the mechanism's degree of certainty and assistance framing.

all_of: A product mention and a disease or cancer mention are available.
A verified mechanism description links the product to the stated action.
exclude_if: No mechanism of action is supplied.
The supplied mechanism does not support the patient-facing explanation being used.
required_information: A verified mechanism of action for the product, including the action on the immune system and its relation to the patient's disease if that explanation is used.

skills.name: Pair each substance’s class with an accessible explanation of its stated effect
skills.action: Explain supplied substances separately when appropriate, pairing each source-stated medicine-class label with an accessible account of its stated process or effect.

all_of: The source supplies a substance mention and information appropriate for an explanation.
exclude_if: Do not assign a class or describe a mechanism or effect from co-occurring entity mentions alone.

preserve: Keep explanations substance-specific.
Preserve the supplied causal sequence and degree of certainty.
Do not infer class membership, mechanisms, or effects from entity co-occurrence.

not_an_attempt: Listing substance or class names without explaining their supplied relationship.
Adding a mechanism or effect not supplied by the source.
required_elements: For each substance explained, present the source-stated class relationship when available.
Present the source-stated process or effect in an explanatory sequence when available.
Keep explanations distinct when the source gives substances different accounts.

all_of: At least one generic-name mention.
For each substance to be explained, the source explicitly supplies its medicine-class relationship and its mechanism or effect.
exclude_if: A class relationship or mechanism is absent from the source, or would have to be inferred from entity co-occurrence.
required_information: Verified identification of each substance’s medicine class.
A source-supplied mechanism or effect for each substance, including the stated causal links.

skills.name: Close with a qualified indication and eligibility statement
skills.action: Close with a source-stated use or indication statement, preserving any supplied population and prior-treatment qualifications.

all_of: The source supplies an indication or use statement suitable for closing the section.
exclude_if: Do not infer an indication, population restriction, or prior-treatment qualification from mentions alone.

preserve: Retain the stated condition and any population or prior-treatment qualification.
Do not broaden eligibility or imply that the example’s adult population or telmisartan-alone qualification is universal.

not_an_attempt: Ending with a condition mention that is not stated as an indication or use.
Omitting or changing a population or prior-treatment qualification that the source includes.
Inferring eligibility or treatment history from condition, age, or medication mentions alone.
required_elements: A source-stated product-to-indication or use relationship.
Preservation of any population and prior-treatment qualifications supplied in that statement.

all_of: A source-stated treatment indication.
A source-stated population restriction and prior-treatment qualification if those are included in the statement.
exclude_if: The indication, population eligibility, or prior-treatment relationship would need to be inferred from mentions alone.
required_information: Verified product-to-indication relationship.
Verified eligibility criteria for the stated population.
Verified prior-treatment or treatment-combination qualification, including whether the condition is lack of control on a named treatment used alone.

skills.name: Introduce product identity through substances and purpose
skills.action: Introduce a product by naming supplied substances it contains, then state the supplied purpose those substances or the product serve in relation to a condition.

all_of: A product and one or more substances are identified
The source supplies the product–substance relationship and a purpose relating the product or substances to a condition
exclude_if: The product–substance relationship or stated purpose is not supplied

preserve: The product–substance relationship as stated
The stated purpose and its degree of certainty; do not turn control into cure

not_an_attempt: Listing a product and substances without stating their supplied relationship
Naming a condition without stating the supplied purpose
required_elements: Identify the product and its supplied relationship to the named substances
State the supplied purpose in relation to the condition

all_of: A product or treatment mention
At least one substance mention
A condition mention
exclude_if: The supplied information does not verify which substances are ingredients of the product
The supplied information does not verify the product’s purpose for the named condition
required_information: Verified relationship between the product and each substance described as an active substance
Verified purpose relating the substances or product to the named condition

skills.name: Gloss a technical term parenthetically
skills.action: When the source explicitly pairs a familiar-language expression with a technical term, present the technical term immediately afterward in parentheses as a gloss.

all_of: The source explicitly pairs a familiar-language expression with a technical term
exclude_if: The expressions are merely co-mentioned without a supplied pairing

preserve: The supplied term pairing
The parenthetical placement and order of the gloss

not_an_attempt: Using a technical term without its paired familiar-language expression
Giving both terms without the parenthetical gloss form
required_elements: Include the supplied familiar-language expression and paired technical term
Place the technical term in parentheses immediately after the familiar-language expression

all_of: A condition mention that explicitly pairs a familiar-language phrase with a technical term in parentheses
exclude_if: The input only co-mentions the two terms without explicitly pairing them
required_information: The supplied parenthetical pairing of the familiar-language phrase and technical term

skills.name: Explain substance effects with causal links
skills.action: Explain supplied effects of a medicine or substance using linked causal statements; include class information when supplied and express intermediate steps or separate pathways as the source provides them.

all_of: A medicine or substance is identified
The source supplies at least one effect or causal relationship to explain
exclude_if: The class membership or causal relationship would have to be inferred from co-mentioned entities

preserve: The stated direction of each causal link
Intermediate steps and distinctions between pathways where supplied
Any qualifications in the source

not_an_attempt: Listing a substance or medicine class without explaining a supplied effect
Inferring a mechanism or causal relationship from entity co-occurrence
required_elements: Identify the substance or medicine whose effect is being described
Express at least one supplied relationship or causal step
Preserve supplied intermediate steps, pathway distinctions, and qualifications

all_of: A substance mention
A supplied class relationship if a class is named
A supplied mechanism linking the substance to an effect
exclude_if: The mechanism or substance-to-class relationship would have to be inferred from entity co-occurrence
required_information: Verified identification of the substance being explained
Verified class membership for any class stated
The mechanism, including the causal steps and effects to be described

skills.name: Close with a direct treatment-purpose statement
skills.action: When a product’s use is supplied, close an explanatory description with a concise, direct statement naming the product and its stated use.

all_of: A product is identified
The source supplies the product’s use
exclude_if: The product–use relationship is not supplied

preserve: The concise closing placement
The supplied product–use relationship without changing its scope

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition without stating the product’s supplied use
Presenting the use only as an earlier explanation rather than as the closing statement
required_elements: Name the product
State its supplied use directly
Place the concise use statement at the close of the description

all_of: A product or treatment mention
A condition mention
A supplied treatment indication linking them
exclude_if: The product-condition relationship is not supplied
The source describes prevention, symptom relief, or another purpose rather than treatment
required_information: Verified indication and whether the stated use is treatment rather than another purpose

skills.name: Substance-led medicine introduction with an antidote relation
skills.action: Introduces a medicine by naming its active substance, then states the substance’s supplied role in relation to named target medicines.

all_of: A medicine and an active substance are available to introduce.
The source supplies the relationship between them and any stated role in relation to target medicines.

preserve: The distinction between the medicine and its active substance.
The source-supported role and target relationship; do not infer these from co-occurring mentions.

not_an_attempt: Only listing a medicine and substance without linking them.
Naming a role without identifying its stated target, when a target is supplied.
required_elements: Relate the medicine to its active substance.
State the supplied role of the substance and identify its target when that information is supplied.

all_of: A PRODUCT_NAME mention.
A TREATMENT mention serving as the proposed active substance.
A TREATMENT or GENERIC_NAME mention for the medicines said to be acted against.
required_information: Verified information that the named substance is an active substance in the named product.
Verified information that the substance acts as an antidote to the identified target medicines.

skills.name: Plain-language event description followed by its technical name
skills.action: Describes an event in accessible language and then identifies the technical term used for that event.

all_of: A technical term and source-supported meaning for it are available.

preserve: The connection between the accessible event description and the technical label.
The supplied meaning of the term; do not infer a definition from mentions alone.

not_an_attempt: Using a technical term without explaining what it refers to.
Describing an event and mentioning a term without linking the term to that event.
required_elements: Describe the event in accessible language.
Identify the technical term as the name for the described event.

all_of: A technical-term mention and mentions sufficient to express its supplied definition.
required_information: A verified definition of the technical term, including which described event the term names.

skills.name: Progression from identity and event explanation to use and effect
skills.action: When relevant content is available, presents medicine identity or administration context before the event and its consequence, and presents treatment use or effect after that explanation.

all_of: There is relevant content for at least two stages of the sequence: medicine identity or administration context; event or consequence; treatment use or effect.

preserve: The observed progression of information.
The distinction between describing an event or consequence and stating a treatment use or effect.
The optionality of stages when their content is unavailable.

not_an_attempt: Merely including similar topics without following their observed progression.
Treating every stage as mandatory when the corresponding content is unavailable.
required_elements: Order the available relevant content in the observed progression: identity or administration context, then event or consequence, then use or effect when available.

all_of: Supplied content for a medicine identity or administration context, an event explanation, and a use or effect.
required_information: Verified relationships for any product identity, administration, event definition, indication, eligible population, or effect that the description includes.

skills.name: Qualified use and effect wording
skills.action: States a supplied treatment use with any stated population restriction, and presents any separate effect claim with its supplied degree of certainty.

all_of: A treatment use and its relevant population information are supplied.

preserve: The stated adult restriction in this example, or any different population restriction supplied in another case.
The qualified wording “can reduce”; do not turn a possible effect into a certain outcome or require discussion of alternatives.
The distinction between treating the condition and reducing its consequence.

not_an_attempt: Omitting a source-supported population restriction.
Strengthening or weakening the certainty of a stated effect.
Conflating treatment of a condition with a separately stated effect on a consequence.
required_elements: State the supplied treatment use and any supplied population restriction.
If an effect is also supplied, state it separately and preserve its degree of certainty.

all_of: A product or treatment mention, a condition mention, and supplied information about treatment use and population.
required_information: Verified information that the medicine is used to treat the condition.
Verified eligible-population information supporting any stated age restriction.
If an effect is stated, verified effect information supporting its direction and qualified certainty.

skills.name: Product identity, treatment type, and patient group are combined in the opening.
skills.action: Opens by identifying the product, naming its treatment type and duration, and stating the qualified patient group it is for.

all_of: A product and its treatment type are available.
An intended patient group is available when the report states one.

preserve: The stated long-term duration.
The restriction to patients with type 1 Gaucher disease.
The direct opening identification of product and treatment type.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product and treatment type without connecting them.
Mentioning a condition without stating that the product is for that patient group.
required_elements: Connect the product to its stated treatment type.
State the intended patient group when available, retaining stated qualifications such as disease subtype or duration.

all_of: A product-name mention.
A treatment or medicine-class mention.
A disease or patient-group mention.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly verify the product-to-treatment relationship.
The source does not explicitly verify the intended patient group or condition.
required_information: Verified information that the named product is the stated treatment type.
Verified information that the treatment is intended for the stated patient group, including any disease subtype or other restriction.

skills.name: Disease cause is explained by linking the condition to an enzyme defect.
skills.action: Explains a disease by naming it, identifying it as a genetic disorder, and stating that it is caused by a missing or defective named enzyme.

all_of: A disease is being explained.
A disease-specific cause is available.

preserve: The causal wording that the disease is caused by the enzyme defect.
The distinction between a missing enzyme and a defective enzyme.
The naming of the disease and enzyme.

not_an_attempt: Listing a disease and an enzyme without stating their relationship.
Giving a general disease description without stating the supplied cause.
required_elements: Name the disease.
State the supplied causal relationship and identify the cause, retaining whether the component is missing or defective.

all_of: A disease mention.
A mention of the proposed cause.
exclude_if: The disease-to-cause relationship is not explicitly verified in the source.
required_information: Verified disease-specific information that the stated missing or defective component causes or characterizes the disease.

skills.name: A causal chain makes the disease process understandable in stages.
skills.action: Explains a disease process in successive causal steps: a component's absence or malfunction leads to material buildup, which leads to signs or symptoms.

all_of: A component or process and a possible buildup are available.
Consequences such as signs or symptoms are available when the source states them.

preserve: The direction and qualification of each stated causal link.
The progression from enzyme malfunction to buildup and then to signs and symptoms.
The distinction between buildup and its consequences.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a component, material, and symptoms without connecting them.
Describing buildup without stating its supplied consequence.
required_elements: State the supplied relationship between the component's absence or malfunction and material buildup.
When supplied, connect that buildup to its stated signs or symptoms.

all_of: A mention of an enzyme or other component.
A mention of a material that may build up.
A mention of signs or symptoms.
exclude_if: Either causal link in the sequence is not explicitly verified in the source.
required_information: Verified information connecting the component's absence or malfunction to buildup of the named material.
Verified information connecting that buildup to the stated signs or symptoms.

skills.name: Product contents are connected to a stated replacement purpose.
skills.action: Connects a product to a named substance it contains, then describes that substance's stated role, including any patient-group qualification attached to the role.

all_of: A product and a contained substance are available.
The substance's stated role is available.

preserve: The distinction between what the product contains and what the contained substance is designed to do.
The qualified wording “designed to replace,” rather than strengthening it into a guarantee or outcome.
The stated patient-group qualification.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product and substance without stating that the product contains it.
Naming a contained substance without describing its stated role.
required_elements: State that the product contains the named substance.
Describe the substance's supplied role, retaining any qualification such as “designed to.”
Retain a patient-group qualification when the source attaches one to that role.

all_of: A product-name mention.
A substance mention.
A mention of the component or function the substance is said to replace.
A patient-group mention if the replacement role is qualified by population.
exclude_if: The product-to-substance containment relationship is not explicitly verified.
The substance's stated replacement role is not explicitly verified.
A patient-group restriction is present but not explicitly verified.
required_information: Verified information that the product contains the named substance.
Verified information that the substance is designed or intended to replace the stated component.
Verified information about the patient group to which that role applies, including any restriction.

skills.name: Qualified treatment-use statements
skills.action: State a treatment use with the source’s population and severity qualifications; when available, present an additional use separately, retaining its stated population and formulation wording. Include explanatory details about a condition when the source provides them.

all_of: The source provides a treatment-use relationship to describe.

preserve: Keep the adult-patient and severity qualifications stated for the first use.
Keep the additional use distinct and preserve “can also be used” and the formulation references.
Do not infer a route of administration from a formulation mention.

not_an_attempt: Listing a condition without stating its treatment-use relationship.
Omitting or changing population or severity qualifications that the source states.
required_elements: State the supplied treatment-use relationship.
Retain any population and severity qualifications actually stated.
When describing an additional use, keep it distinct and retain any stated qualifications and formulation references.

all_of: A condition and a treatment or product are mentioned.
The source explicitly states the treatment-use relationship.
Any population or severity qualification used in the description is supplied by the source.
exclude_if: The source only mentions a condition without stating a treatment-use relationship.
A population or severity qualification is not verified in the source.
Formulation-specific wording is unavailable when formulation distinctions are described.
required_information: Verified information identifying the condition for which the product or treatment is used.
Verified information for any stated eligible population and severity range.
For formulation-specific statements, verified information identifying which formulations the statement applies to.

skills.name: Accessible mechanism explanation
skills.action: Explain a supplied medicine mechanism in accessible language by describing what the substance does to the affected cells, and give an illustrative cell type when supplied.

all_of: A medicine or substance and a source-supplied mechanism linked to it are available.
exclude_if: The source supplies no mechanism linked to the medicine or substance.

preserve: Retain the target’s qualified wording that paclitaxel “affects or stops” growth rather than strengthening it to a single definite effect.
Keep any cell example within the source-supplied scope.

not_an_attempt: Listing a medicine or substance and cell mentions without explaining a supplied mechanism.
Stating a treatment purpose without explaining how the medicine or substance acts.
required_elements: An accessible explanation of the supplied mechanism linked to the medicine or substance.
A description of affected cells when supplied; an illustrative cell type is optional when available.

all_of: A treatment or substance mention is available.
exclude_if: No verified mechanism is supplied.
A proposed example is not explicitly linked to the mechanism.
required_information: Verified mechanism of action linked to the treatment or substance; verified cell target and example relationship if these are to be included.

skills.name: Organized treatment-use statement
skills.action: Introduce one or more supplied treatment uses with a lead-in, then present the associated conditions as a grouped list; place population and combination details in the lead-in when available.

all_of: A product or medicine and at least one source-supplied condition-to-treatment-use relationship are available.
exclude_if: No source-supplied relationship identifies the condition as a treatment use for the medicine.

preserve: Keep the lead-in, grouped indication presentation, and any supplied population or combination qualifications in their stated relationships.
Do not treat entity mentions alone as evidence of an indication, eligible population, or combination therapy.

not_an_attempt: Listing conditions without presenting them as treatment uses.
Adding population or combination details based only on separate mentions in the source.
required_elements: A lead-in presenting the supplied treatment-use relationship and the associated condition or conditions.
When available and included, population and combination details must be related to that use.

all_of: A product name and at least one condition mention are available.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly identify the condition as a treatment use for the product.
Population or combination details are not explicitly related to that use.
required_information: Verified product-to-indication relationship for each listed condition; verified eligible population if stated; verified combination-treatment relationship and partner medicine if stated.

skills.name: Conditional-use qualification
skills.action: Close a treatment-use description with a qualification that use is conditional on other therapies not having worked, when the source supplies that condition.

all_of: A treatment-use statement and a source-supplied condition relating its use to the outcome of other therapies are available.
exclude_if: Other therapies are mentioned but the source does not connect their outcome to use of the treatment.

preserve: Preserve the limited condition that other therapies have not worked.
Do not turn the condition into a recommendation, guarantee, or broader claim about treatment failure.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning other therapies without stating their relationship to use of the named medicine.
Turning the qualification into treatment advice, a guarantee, or a stronger claim than the source makes.
required_elements: A source-supplied condition connecting use of the treatment to other therapies not having worked or a clearly equivalent stated outcome.
Wording that preserves the source’s qualification.

all_of: A treatment or product mention and a mention of other therapies are available.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly state that use is conditional on other therapies having failed or not worked.
required_information: Verified relationship between the treatment’s use and the stated outcome of prior therapies.

skills.name: Substance-first identity followed by stated use
skills.action: When product identity, active-substance information, and use information are available, state the product’s active substance and then give the product-use statement in the following sentence.

all_of: A named product is being introduced.
Verified active-substance and product-use information are available.

preserve: The sequence from product and active substance to use.
The distinction between treating and preventing, and any stated population restriction.

not_an_attempt: Naming a substance without identifying it as the product’s active substance.
Giving a product-use statement without connecting it to the product.
required_elements: Identify the product’s active substance.
Follow with the available product-use statement and preserve its stated condition and population.

all_of: A named product and a substance mention are available.
A product-use statement and its stated condition are available.
exclude_if: The source does not supply a verified product–substance relationship.
The source does not supply a verified use and any population restriction.
required_information: Verified information that the named substance is an active substance of the product.
Verified indication specifying whether the product treats, prevents, or both, and the applicable population.

skills.name: Outcome-specific benefit with an explicit limitation
skills.action: State an outcome-specific benefit and, when available, separately state a limitation concerning another outcome, preserving the qualification attached to each.

all_of: A product-related outcome claim is being presented.

preserve: The different outcomes attached to the benefit and limitation.
The qualification that a reduction in hip-fracture risk has not been shown, rather than asserting no effect.

not_an_attempt: Stating an outcome benefit without any available limitation as though the paired pattern had been used.
Turning a limitation in what has been shown into a categorical claim of no effect.
required_elements: State the outcome-specific benefit.
When a distinct outcome-specific limitation is available, state it separately and retain its evidence qualification.

all_of: A product and at least two distinct outcome mentions are available.
Verified information supports both an outcome-specific benefit and a limitation concerning another outcome.
exclude_if: The source supplies only outcome mentions without verified product-effect and evidence-status relations.
required_information: Verified product-related clinical effects, identifying the outcome and the exact qualification or evidence limitation for each claim.

skills.name: Accessible mechanism explanation with qualified comparison
skills.action: Explain a supplied product mechanism by placing relevant context before the product’s qualified effect or comparison.

all_of: A product mechanism is being explained.

preserve: The sequence from menopause and oestrogen context to the product effect.
The qualification “some” and the stated timing after menopause.

not_an_attempt: Inferring a mechanism from co-occurring product, hormone, or condition mentions.
Stating a product effect without the contextual setup when using this explanatory sequence.
required_elements: Present relevant supplied context before the product-mechanism statement.
State the product effect or comparison with its supplied qualification.

all_of: A relevant contextual statement and a product-mechanism statement are supplied.
exclude_if: The source does not supply a verified mechanism and any contextual relation used to explain it.
required_information: Verified mechanism of action, including the contextual relationship and any qualification used in the comparison.

skills.name: Opening identity, purpose, and route
skills.action: In the opening sentence, identify the named product as a medicine and state its supplied purpose and route of administration.

all_of: A product is identified as a medicine.
The source supplies the product’s purpose and route.
exclude_if: The source does not supply the purpose or route being stated.

preserve: Keep the identity, purpose, and route in the opening sentence when expressing this pattern.
Do not infer product-to-purpose or product-to-route relations from co-occurrence.
Preserve any supplied terminology gloss without adding an unsupported equivalence.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product without identifying it as a medicine or stating its purpose and route.
Inferring the product’s purpose or route from co-occurring entities.
required_elements: Identify the product as a medicine.
In the opening sentence, state a supplied purpose and route.

all_of: A product is named and identified as a medicine.
A purpose and route are explicitly linked to that medicine in the source.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly link the medicine to both the stated purpose and route.
required_information: Verified product-to-medicine identity, therapeutic purpose, and route of administration.

skills.name: Direct population-and-use statement
skills.action: Immediately after the introductory description, state the supplied patient group or condition for whom the medicine is used.

all_of: A medicine or treatment is introduced.
The source links its use to a patient group or condition.
exclude_if: The source merely mentions a condition without linking it to use of the medicine or treatment.

preserve: Retain any stated population restriction; do not broaden it.
Keep the direct use statement after the introductory description when following this sequence.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition without connecting it to use of the medicine.
Inferring eligibility from a condition mention alone.
required_elements: Explicitly connect use of the medicine to a supplied patient group or condition.
Place the use statement after the introductory description when this sequence is used.

all_of: A product or treatment is identified.
A patient group or condition is explicitly linked to use of that product or treatment.
exclude_if: The source merely mentions a condition without specifying that the medicine is used for that population.
required_information: Verified indication and any population restriction attached to that indication.

skills.name: Parenthetical alternate-name gloss
skills.action: Explain a term with a brief parenthetical that explicitly identifies its supplied alternative name.

all_of: A term is being explained.
The source supplies an alternative-name relation for that term.
exclude_if: The source supplies no alternative-name relation.

Source information explicitly verifies that the product is used to treat the stated condition.
If a population restriction is stated, source information explicitly verifies that restriction.
exclude_if: Exclude the treatment-purpose claim if verified source information does not link the product to treating the condition.
Exclude an age or population qualification if the source does not specify it.
required_information: Verified information that the product is used to treat the stated condition.
Verified information supporting any stated population restriction, including age.

skills.name: Qualified population associations
skills.action: Describes qualified associations between a condition and populations or exposure groups, distinguishing commonness from possible occurrence.

all_of: A condition and at least one relevant population or exposure group are available.
exclude_if: Do not infer a condition–group association from mentions alone.
Do not turn commonness or occurrence into treatment eligibility or causation.

preserve: Distinguish commonness from occurrence and retain qualifiers such as “especially” and “can also.”
Do not present an association as eligibility or causation unless that distinct relationship is supported.

not_an_attempt: Naming a condition and a population without stating their source-supported association.
Converting a qualified association into a universal, causal, or treatment-eligibility claim.
required_elements: State a source-supported association between the condition and a population or exposure group.
Preserve the source’s type and degree of qualification, such as “especially common,” “can also occur,” or “common in patients receiving.”

all_of: A DX_NAME mention for the condition is available.
A population or exposure-group mention is available.
Source information explicitly verifies the association between the condition and each stated population or exposure group.
Source information specifies whether the association concerns commonness or occurrence and supplies any qualification used.
exclude_if: Exclude any population association that is not explicitly verified in source information.
Do not present a population association as treatment eligibility unless that distinct relationship is verified.
Do not state a causal association unless the source explicitly verifies causation.
required_information: Verified information connecting the condition to each stated population or exposure group.
Verification of whether the claim concerns commonness or occurrence and of any qualification used.

skills.name: Progression from product purpose to condition context
skills.action: Orders the section from product purpose to treatment indication, followed by an available condition explanation and population context.

all_of: Product-purpose information and treatment-indication information are available for inclusion.
exclude_if: Do not use the order to infer medical relationships.
Do not require condition explanation or population context when that content is unavailable.

preserve: Treat this as an observed information-ordering choice, not as evidence for any medical relationship.
Do not require all example content types or transfer example-specific entities and qualifiers.

not_an_attempt: Reordering isolated mentions without presenting the relevant information.
Treating the example’s sequence as requiring every content type in every section.
required_elements: Place product-purpose information before the treatment indication when both are included.
Place an included condition explanation or population context after the indication.
Omit unavailable content rather than inventing it.

all_of: A PRODUCT_NAME mention is available.
A DX_NAME mention is available.
Any product–substance or purpose relationship included is verified in source information.
Any treatment indication included is verified in source information.
Any condition explanation or population association included is verified in source information.
exclude_if: Omit any element for which its required source information is unavailable.
Do not use the observed order to infer product–substance membership, indication, condition explanation, or population association.
required_information: Verified product identity and any product–substance or purpose relationship included in the opening.
Verified treatment indication.
A verified condition explanation and any population associations included in the later context.

skills.name: Purpose stated with population and context
skills.action: Describe the product’s use by stating its purpose and, when available, the relevant patient group, location or wound, and post-surgery context; examples may be added when available.

all_of: A product and source-supported information about its use are available.

preserve: Retain the adult-patient qualification in this example without treating it as a reusable age rule.
Preserve that the stated purpose is to reduce pain, not to cure a condition.
Keep the body-location and surgical-wound contexts distinct, along with the following-surgery qualification.
Present the procedures as examples, not as an exhaustive list.

not_an_attempt: Listing a symptom, patient group, location, or procedure without describing the product’s use.
Strengthening a stated purpose into a claim of cure or guaranteed effect.
required_elements: State the source-supported purpose of the product.
Include applicable population or contextual qualifications when supplied and relevant to that use.

all_of: A product name and mentions of the relevant condition or symptom and use context are available.
The source explicitly states the product’s purpose and the applicable patient group and contextual qualifications.
exclude_if: The source supplies only entity mentions without verifying that they are linked as the product’s use.
The source does not verify the population or contextual qualifications included in the description.
required_information: Verified therapeutic-use information linking the product to the stated purpose and any relevant location, wound, or post-surgery context.
Verified population eligibility for any stated patient group.
Verified support for the described effect, expressed no more strongly than the source.

skills.name: Explain action in accessible terms
skills.action: Explain a medicine’s stated action in accessible language, attributing the action to the medicine and connecting it to a relevant target or outcome.

all_of: A medicine and a source-supported action with a relevant target or outcome are available.
exclude_if: The source supplies only organism or condition mentions, without a supported medicine action.

preserve: The accessible action wording.
The target and outcome relationships and their stated scope and certainty.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning bacteria or infections without describing an action.
Describing an action without attributing it to the medicine.
required_elements: Attribute an action or effect to the medicine.
Connect the action to a relevant target or outcome in accessible language.

all_of: A product mention is available.
The source supplies the mechanism and the target or outcome to be described.
exclude_if: The source provides only condition or organism mentions, without a verified medicine action.
required_information: Verified mechanism information linking the medicine to the stated action and target or outcome.

skills.name: Organize treatment and prevention separately
skills.action: When treatment and prevention uses are available, distinguish them with explicit labels or equivalent wording and group each use description under its stated purpose.

all_of: Use descriptions and their purposes are available.
exclude_if: The source does not support the purpose assigned to a use.

preserve: The distinction between treatment and prevention.
The association of each description with its stated purpose.
Any source-supported population or procedure qualifications.

not_an_attempt: Presenting treatment and prevention uses as one undifferentiated list.
Using purpose labels without associating the descriptions with the corresponding purposes.
required_elements: When both treatment and prevention uses are available, distinguish the purposes with labels or equivalent wording.
Associate each use description with its source-supported purpose.

all_of: The source supplies use information for at least one purpose.
If it supplies both treatment and prevention uses, each use is explicitly linked to its purpose.
exclude_if: The source does not distinguish the purpose of a stated use.
required_information: Verified information identifying whether each stated use is treatment or prevention.
Verified indication and any applicable population or procedure qualifications.

skills.name: Address the reader and child directly
skills.action: In patient-facing text, address the reader directly and, when supported, include a child as an alternative patient; retain the stated prescriber and indication framing when available.

all_of: A patient-facing explanation is appropriate.
exclude_if: The source does not support an included patient group, prescriber relationship, or indication framing.

preserve: The direct patient-facing address.
The child reference as an alternative patient when applicable.
The stated prescriber and indication relationship and its degree of certainty.

not_an_attempt: Using second-person wording without addressing the reader as a potential patient.
Mentioning a child without framing the child as an alternative patient in the explanation.
required_elements: Address the reader directly.
When the source supports it, refer to a child as an alternative patient.
When available in the source, retain the prescriber and use framing without strengthening it.

all_of: The source supports a patient-facing explanation.
Any included child reference and prescribing rationale are explicitly supported.
exclude_if: The source does not identify the addressed patient group or does not support the stated prescribing rationale.
required_information: Verified patient-group eligibility for any reader or child reference.
Verified indication information supporting the stated prescribing rationale.

skills.name: Express qualified use
skills.action: State eligibility with qualified wording and an explicit age or population boundary, and keep any separate use-specific population qualification distinct when available.

all_of: A source-supported eligibility statement includes an age threshold or other population boundary.
exclude_if: Only a number or population mention is available, without a supported eligibility relationship.

preserve: The qualified wording “can be given.”
The stated age boundary and unit.
The distinction between a general eligibility statement and a qualification tied to a particular use.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a number without identifying the age or population it qualifies.
Mentioning a population or procedure without linking it to the relevant use.
required_elements: State a supported eligibility boundary, such as an age threshold or population.
Link that boundary to the relevant use and retain qualifying wording such as “can be given.”
Keep a separate use-specific qualification distinct when available.

all_of: The source supplies an explicit population eligibility qualification linked to a medicine use.
exclude_if: Only a number or population mention is available, with no verified eligibility relationship.
required_information: Verified eligibility wording, including the applicable population and any age threshold and unit.
Verified linkage between each qualification and the relevant use.

skills.name: Product identity followed by substance and group
skills.action: Introduces a product by stating its active substance, then uses a relative clause to identify that substance’s medicine group.

all_of: A product and its active substance are available to name.
The source supplies the relationship between the product and substance, and the substance and group.
exclude_if: The source does not supply the relationships being expressed.

preserve: Keep the product, active substance, and medicine group distinct.
Do not infer either relationship from co-occurring mentions.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product, substance, and group without expressing their relationships.
required_elements: Name the product and its active substance.
Connect the substance to its medicine group.

all_of: The source explicitly identifies a product's active substance and states the substance's medicine group.
exclude_if: The source only lists a product, substance, or group without explicitly relating them.
required_information: Verified information that the product contains the named active substance and that the substance belongs to the named group.

skills.name: Plain-language gloss with qualified disease relevance
skills.action: Gives a short plain-language appositional gloss for a technical term, then states its disease relevance with an explicit qualification.

all_of: A technical term and a relevant disease context are available.
exclude_if: No definition or disease relationship is supplied.

preserve: Retain the target’s qualification that the involvement can occur “in some cases.”
Do not strengthen possible involvement into definite causation or outcome.

not_an_attempt: Giving a gloss without stating the supplied disease relevance.
Turning a qualified relationship into a definite causal claim.
required_elements: Give a supplied plain-language gloss of the term.
State the supplied disease relationship with its qualification.

all_of: The source supplies a definition of a technical term and a qualified relationship between that term or subject and a disease.
exclude_if: The source gives no definition or disease relationship, or presents a possibility as certainty.
required_information: A verified plain-language definition of the term and verified wording of the disease relationship, including its degree of certainty.

skills.name: Contrasting treatment options with indication-specific qualifications
skills.action: Organizes distinct treatment uses as alternatives, attaching each use to its own indication and any supplied population, disease-subtype, or disease-extent qualifications.

all_of: The source supplies at least two distinct treatment uses or options and their respective indications.
exclude_if: The source only co-mentions treatments and conditions without assigning indications to the options.

preserve: Keep the alone and combination options distinct where those are the supplied alternatives.
Keep supplied qualifications attached to the relevant option without changing their meaning.

not_an_attempt: Listing treatments and conditions without linking each option to its indication.
Combining distinct options so their qualifications no longer clearly attach to the appropriate option.
required_elements: Distinguish the treatment options.
Connect each option to its supplied indication.

all_of: The source explicitly describes at least two treatment options and assigns an indication and any relevant population or disease qualifications to each.
exclude_if: The source only co-mentions treatments, conditions, or population terms without assigning indications and qualifications.
required_information: Verified indication for each option; verified treatment-combination relationships; and the applicable population, disease-subtype, and extent qualifications.

skills.name: Population-qualified additional treatment
skills.action: Adds a statement that a named additional treatment applies to a specified population.

all_of: The source supplies an additional treatment and a population to which it applies.
exclude_if: The source only mentions the treatment and population without relating them.

preserve: Retain the stated population boundary.
Preserve the additional-treatment relation; do not extend it to other populations.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a population and another medicine without stating that the medicine applies to that population.
required_elements: Identify the supplied population.
Link that population to the additional treatment.

all_of: The source explicitly states that an additional treatment applies to a defined population.
exclude_if: The source merely mentions a population and an additional treatment without linking them.
required_information: Verified population eligibility and verified information that the additional treatment is given to that population.

skills.name: Direct reader address with a conditional leaflet reference
skills.action: Addresses the reader directly, makes a leaflet cross-reference conditional on a stated treatment circumstance, and directs questions about the other medicine to a doctor.

all_of: The source supplies a condition for referring the reader to another medicine’s leaflet.
The source supplies a direction about whom to ask with questions about that medicine.
exclude_if: The source does not supply the cross-reference condition or the question referral.

preserve: Keep the leaflet reference conditional on fulvestrant being given with palbociclib, as stated.
Keep the referral specific to questions about palbociclib and asking a doctor; do not add broader advice.

not_an_attempt: Using second-person wording without a patient-facing action or direction.
Mentioning a leaflet or clinician without the supplied condition or question referral.
required_elements: Address the reader directly.
State the supplied condition for the leaflet reference.
Retain the supplied direction for questions about the other medicine.

all_of: The source explicitly addresses the reader, supplies a condition for a leaflet cross-reference, and directs questions about the other medicine to a clinician.
exclude_if: The source has no direct reader address, conditional leaflet reference, or clinician referral for questions.
required_information: Verified wording of the condition for the leaflet reference and the stated clinician referral.

skills.name: Sequential, accessible mechanism explanation
skills.action: Explain a proposed medicine action in an accessible sequence: identify the target and, when supplied, where it occurs or what it does; then describe the effects attributed to the substance’s interaction with it.

preserve: The distinction between target identification, interaction, and attributed effects.
The causal links and degree of certainty expressed in the source.
Do not infer a mechanism from co-mentioned entities.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a target or binding without explaining any supplied consequence of the interaction.
Presenting unrelated target details as a causal sequence.
required_elements: Identify the relevant target or interaction.
Connect the substance to the target when that relationship is supplied.
Describe the stated effect or effects of the interaction, if supplied.

all_of: A substance and a proposed biological target are mentioned.
required_information: Verified information connecting the substance to the target.
A supplied mechanism explaining the relevant binding or interaction and its stated effects.

skills.name: Scenario-based organization of purpose and eligibility
skills.action: Introduce the treatment context and present applicable patient or condition scenarios in a readable sequence, using direct address and attaching supplied qualifications to the relevant scenario.

all_of: A treatment context and at least one relevant patient or condition scenario are available.

preserve: The distinction between the broad treatment context and specific scenarios.
The attachment of each supplied qualification to its applicable scenario.
The source’s degree of certainty and the reader-address style.

not_an_attempt: Listing conditions without presenting them as scenarios for treatment use.
Attaching a qualification to a scenario when the source does not support that relationship.
required_elements: Introduce the treatment context.
Present at least one applicable patient or condition scenario.
Keep supplied qualifications attached to the relevant scenario.

all_of: A product or treatment is mentioned.
At least one condition or patient scenario is mentioned.
required_information: Verified information establishing the treatment’s indication.
Verified information specifying which patient or condition scenarios qualify and which qualifications belong to each scenario.

skills.name: Qualified co-treatment requirement
skills.action: State a required co-treatment relationship directly, preserving the stated strength of the requirement and how the accompanying medicines are described.

preserve: The mandatory wording “must always.”
The description “certain other HIV medicines,” without making the accompanying medicines more specific than the source.

not_an_attempt: Listing the product and other medicines without saying they are to be used together.
Changing a stated requirement into an optional recommendation or vice versa.
required_elements: An explicit relationship between the product and the accompanying medicine or medicines.
The source's degree of obligation.
The source's level of specificity about the accompanying medicines.

all_of: A product-name mention and a mention of other treatment or medicine are available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify that the treatments are to be used together.
The source does not support the stated strength or qualification of the requirement.
required_information: Verified information that the named product is to be taken with the other medicine or medicines.
Verified information about whether this is mandatory and about the identity or qualification of the accompanying medicines.

skills.name: Accessible explanation of mechanism
skills.action: Explain a technical mechanism in a patient-facing sequence: identify the relevant component, explain its role, and state the product's action on it when that information is supplied.

all_of: A mechanism component or technical term is available to explain.

preserve: The sequence from identifying HIV integrase to explaining that the enzyme helps the virus multiply, then describing Vitekta's action.
The distinction between the enzyme's role and the product's stated effect on it.

not_an_attempt: Naming a technical component without explaining its role.
Explaining a component's role without stating the product's supported action when that action is part of the explanation.
required_elements: Identification of the relevant component or term.
A plain-language explanation of its role.
When supplied, an explicit statement of the product's action on the component.

all_of: A product-name mention and mentions of the mechanism component and its technical term are available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify the mechanism or define the technical term sufficiently for the proposed explanation.
required_information: Verified information about the mechanism, including the product's relationship to the mechanism component.
A verified definition or functional explanation of the technical term and, where stated, the component's role.

skills.name: Limitations and residual possibility
skills.action: Set expectations with an explicit statement that the medicine is not a cure and, when supplied, a qualified statement that associated illnesses may still develop during treatment.

all_of: A medicine and a condition are available to discuss.

preserve: The explicit non-cure statement.
The possibility expressed by “may still.”
The treatment-time qualification and stated association of the illnesses with HIV infection.

not_an_attempt: Making only a general statement about treatment limitations without the source's qualification.
Changing “may still” into certainty or impossibility.
Replacing a statement about cure with a claim about prevention, symptom relief, or treatment efficacy.
required_elements: When supported by the source, an explicit statement that the medicine is not a cure for the condition.
When supplied, a qualified statement that associated illnesses may still develop during treatment.

all_of: A medicine mention, a condition mention, and a mention of possible associated illness are available.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly support the non-cure statement or the possibility of illness during treatment.
required_information: Verified information that the medicine is not a cure for the named condition.
Verified information about whether associated illnesses may still occur during treatment.

skills.name: Accessible, conditional mechanism sequence
skills.action: Explain a supplied mechanism as a patient-readable causal sequence, retaining any stated trigger or condition and connecting it to a stated outcome when available.

all_of: Source information supplies a mechanism linked to a product or substance
exclude_if: No source-supported mechanism is available

preserve: Retain the stated sexual-stimulation condition.
Preserve the sequence from blood-vessel relaxation to blood flow; include an outcome only as supplied.

not_an_attempt: Naming a mechanism without explaining its supplied steps
required_elements: A source-supported mechanism is described through linked causal steps

all_of: A product or substance mention is present
Source information supplies a mechanism linked to that product or substance
Source information supplies any trigger or condition and the resulting effect
exclude_if: No verified product- or substance-linked mechanism is supplied
A trigger, condition, or resulting effect is asserted but not supplied by the source
required_information: A verified mechanism of action, its relationship to the product or substance, any conditions on its operation, and any claimed resulting clinical effect

skills.name: Connected, accessible mechanism explanation
skills.action: Explain a product mechanism through a connected account of relevant disease context, any described target or process, and the product's stated action and effect; include only components supported by the source.

all_of: A product or treatment is being described.
Source information is available about its action and at least one related effect or process.
exclude_if: The proposed mechanism or effect would have to be inferred from entity co-occurrence.

preserve: Preserve the supplied causal and action relationships.
Do not add or strengthen mechanism claims or effects.
Treat disease context as optional when it is not available.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product, condition, target, or effect without explaining a supplied relationship between them.
required_elements: A connected explanation of a supplied product action and its related effect or process.

all_of: A product and relevant mechanism entities are mentioned.
Verified information explicitly supplies the product's action and its relationship to the stated effect.
If a disease-related cause or process is included, verified information explicitly supplies that relationship.
exclude_if: The mechanism or disease-related relationship would have to be inferred from entity co-occurrence.
required_information: A supplied account of how the product acts and the effect that action is stated to produce.
A supplied explanation of any disease-related process included in the description.

skills.name: Mechanism-first ordering and qualified use statement
skills.action: When both explanatory mechanism content and use information are available, present the mechanism before the use statement; state the use with any supplied patient-population or severity qualifications.

all_of: Both explanatory mechanism content and product-use information are available.
exclude_if: The product-to-use relationship would have to be inferred.

preserve: Keep the use relationship explicit.
Retain supplied population and severity qualifications without broadening them.
Do not infer treatment eligibility from a condition mention.

not_an_attempt: Presenting only mechanism content or only a use statement, with no ordering between them.
Inferring a product indication from a condition mention alone.
required_elements: Mechanism content placed before a product-use statement.
An explicit, source-supported product-to-use relationship.

all_of: A product, mechanism information, an indication, and any relevant population qualification are available.
Verified information explicitly links the product to the indication and supplies the population qualification.
exclude_if: The indication or population qualification is not explicitly supplied.
The order would imply an indication or eligibility relation that the source does not establish.
required_information: A supplied account of how the product works, if it is to precede the use statement.
Verified information explicitly stating what the product is used to treat.
Verified information establishing any stated patient-population or severity qualification.

skills.name: Overview linking product identity and uses
skills.action: Open with the product identity and a compact overview linking it to one or more supplied uses; include medicine-group membership and a population qualification when those are supplied.

all_of: A product mention and at least one use or indication are available.

preserve: Any stated population restriction and its scope.
The distinction between class membership and therapeutic use.
The source's degree of certainty and the supplied use relationships.

not_an_attempt: Naming the product and conditions without presenting them as an overview of its uses.
required_elements: Name the product.
Link it to the supplied use or uses.
Include class membership or a population restriction only when the source supplies it.

all_of: A product mention and a medicine-group or class mention are available.
At least one condition or problem mention is available.
The source supplies the product-to-class and product-to-indication relationships and any population restriction to be stated.
exclude_if: The product’s group, indication, or population eligibility is not supplied.
required_information: Verified medicine-group or class membership for the product; verified therapeutic indication(s); and the eligible population, including whether an adult restriction applies.

skills.name: Condition-focused information blocks
skills.action: Organize related material into separate condition-focused blocks, keeping explanations, use information, or other details with the condition they concern; place an overview first when one is available.

all_of: Material concerning at least two conditions or problems is available.
There is related explanatory, use, or other content to organize.

preserve: The source-supported association between each condition and its details.
Any qualifications in the grouped content.
The source's distinctions between conditions; do not merge separate condition blocks.

not_an_attempt: Presenting all condition-related material in one undifferentiated list.
Providing condition labels without grouping any related material under them.
required_elements: Separate material into at least two condition-focused blocks.
Keep each included detail with the condition it concerns.

all_of: At least two condition or problem mentions and related explanatory or use material are available.
The source identifies which material belongs with each condition.
exclude_if: The source does not establish the relationship between a condition and the details to be grouped with it.
required_information: Verified links between each condition and its associated use, explanation, symptoms, or other details.

skills.name: Concrete explanation of neuropathic pain
skills.action: Make a condition or problem more concrete with source-supplied descriptions, examples, or associated experiences, clearly preserving the relationship and qualification used for each detail.

all_of: A condition or problem mention is available.
One or more explanatory descriptions, examples, or associated experiences are available.

preserve: The distinction between causes, disease examples, descriptions of sensations, and associated experiences.
The target's qualification that sensations 'may be described' in those terms.
Any uncertainty or scope limitation supplied for the explanation.

not_an_attempt: Repeating a technical condition name without adding any concrete explanation.
Presenting a detail as a cause, example, sensation, or associated experience when the source does not state that relationship.
required_elements: Use at least one supplied concrete description, example, or associated experience to explain the condition or problem.
Preserve the source's stated relationship and qualification for that detail.

all_of: A condition or problem mention and one or more explanatory detail mentions are available.
The source supplies the relationship between the condition and each included cause, example, or sensation.
exclude_if: The source provides only co-occurring condition and detail mentions without explaining their relationship.
required_information: Verified condition-specific explanation, including which details are causes, examples, sensations, or associated experiences.

skills.name: Present mechanism as a linked explanatory sequence
skills.action: Explain a product mechanism by linking a supplied change in cells or body sites to a stated purpose or outcome, using the source's qualifications.

all_of: A product mechanism or explanatory link is available.

preserve: The target's qualified wording, including “helps to protect.”
Only the mechanism and links verified by the source; do not infer them from entity co-occurrence.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product, cells, body sites, or outcomes without explaining their supplied relationship.
Inferring a mechanism from co-occurring entity mentions.
required_elements: State the supplied mechanism and its link to a purpose or outcome.
Preserve the source's qualifications and causal scope.

all_of: A product, relevant cells or body sites, and an outcome are mentioned.
The source supplies the mechanism linking the product to the outcome.
exclude_if: The source does not provide the mechanism linking the product to the stated outcome.
required_information: A verified mechanism of action, including the relevant cell or body-site changes and their relationship to the stated outcome.

skills.name: State the mechanism accessibly after naming the product
skills.action: Lead with a plain-language statement linking the named product to its supplied mechanism, using an accessible action phrase such as “works by” and naming what it affects.

all_of: A product is named.
A mechanism explicitly linked to that product is available.
exclude_if: No product-linked mechanism is supplied.

preserve: The supplied product-to-mechanism relationship.
The target’s accessible wording and identification of what is controlled.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product and substances or measurements without stating their supplied relationship.
Asserting a mechanism that is not supplied.
required_elements: Name the product.
State its supplied mechanism in accessible language.

all_of: A product is named.
A mechanism explicitly linked to that product is provided.
exclude_if: No product-linked mechanism is supplied.
required_information: Verified source information explicitly stating how the named product acts.

skills.name: Group stated uses by population and preserve qualifications
skills.action: Organize product uses by explicitly stated patient group, separating groups when useful and retaining the stated purpose, eligibility conditions, and qualifications for each use.

all_of: One or more product uses and their relevant patient-group information are supplied.
exclude_if: The source gives no product-use information to organize.

preserve: Distinct population groupings and the target’s separation of adult and child uses.
The distinction between treatment and reduction purposes.
Eligibility conditions and qualifications as stated, without strengthening or weakening them.

not_an_attempt: Listing conditions without connecting them to a product use or supplied patient group.
Changing or dropping a qualification attached to a use.
required_elements: Present at least one supplied product use.
Associate it with its supplied patient group when available.
Retain the purpose and qualifications that apply to the use.

all_of: A product-use relationship is explicitly supplied.
Any population groupings and eligibility qualifications used are explicitly supplied.
exclude_if: The source provides only co-occurring product, condition, population, or treatment mentions without their relationships.
required_information: Verified indications linked to the product.
Verified population eligibility and any qualifying circumstances for each stated use.
The stated purpose for each use, such as treatment or reduction, where applicable.

skills.name: Explain a contrast between related technical terms
skills.action: Explain a supplied distinction between related technical terms in parallel, accessible language, adding an example when one is supplied.

all_of: Related technical terms are being contrasted.
The source supplies the distinction between them.
exclude_if: The source supplies term mentions but no distinction to explain.

preserve: The distinction between the terms.
Any causal or qualifying wording in the supplied definitions.
The source’s example, when available.

not_an_attempt: Repeating the terms without explaining their distinction.
Inventing definitions, causal relationships, or examples.
required_elements: Identify the terms being contrasted.
Explain their supplied distinction in a parallel or otherwise clear form.

all_of: At least two related technical terms are identified.
A source-provided distinction between the terms is available.
exclude_if: The source supplies term mentions but no definitions or contrast.
required_information: Verified definitions that state the distinction between the terms.
Verified information for any example or causal relation included.

skills.name: Treatment purpose with condition clarification and population restriction
skills.action: State a treatment purpose with the condition named, and include a familiar parenthetical clarification and population restriction when supplied.

all_of: The source supplies a treatment purpose and the condition it concerns.
exclude_if: The source does not establish the treatment relationship being stated.

preserve: Retain the source’s purpose and condition wording or meaning.
Preserve population restrictions when stated; do not infer eligibility from co-occurring mentions.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a product and condition without stating their supplied treatment relationship.
Changing the stated purpose into another purpose, such as cure or prevention.
required_elements: State the supplied treatment purpose and name the condition.
Include a source-supplied familiar clarification or population restriction when available.

all_of: A product or treatment mention is available.
A condition mention is available.
Verified information states the treatment purpose and its relationship to the condition.
