exclude_if: A source-specified order must be followed instead.
The proposed sequence would imply a medical relationship not supplied by the source.

preserve: The distinction among identity, mechanism, treatment purpose, condition explanation, and response information.
All source-specified relationships and qualifications.
The optional status of content not supplied.

not_an_attempt: Treating headings alone as evidence of the prose sequence.
Requiring absent content types to be added.
required_elements: Place identity or mechanism material before treatment-purpose or condition-explanation material when those types are presented in this sequence.
Place response or duration information after them when such information is available.

all_of: Verified product-identity information and mechanism information are available.
Verified therapeutic-purpose information is available.
Response or duration information is available if it is to be placed last.
exclude_if: The proposed order would imply an ingredient, mechanism, indication, or clinical-effect relationship absent from the input.
required_information: Verified product–ingredient relationship and mechanism, where included.
Verified therapeutic indication.
Verified clinical-effect timing or duration, if included.

skills.name: Purpose and population qualification after product identification
skills.action: Introduce the product as a medicine or treatment, state its purpose, and then give any applicable population qualification in the same patient-facing statement.

all_of: A product is being introduced.
A treatment purpose and any population qualification to be stated are available.

preserve: Keep the product introduction, purpose, and population qualification in the demonstrated order when all are stated.
Preserve any stated limits on the eligible population.

not_an_attempt: Naming the product without stating a treatment purpose.
Listing a purpose and population details without presenting the population details as a qualification on that use.
required_elements: Identify the product as a medicine or treatment.
State its treatment purpose.
When available, present the eligible population after the purpose as a qualification on that use.

all_of: A product mention.
Verified information linking the product to a treatment purpose.
Verified information specifying the population eligible for that use.
exclude_if: The input does not provide a verified product-purpose relationship.
The input does not provide the population qualification to be stated.
required_information: The verified indication for the product.
The verified eligible population, including any age threshold or age-group restrictions.

skills.name: Qualified use linked to an alternative treatment
skills.action: Describe a qualified-use circumstance by linking inability to take an alternative treatment with the stated reason, keeping that qualification attached to the described use.

all_of: A treatment use is being described.
A limitation on taking an alternative treatment and a reason for that limitation are available.

preserve: Preserve the conditional or qualified nature of the use.
Preserve the stated reason and its relationship to the limitation.

not_an_attempt: Merely naming an alternative treatment and a reason without linking them to a limitation on taking it.
Presenting the qualified use as an unqualified recommendation.
required_elements: State the limitation on taking the alternative treatment.
Link the limitation to its stated reason.
Keep the qualification attached to the described use.

all_of: A product or treatment whose use is being described.
Verified information that a patient group cannot take an alternative treatment for a stated reason.
exclude_if: The input only mentions an alternative treatment or side effects without linking them to inability to take that treatment.
required_information: The verified alternative treatment.
The verified relationship between inability to take it and the stated reason.
The verified patient group to which this qualification applies.

skills.name: Substance identity with a technical descriptor and functional gloss
skills.action: Name the product’s active substance, provide a technical descriptor, and follow it with an accessible functional explanation when one is available.

all_of: A product and a substance are being described.
A product-to-substance relationship and a technical descriptor are available.

preserve: Distinguish the substance identity from its class or functional description.
Preserve the scope and strength of the stated functional explanation.

not_an_attempt: Listing a substance and descriptor without stating their relationship to the product.
Providing a technical descriptor without an accompanying functional explanation when the pattern is being attempted.
required_elements: State the product-to-substance relationship.
Give the technical descriptor.
When available, explain the descriptor’s function in accessible wording.

all_of: A product mention and a named substance.
Verified information that the substance is the product's active substance.
A verified class descriptor and a supplied definition or functional explanation for it.
exclude_if: The substance is merely mentioned without a verified relationship to the product.
The technical descriptor lacks a supplied definition or functional explanation.
required_information: The verified active-substance relationship between the product and named substance.
The verified medicine-class relationship, if stated.
A supplied definition or functional explanation supporting the gloss.

skills.name: Identity through substance and group
skills.action: Introduce a product by stating its relationship to a named substance and, when available, its membership in a named medicine group in the same sentence.

all_of: A product and a substance are available to introduce.
A medicine group is available if group membership is to be stated.

preserve: Do not infer ingredient or medicine-group membership from co-occurring mentions.
Do not require a group relationship when none is supplied.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product, substance, or medicine group without stating the relationships being expressed.
required_elements: An explicit product-to-substance relationship.
If group membership is stated, an explicit product-to-group relationship.

all_of: A product and a substance are mentioned.
A medicine group is mentioned.
The source explicitly states that the substance is an ingredient of the product and that the product belongs to the group.
required_information: Verified product-to-substance ingredient relationship.
Verified product-to-medicine-group membership relationship.

skills.name: Reader-directed, conditional use wording
skills.action: Address the reader directly when describing supplied circumstances for use, and retain any stated conditions, inability, or risk restrictions when describing a qualified treatment or combination.

all_of: The source supplies circumstances for use or a treatment combination to describe.

preserve: Preserve direct address where used.
Preserve the target’s conditional wording and the scope of its restrictions; do not present them as independently validated medical advice.

not_an_attempt: Using second-person wording without describing relevant supplied circumstances for use.
Turning a supplied condition or restriction into an unconditional statement.
required_elements: Direct reader address tied to the supplied circumstances for use.
When the source states conditions or restrictions, wording that retains their conditional force and scope.

all_of: The source explicitly addresses the reader about circumstances for use.
The source supplies any restrictions and conditions attached to the use or treatment combination.
exclude_if: The source only mentions a medicine combination or condition without explicitly relating it to the reader’s eligibility or use.
required_information: Verified therapeutic indication and reader-eligibility criteria.
For a treatment combination, verified combination-therapy relationship and all stated conditions or restrictions, including any risk qualification.

skills.name: State identity through the active substance and formulation
skills.action: Introduce a product by naming its active substance and, when supplied, explaining how that substance is associated with other components or its formulation.

all_of: A product and its active substance are available in the source.
The source supplies the relationship between the product and active substance.
exclude_if: The source only co-mentions a product and substance without stating their relationship.

preserve: Retain the source's distinctions between active substance, associated component, and formulation.
Do not infer ingredient membership or formulation from co-occurring mentions.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product and substance separately without stating their relationship.
required_elements: Identify the product and its active substance.
State the source-supplied relationship between the substance and any described component or formulation.

all_of: A product mention is available.
An active-substance mention is available.
The source explicitly states their relationship.
exclude_if: The source only co-mentions the product and substance without stating their relationship.
required_information: Verified identification of the active substance for the product.
If formulation or another component is described, verified information stating how it relates to the active substance.

skills.name: Explain mechanism through component roles and consequences
skills.action: Explain a medicine or component's supplied role through an accessible sequence that links an action to its stated consequence.

all_of: The source supplies an action or role for a medicine or component.
The source supplies a consequence or effect to explain.
exclude_if: The source only lists medicines, components, or body-related terms without supplying an action, role, or consequence.

preserve: Keep each component's role and each cause-and-effect link within the source's stated scope.
Do not infer mechanisms or biological effects from entity mentions alone.

not_an_attempt: Merely naming a mechanism or technical process without explaining it.
required_elements: State a source-supplied action or component role.
Connect it to a source-supplied effect or consequence in an understandable sequence.

all_of: A medicine or component is mentioned.
A mechanism or component role is explicitly supplied.
exclude_if: The source only lists medicine, component, or body-related mentions without supplying a mechanism or role.
required_information: Verified mechanism linking the medicine or component to the stated action and consequence.
Verified component relationships wherever the explanation assigns a role to a component.

skills.name: Express condition-specific use with its qualifications

exclude_if: The source only co-mentions a medicine and condition without stating a use relationship.

preserve: Keep conditional language, prior-treatment requirements, suitability restrictions, and combination relationships as stated.
Do not turn a qualified use into an unqualified one or infer use from co-occurrence.

not_an_attempt: Listing a medicine and condition together without stating the use relationship.
required_elements: State the source-supplied relationship between the medicine and condition.
Retain any qualifications included in the described use.

all_of: A medicine and condition are mentioned.
The source explicitly states the medicine's use for that condition.
Any qualification included in the description is explicitly supplied.
exclude_if: The source only co-mentions a medicine and condition without stating an indication.
The source does not supply a claimed prior-treatment, eligibility, suitability, or combination relationship.
required_information: Verified medicine-to-condition indication.
For prior-treatment or suitability statements, verified eligibility criteria and their relationship to the indicated use.
For combination statements, verified combination-therapy relationship and named partner.
For statements about procedures being unsuitable, verified suitability information tied to the condition and intended use.

skills.name: Explain a class label in plain language

The source supplies a plain-language category description for the class.

Keep any source-supplied class description faithful.

Describe it using the source-supplied plain-language category.

all_of: A medicine and a class label are mentioned.
The source explicitly states the medicine's class membership.
A plain-language category description is supplied.
exclude_if: The source only co-mentions a medicine and class label or does not supply a category description.
required_information: Verified medicine-to-class relationship.
Source-supplied description of the class in plain language.

skills.name: Gloss a technical term with its abbreviation
skills.action: Introduce a supplied abbreviation alongside its expanded technical term and explicitly state their correspondence, for example by saying the term is generally known by the abbreviation.

Preserve the stated correspondence without adding a definition not supplied by the source.

not_an_attempt: Including an abbreviation without its expansion.
Listing a term and abbreviation without stating their correspondence.

An explicit statement linking the abbreviation to the term.

The source explicitly identifies the abbreviation as referring to that term.
exclude_if: The input contains both strings but does not establish that they correspond.

all_of: Patient-relevant treatment-expectation, risk, or precaution information is supplied.

preserve: Retain the source’s modality, including possibility wording such as “may.”

not_an_attempt: Using second person without communicating a patient-relevant qualification or risk.
Adding a non-cure statement, risk, or precaution absent from the source.

At least one relevant qualification or risk supplied by the source.

For any ongoing-risk or transmission statement, the source explicitly supplies the relevant risk and its relationship to the patient or treatment.
exclude_if: The input contains only medicine or condition mentions without verified treatment-expectation, risk, or transmission information.
required_information: Verified treatment-versus-cure statement, if included.
Verified ongoing-risk claims and their relationship to the patient or treatment, if included.
Verified transmission claim and any associated precautionary wording, if included.

skills.name: State uses with their qualifications

not_an_attempt: Merely listing conditions without presenting them as uses of the medicine.
Presenting a qualified use as unqualified when the source gives a relevant restriction.

Retain the qualifications that are stated for those uses.

all_of: A product and at least one potential condition or use are mentioned.
exclude_if: The source does not establish which condition is an indication or which qualifications apply to that use.
required_information: Verified indication for the product.
Verified population eligibility and any prior-treatment or disease-status conditions for each stated use.
Verified whether the product is used alone or with other treatment.

skills.name: Treatment purpose with a stated population qualification

Treating a number mention alone as an age threshold or patient restriction.

A condition mention is available.
Verified source information explicitly states the treatment indication.
If an age qualification is stated, verified source information explicitly gives its population scope and threshold.
exclude_if: The source does not verify the product-to-condition treatment relationship.
An age qualification would have to be inferred from a number mention alone.
required_information: The verified treatment indication for the medicine.
For any stated age restriction, the verified eligible population and exact threshold wording.

skills.name: Introduce identity through the named medicine and its group

Naming a group without identifying which medicine it describes.

When a group is stated, link that medicine to the group.

The source explicitly provides the product-to-medicine relationship and the medicine’s group membership.
exclude_if: The source does not verify either relationship.

Verified information that the medicine belongs to the stated group.

The source supports the purpose statement being made.
exclude_if: The source supports only prevention or only treatment, but the proposed wording states both.

Preserve the source’s degree of certainty and do not turn treatment into a cure claim.
Do not state both purposes unless both are supported.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition without stating the medicine’s purpose.
Stating only one purpose when the wording claims to combine both.

Name the relevant condition category.

all_of: A PRODUCT_NAME, GENERIC_NAME, or TREATMENT mention is available.
A condition mention is available.
The source verifies both prevention and treatment as purposes for that condition.
exclude_if: Only one of prevention or treatment is verified, or the source does not establish the medicine–condition relationship.

skills.name: Explain mechanism with accessible action verbs

The source supplies an action or mechanism to explain.

Keep mechanism explanation distinct from the medicine’s stated purpose.
Retain the target’s qualification that the action concerns some types of fungi.

not_an_attempt: Giving an action or mechanism absent from the source.
Mentioning the medicine and organism without explaining their stated relationship.

Connect the action to the relevant organism or process.

Presenting qualified use as unconditional.

Present relevant condition-specific cases after that framing.
Keep any stated prior-treatment qualification attached to its case.

The source verifies the eligible population, the medicine’s use for each condition, and any required prior-treatment outcomes.
exclude_if: The source does not specify the population or does not link each condition to its treatment qualification.
The source does not distinguish prior-treatment alternatives from a combination regimen.

Verified therapeutic indication for each listed condition.
Verified prior-treatment requirements, including which prior medicines are relevant and whether they failed or had to be stopped.
Verified information clarifying whether named medicines are prior treatments rather than medicines used together.

Adding a definition or equivalence not supplied by the source.

Provide a nearby, clearly linked name or explanation.

all_of: A technical condition term and an explanatory term or definition are available.
The source verifies the relationship between them.
exclude_if: The source provides no verified definition or naming relationship.

Naming a class without an explanation when the action includes a class explanation.

When class and definition information are available and used, name the class and briefly explain it.

Verified source information explicitly links the substance to the product, identifies its medicine class, and defines that class in accessible terms.
required_information: The verified product–active-substance relationship.
The verified substance–class relationship.
A verified, suitable plain-language definition of the class.

skills.name: Inline glosses for technical wording

required_elements: Connect the intervention to at least one supplied outcome.
Retain the stated degree of benefit and any distinct outcomes that are included.

all_of: The source explicitly relates an intervention to a viewing or detection outcome.
The source supplies the specific outcome described.
exclude_if: The input only co-mentions an intervention and an outcome without stating their relationship.
required_information: Verified information about how the intervention relates to the viewing or detection outcome.
Verified support for each stated clinical effect, including any claimed improvement.

skills.name: Accessible explanation of intended biological action
skills.action: Explain a product's stated biological action by connecting it to the target site or tissue and the stated production or other outcome.

all_of: A product or treatment and a biological target or outcome are available.

preserve: The stated action of encouraging bone marrow to produce more white blood cells.
The wording presents this as an intended action, not a guarantee of outcome.
Retain the parenthetical explanation of bone marrow when an appropriate source-supported explanation is available.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product, target, or outcome without linking them as an action.
Presenting an encouraged or intended action as a guaranteed result.
required_elements: Explicitly link the product or treatment to the stated biological action.
Name the target site or tissue and outcome when those details are supplied.

all_of: A product or treatment mention and a biological target or site are available.
Verified information explicitly links the product or treatment to the stated biological action and outcome.
exclude_if: The source supplies only mentions of the product, target, or outcome without the mechanism linking them.
required_information: Verified mechanism-of-action information linking the named product or treatment to the target site and the stated biological outcome.

skills.name: Introduces identity through class, substance and diagnostic purpose
skills.action: Introduce the product by stating its medicine class and diagnostic-only role; then, when available, link it to its active substance and state the diagnostic purpose, using a parenthetical gloss for a technical diagnostic term when supplied.

all_of: A medicine or product is being introduced.

preserve: Keep diagnostic use distinct from treatment.
Preserve the source's degree and scope of limitation, such as “diagnostic use only” or “used only to identify illness.”
Do not infer active-substance membership or purpose from co-occurrence alone.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product and substance without linking them when the source does provide that relationship.
Describing treatment when the source presents the use as diagnostic.
required_elements: State the product class and diagnostic limitation when the source supplies them.
Link the product to its active substance when that relationship is supplied.
State the diagnostic purpose when supplied; retain any parenthetical term gloss from the source.

all_of: A product-name mention is available.
A substance-name mention is available.
Source text explicitly identifies the product's medicine class.
Source text explicitly identifies the substance as an active substance of that product.
Source text explicitly states the diagnostic purpose.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly establish any one of the class, active-substance relationship or diagnostic purpose.
The source describes treatment rather than the diagnostic purpose being expressed.
required_information: Verified information identifying the product as a medicine of the stated class; identifying the substance as its active substance; and stating what the product is used to identify.

skills.name: Explains the detection process leading to a scan
skills.action: Explain how a source-described signal or material is detected from outside the body, naming the detection equipment when supplied; then connect that step to making or informing an image or scan when the source does so.

all_of: The report is explaining an imaging or detection procedure.

preserve: Keep the source's order and causal direction when it describes a detection-to-imaging sequence.
Do not add equipment, mechanism, or causal links absent from the source.
Retain stated quantity or duration qualifications when relevant.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning radioactivity and a scan without explaining the source-provided detection step.
Naming equipment without stating its role in detection.
required_elements: Describe the detection step and its role using source-supported details.
Connect detection to making or informing an image or scan when the source supplies that connection.

all_of: A medicine or procedure mention is available.
An imaging-test mention is available.
Source text explicitly describes the signal or material being detected.
Source text explicitly describes how it is detected from outside the body.
Source text explicitly connects that detection step to making or informing the scan.
exclude_if: The source does not provide the detection mechanism.
The source does not connect detection to imaging.
The proposed explanation would require adding a mechanism or equipment absent from the source.
required_information: A verified account of the signal or material involved, how it is detected, and how that detection produces or informs the scan.

skills.name: Qualifies scan value as a possible clinician judgment
skills.action: Frame a test's possible value as a clinician's judgment, retaining the source's modal force and keeping distinct any further information-gathering or decision-making purposes it mentions.

all_of: A test, procedure, or intervention is discussed.

preserve: Preserve modal force: “may” and “would” mark possibility here.
Do not assert that the scan will help or that treatment will be given.
Do not collapse finding out more about a condition into deciding on possible treatment.

not_an_attempt: Presenting a possible benefit as certain.
Turning a possible future decision into a recommendation or definite outcome.
Removing clinician attribution when the source attributes the judgment to a clinician.
required_elements: State the possible value with the source's level of certainty.
Retain clinician attribution when present in the source.
Keep separate purposes or consequences distinct when the source does so.

all_of: A test or procedure mention is available.
A condition mention or treatment-related mention is available.
Source text explicitly states the possible benefit of the test or procedure.
Source text attributes the judgment to a clinician if the output does so.
Source text supports the modal degree of certainty used.
exclude_if: The source does not state the possible benefit.
The source does not support attributing the judgment to a clinician.
The source does not support the proposed level of uncertainty.
required_information: Verified information about what the test may help determine, whether it may inform a further decision, whether a clinician's judgment is being reported, and the certainty with which the source states this.

skills.name: Ends with an attributed clinical benefit–exposure risk comparison
skills.action: When the source closes with a benefit–risk comparison, report the assessment with its stated attribution, comparing the stated clinical benefit with the stated exposure risk; retain relevant qualifications and any stated amount or comparator.

all_of: A report discusses a procedure, test, or treatment and an associated risk.

preserve: Keep the assessment attributed to the clinicians when the source attributes it to them.
Do not present the comparison as a guarantee or as independently verified.
Preserve qualifications; a preceding exposure comparison with another procedure is included when available, not required for the closing pattern.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning exposure without making the source-stated comparison.
Presenting an attributed assessment as independently established.
Strengthening a qualified comparison into a guarantee of safety or benefit.
required_elements: State both sides of the comparison and the source's conclusion when supplied.
Retain clinician attribution when present.
Preserve relevant source-stated qualifications, amounts, and comparators.

all_of: A procedure, test or treatment mention is available.
Source text identifies the exposure risk being discussed.
Source text identifies the clinical benefit being weighed.
Source text explicitly compares the benefit with the exposure risk.
Source text attributes the assessment to a clinician or clinicians if that attribution is used.
Any amount, comparator and qualification in the output are explicitly supported by the source.
exclude_if: The source does not provide both the benefit and exposure risk.
The source does not state a comparison between them.
The source does not support the clinician attribution, quantity, comparator or degree of qualification used.
required_information: Verified details of the exposure and clinical benefit being compared; the source's explicit benefit-risk conclusion; who made the assessment; and any stated quantities, comparator or qualifications.

skills.name: Qualify use options and preserve population restrictions
skills.action: Present medicine-use options with conditional wording, distinguishing use on its own from use with other medicines and stating the applicable populations or age limits when available.

all_of: A medicine-use statement has one or more options.

preserve: Keep use on its own distinct from use with other antiepileptic medicines when both options are stated.
Retain the conditional force of “may be used.”
Preserve supplied population and age qualifications without generalizing them or adding unsupported restrictions.

not_an_attempt: Presenting conditional options as unqualified certainty.
Collapsing distinct use-on-its-own and use-with-other-medicines options when both are supplied.
required_elements: Use wording that retains the stated conditional force.
Keep distinct supplied use options distinguishable.

all_of: A use statement and its conditional status are supplied.
The source explicitly specifies whether each option is used alone or with other medicines.
The eligible populations and any age threshold are explicitly verified.
exclude_if: The source gives only a treatment or number mention without linking it to a use option or eligibility restriction.
required_information: Verified indication for the stated use.
Verified monotherapy or combination-therapy relationship for each option.
Verified eligible populations and any age threshold, including the relevant unit and restriction.

skills.name: Purpose-first introduction with qualified eligibility
skills.action: Introduce the medicine and its treatment purpose first, then present eligible population groups in a compact list or equivalent grouping, attaching any stated eligibility limits to the relevant group.

all_of: The source supplies a medicine and its treatment purpose.
The source supplies at least one eligible population.

preserve: Keep population-specific qualifications attached to the correct population.
Preserve the scope and force of limiting language; do not turn eligibility into an unconditional recommendation.

not_an_attempt: Naming a medicine and condition without presenting their source-supported treatment relationship.
Presenting eligibility limits in a way that changes which population they apply to.
required_elements: A medicine-purpose statement before the eligibility information.
Eligible population information in a list or comparably compact grouping.
Any source-supplied eligibility qualification attached to the population it limits.

all_of: A product mention and source information explicitly linking it to a treatment purpose.
Source information specifying at least one eligible population.
Where eligibility is limited, source information stating the applicable qualification.
exclude_if: The source does not verify the product-purpose relationship.
The source does not verify the population eligibility or any stated restriction.
required_information: Verified therapeutic indication for the product.
Verified population eligibility and the precise conditions or limitations applying to each population.

skills.name: Accessible process-based explanation of the condition
skills.action: Explain a condition using an accessible account of a bodily process, contrasting the condition with the reference process and linking the stated difference to its consequence.

all_of: The source provides a condition explanation suitable for a patient-facing description.

preserve: Keep the process, contrast, and consequence in the relationships and degree of certainty stated by the source.
Use accessible wording without adding or strengthening clinical claims.

not_an_attempt: Merely naming a condition or listing its symptoms.
Stating a process, contrast, or consequence that the source does not provide.
required_elements: An accessible description of a bodily process relevant to the condition.
A source-supported contrast between the condition and a reference process.
A source-supported consequence linked to that contrast.

all_of: Source information describing a normal or reference bodily process.
Source information describing how that process differs in the condition.
Source information linking the described difference to a consequence.
exclude_if: The source provides only condition or anatomy mentions without the process relationships.
The source does not provide the stated consequence or its connection to the process.
required_information: Verified disease-specific explanation of the bodily process, its contrast with the reference process, and the consequence attributed to that contrast.

skills.name: Immediate plain-language gloss
skills.action: Place a concise plain-language explanation immediately beside a technical term, including as a parenthetical gloss when appropriate.

all_of: The description uses a technical term for which the source supplies a plain-language equivalent or explanation.

preserve: Keep the explanation adjacent to the term it clarifies.
Preserve the source's meaning without extending the gloss.

not_an_attempt: Providing a definition separately rather than next to the term.
Replacing a technical term with another term without explaining it.
Adding a gloss not supplied by the source.
required_elements: A technical term.
An adjacent, concise plain-language gloss.

all_of: A technical term is present.
Source information supplies a plain-language meaning for that term.
exclude_if: The source does not supply the term's meaning.
The proposed gloss would add information not expressed in the source.
required_information: A verified definition or plain-language equivalent for the particular term.

skills.name: Direct reader address in the condition explanation
skills.action: Use direct second-person address in a patient-facing explanation, including to describe a condition or what a reader may or may not know, when that content is source-supported.

all_of: The source provides patient-facing information that can appropriately be phrased with direct reader address.

preserve: Keep second person as a mode of address, not a basis for individualized diagnosis or advice.
Preserve qualifications such as “may” and distinctions between general information and claims about an individual.

not_an_attempt: Using second person only in an unrelated instruction.
Turning general information into an unsupported claim that the individual reader has a condition or its effects.
Changing a stated possibility into a certainty.
required_elements: Second-person wording that directly addresses the reader.
A source-supported explanation or statement phrased in that address.

all_of: A patient-facing description of a bodily process or condition that can be phrased with direct reader reference.
exclude_if: The source does not support addressing the reader in this context.
Direct address would turn a general statement into an unsupported claim about an individual reader.
required_information: A source-supported bodily process or condition description suitable for direct reader address.

skills.name: Progression from purpose to condition explanation to medicine explanation
skills.action: When the relevant content is available, present the medicine's purpose and eligibility before a condition explanation, and present the medicine's mechanism explanation after that condition explanation.

all_of: The source contains at least two of these content blocks: medicine purpose and eligibility, a condition explanation, or an explanation of how the medicine works.

preserve: Treat the sequence as an ordering convention, not a requirement to include every content block.
Do not add a clinical relationship merely to complete the sequence.

not_an_attempt: Using headings without arranging the available explanatory content in the evidenced sequence.
Inferring a mechanism or clinical outcome from co-occurring entity mentions.
required_elements: When purpose and eligibility information is included, it precedes a condition explanation if one is included.
When both a condition explanation and a medicine-mechanism explanation are included, the mechanism explanation follows the condition explanation.

all_of: Verified product-purpose and eligibility information.
A supplied explanation of the relevant condition.
A supplied medicine-mechanism explanation, with any stated clinical outcome explicitly linked in the source.
exclude_if: The source lacks one of the information blocks needed for this sequence.
A mechanism or clinical outcome relationship would have to be inferred from entity co-occurrence.
required_information: Verified product-purpose and eligibility details; condition-specific explanatory information; and, if the medicine explanation states an outcome, a verified mechanism and outcome relationship.

skills.name: Gloss a condition with a brief parenthetical description
skills.action: Make a named condition more accessible by placing a concise, source-supported description or equivalent in parentheses after it.

all_of: A named condition and a source-supported explanation or description of it are available.
exclude_if: The source only mentions a separate condition or body site without linking it as an explanation of the named condition.

preserve: The source-supported relationship between the condition and its description.
Any stated severity or other qualification without strengthening or dropping it.

not_an_attempt: Repeating the condition name without explaining it.
Adding a parenthetical phrase that the source does not link to the named condition.
required_elements: Name the condition.
Immediately follow it with a concise parenthetical description supported as an explanation of that condition.

all_of: A named condition is available.
The source explicitly provides a plain-language description of that condition.
exclude_if: The source merely mentions a second condition or body site without identifying it as an explanation of the first.
required_information: Verified information that the proposed parenthetical phrase describes or explains the named condition, including any stated severity qualification.

skills.name: Gloss a disease term and qualify a cause
skills.action: Explain a named disease with an accessible description; when available, add a cause statement while preserving its qualification.

all_of: A named disease is available.

preserve: Preserve the target’s qualification “often caused”; do not make the cause universal.
Keep the link between the disease term and its description explicit.

not_an_attempt: Restating the disease name without an explanation.
Presenting an included possible or qualified cause as certain.
required_elements: Link the disease term to an accessible description.

all_of: A disease mention is available (DX_NAME or PROBLEM).
exclude_if: No verified plain-language definition of the named disease is supplied.
A cause is to be stated but no verified cause and qualification are supplied.
required_information: A verified explanation explicitly linked to the disease term.
For any cause statement, verified causal information and the source's degree of qualification.

skills.name: Explain mechanism through a cause-and-effect sequence
skills.action: Explain treatment action by linking it to a bodily change and a functional outcome; when available, place this in a condition-to-symptom explanation.

all_of: A treatment action or bodily change is available.

preserve: Retain the distinction between preventing muscle tightening and making airflow easier.
Do not recast the described action as curing COPD.

not_an_attempt: Listing a treatment, body part, or outcome without linking the treatment action to the bodily change or outcome.
Inferring a mechanism or causal relationship from co-occurring entity mentions.
required_elements: When explaining a treatment effect, link the treatment action to a bodily change and the stated functional outcome.

all_of: A treatment mention is available (TREATMENT, TREATMENT_NAME, or PRODUCT_NAME).
At least one anatomy mention is available (SYSTEM_ORGAN_SITE).
A condition or symptom mention is available (DX_NAME or PROBLEM).
exclude_if: The verified source information does not supply the mechanism and the relevant cause-and-effect links.
required_information: A verified mechanism of action specifying the treatment's action and the linked bodily change and outcome.

skills.name: Identity through substances and medicine group
skills.action: Introduce a product by naming its active substance or substances and explicitly connecting them to a named medicine group.

all_of: A product, one or more active substances, and a medicine group are available.
The source supports the product-to-active-substance relationship and the substances’ membership in the named group.
exclude_if: The source does not support either relationship.

preserve: The distinction between naming substances and identifying them as active substances of the product.
The explicit connection to a named medicine group.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product, substances, or a group without connecting them as described.
required_elements: Name the product and its active substance or substances.
Explicitly connect the substances to a named medicine group.

all_of: A product name and one or more substance names are available.
The source explicitly verifies that the named substances are active substances of that product.
The source explicitly verifies the medicine-group relationship.
required_information: Verified product-to-active-substance relationship.
Verified active-substance-to-medicine-group relationship and the group’s name.

skills.name: Qualified effect and possible benefit
skills.action: Present a source-supported effect separately from a qualified possible downstream benefit, retaining the stated degree of certainty.

all_of: A source-supported effect and a related possible downstream benefit are available.
exclude_if: The source does not support the effect, the downstream benefit, or the relationship expressed between them.

preserve: The effect wording as distinct from the downstream benefit.
The qualification “may help,” or an equivalent qualification reflecting the source’s degree of certainty.
The distinction between reducing blood sugar and possibly helping to prevent complications.

not_an_attempt: Presenting a possible benefit as guaranteed.
Conflating the stated effect with a distinct downstream benefit.
required_elements: State the source-supported effect.
State the downstream benefit with the source’s qualification.
Keep the effect distinct from the possible benefit.

all_of: An effect and a possible downstream benefit are available.
The source supports the stated effect and its relationship to the medicine.
The source supports the downstream benefit and its qualified relationship to the effect.
exclude_if: The source does not support the effect or downstream benefit.
The source does not establish the link between them.
required_information: Verified clinical effect of the medicine.
Verified relationship, if any, between that effect and the downstream benefit.
The source’s degree of certainty for the downstream benefit.

skills.name: Product introduction with substance, class, and purpose
skills.action: In an opening sentence, introduce the product by naming its supplied substance or substances, identifying their supplied class, and stating the supplied purpose together.

all_of: The source supplies a product and one or more substances related to it.
The source supplies the relevant substance-class relationship and purpose.
exclude_if: The source does not establish the product–substance relationship, class, or purpose.

preserve: The source's product–substance, class, and purpose relationships.
The combined opening-sentence presentation without strengthening the stated purpose.

not_an_attempt: Listing substances without relating them to the product.
Naming a class or purpose without expressing the supplied relationships.
required_elements: A product is introduced with one or more related substances.
The supplied class and purpose are combined with that introduction.

all_of: A product and at least one proposed substance are mentioned.
The source explicitly supplies their relationship, the relevant medicine class, and a purpose.
exclude_if: The product–substance, class, or purpose relationships are not supplied.
required_information: Verified information that the named substance or substances are contained in the product.
Verified classification of the substances and the product's stated purpose.

skills.name: Qualified indication and eligibility
skills.action: State the product's use for a condition and include the source-provided population and treatment prerequisite or other limitation when available.

all_of: The source supplies a product-use relationship to a condition.
exclude_if: The source does not establish the product's use for the condition.

preserve: The adult population restriction stated in the example.
The condition being treated.
The qualification that metformin alone is insufficient.
The scope and force of any source-provided qualifications.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition without stating the product's use for it.
Omitting a population restriction or treatment qualification that the source supplies.
Turning a qualified use into an unrestricted one.
required_elements: An explicit product-use relationship to a condition.
Any population restriction and treatment prerequisite or limitation supplied for that use.

all_of: A product and a condition are mentioned.
The source explicitly states the product's indication, eligible population, and any prior-treatment qualification used in the sentence.
exclude_if: The indication, population eligibility, or stated treatment prerequisite is absent or unspecified.
required_information: Verified indication linking the product to the condition.
Verified population eligibility and the precise prior-treatment qualification.

skills.name: Conditional response-based discontinuation statement
skills.action: State a conditional follow-up rule linking a source-provided time window and response condition to the stated action, when those elements are available.

all_of: The source supplies a follow-up action linked to a treatment response.
exclude_if: The source does not establish the conditional relationship between the response and the action.

preserve: The conditional nature of the statement.
The stated interval after starting the product and the lack-of-improvement condition.
The linked action and its modal force: 'should be discontinued'.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a time period without the response condition.
Describing a response condition without the linked action.
Turning a conditional action into unconditional advice or changing its stated force.
required_elements: The source-provided response condition and linked action.
The source-provided time window, when one is stated.
The conditional relationship among the supplied elements.

all_of: A product and a treatment-response measure are mentioned.
The source explicitly supplies a time window, the response condition, and the action linked to that condition.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly link the time window, response condition, and action.
required_information: Verified time window after starting treatment.
Verified response criterion and the explicit action to take if that criterion is met or not met.

skills.name: Product identity followed by substance action
skills.action: Introduce a product by stating what substance it contains, then identify that substance and describe its action in the same sentence. When the source also supplies an explanation of the substance’s role, include it as a plain-language elaboration.

all_of: A product and a substance associated with it are available.

preserve: Preserve the source’s exact product–substance relationship, substance classification, and action.
Include explanatory details only when supplied; do not add a role or consequence.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product and substance without stating their relationship.
Naming or classifying the substance without describing its action.
required_elements: The sentence states that the product contains the named substance.
The sentence identifies the substance and states its action.

all_of: A product-name mention and a candidate substance mention are available.
The source supplies an action and any definition used in the explanation.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly link the product to the substance.
The source does not supply the action or the explanatory definition used.
required_information: Verified information that the product contains the named substance; whether the substance is an enzyme; the substance's mechanism or action; and the stated role of asparagine and cell survival, if those details are included.

skills.name: Contrast normal and cancer cells
skills.action: Explain a relevant difference by contrasting what one group can do with what another group cannot do, retaining any limitation on the groups.

all_of: The source supplies two groups and contrasting abilities relevant to the explanation.

preserve: Keep the contrast and its direction.
Do not broaden the claim beyond the groups or scope specified by the source.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning two groups without contrasting their abilities.
Presenting a limited claim as applying to all members of a group.
required_elements: The wording contrasts an ability attributed to one group with an inability attributed to another.
Any stated limitation on the groups is retained.

all_of: Mentions of both groups being compared are available.
The source explicitly states the relevant ability for each group and any limitation on the groups.
exclude_if: The source does not supply both sides of the comparison.
The source does not specify the scope of the comparison where it is qualified.
required_information: Verified information stating what each group can or cannot do, and which members of the groups the statements apply to.

skills.name: Link reported level change to growth effect
skills.action: State a product-attributed change in a substance level and coordinate it with a reported effect on cell growth, in the same sentence.

all_of: The source supplies a product-attributed change in a substance level and an effect on cell growth.

preserve: Preserve the direction and scope of the level change and the stated growth effect.
Do not imply that one effect causes the other unless the source states that relationship.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a level change without attributing it to the product.
Mentioning cells without stating an effect on their growth.
required_elements: A product-attributed substance-level change is stated.
An effect on cell growth is stated and coordinated with the level change.

all_of: A product mention and mentions of the affected substance and cell group are available.
The source explicitly states both effects and their relationship.
exclude_if: The source supplies only the level change, without the growth effect or the link between them.
required_information: Verified information on the product's effect on the named substance level, the affected cells and their growth, and whether the source states that the effects are related.

skills.name: Plain-language condition explanation
skills.action: Explain a named condition with a plain-language description of its type and what happens in it; when supplied, identify a technical name for the described cells in parentheses.

all_of: A named condition and source-provided descriptive information about it are available.

preserve: Retain qualifiers such as “certain” and the source’s account of the cells and consequences.
Keep the explanation distinct from a treatment-purpose claim unless the source separately states that relationship.

not_an_attempt: Repeating a condition name without explaining it.
Giving an explanation or technical label that the source does not supply.
required_elements: The wording describes the condition’s type or nature.
The wording gives a source-supported account of what happens in the condition.

all_of: A condition mention is available.
The source provides a definition or description of that condition.
exclude_if: The source does not supply the condition definition or explanatory details used.
required_information: A verified definition of the named condition and the specific disease explanation included in the text.

skills.name: Concise combination-use qualification
skills.action: Add a separate, concise statement that the product is used together with other medicines.

all_of: A product and a combination-use qualification are relevant to the report.

preserve: Keep the qualification as general as the source; do not name medicines or add a regimen when unspecified.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning other medicines without stating that they are used together with the product.
required_elements: A concise statement says the product is used together with other medicines.

all_of: A product mention and another-medicine or treatment mention are available.
The source explicitly states that they are used together.
exclude_if: The source only mentions other medicines without stating a combination relationship.
required_information: Verified information that the product is used together with other medicines; do not infer a combination from separate mentions.

skills.name: Mechanism linked to symptom effect
skills.action: Explain a treatment effect by stating an effect on a relevant body system or condition and linking it to symptom treatment when that relationship is supplied.

all_of: A treatment, relevant body system or condition, or symptoms are available for discussion.

preserve: The direction and scope of the stated effect.
The target's link between reducing bladder activity and treating related symptoms.
The source's degree of certainty.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning an effect and symptoms without linking them in the explanation.
required_elements: State an effect on the relevant body system or condition.
Connect that effect to symptom treatment when the text makes that connection.

all_of: A product or treatment and a relevant condition or symptom are mentioned.
Verified information supplies the mechanism and, if symptom treatment is stated, the treatment relationship.
exclude_if: Mechanism information or the asserted treatment relationship is absent or unverified.
required_information: Verified mechanism-of-action information for the treatment, plus verified therapeutic-indication information for any claimed symptom effect.

skills.name: Qualified purpose followed by symptom examples
skills.action: State a treatment use, qualify the population when supplied, and introduce relevant symptoms as examples when available.

all_of: A treatment use and relevant condition or symptoms are available for discussion.

preserve: The adult population qualification in this example, or the corresponding source qualification in another case.
The relationship between the treatment use and the symptoms.
The non-exhaustive force of “such as.”

not_an_attempt: Listing a condition or population without stating a treatment use.
Listing symptoms without presenting them as examples of the stated use.
required_elements: State a treatment use.
When present, qualify the use for the named population.
When examples are included, introduce relevant symptoms as examples of that use.

all_of: A treatment or product and a condition or symptoms are mentioned.
Verified information supports the treatment indication.
If a population is named, verified information supports that population's eligibility.
If symptoms are listed as examples, verified information relates them to the indication.
exclude_if: The treatment relationship is unverified.
A stated population restriction or example-symptom relationship is unverified.
required_information: Verified therapeutic indication; verified population eligibility for any named population; and verified relation of any example symptoms to the indication.

skills.name: Accessible cell-level mechanism linked to disease
skills.action: Explains a medicine's effect on a biological target and, when available, relates that target to a disease.

all_of: A medicine or substance and a biological target are available to identify.

preserve: The stated effect on the target, including its direction or nature as supplied.
Any stated qualification of how the target relates to the disease.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a medicine, target, and disease without stating an effect on the target.
Stating an effect without relating the target to a disease when that relation is included.
required_elements: State the medicine or substance's effect on the target.

all_of: A GENERIC_NAME or TREATMENT mention identifying a medicine or substance.
A PROBLEM mention describing cells or another biological target.
A DX_NAME or PROBLEM mention identifying a disease.
exclude_if: No supplied mechanism explicitly describes the medicine's effect on the target.
