skills.name: Direct patient address with a qualified risk-benefit statement
skills.action: Address the reader directly when presenting a supplied, attributed clinical benefit-risk assessment, retaining its qualifications; state exposure information separately when available.

all_of: A patient-facing report has an appropriate reader to address.

preserve: Keep the assessment attributed to the stated decision-makers when supplied.
Preserve the target's comparison and certainty without strengthening it.
Retain any supplied exposure qualification without treating it as part of the assessment unless the source links them.

not_an_attempt: Using second-person language without addressing the reader.
Presenting an unattributed or strengthened benefit-risk conclusion.
required_elements: Use direct reader address in the assessment when appropriate.
Attribute the assessment as supplied and preserve its degree of certainty and comparison.

all_of: The source supplies an exposure statement and its qualification.
The source supplies a clinician-attributed benefit-risk assessment.
exclude_if: The source does not provide the exposure qualification or the attributed assessment.
required_information: Verified exposure information, including amount qualification if stated.
Verified clinician-attributed assessment comparing clinical benefit and risk.

skills.name: Product identity is introduced through category and active-substance statements
skills.action: When the relevant information is available, introduces the named product with a category description, may add a production-method descriptor, and then states its active substance in a separate sentence.

all_of: A product name is available.

preserve: Keep the product category and active-substance relationship distinct and explicit.
Do not infer a category, ingredient relationship, or production method from co-occurring mentions.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product without a category description or a separate active-substance statement.
Treating co-occurring mentions as establishing a product-category or active-substance relationship.
required_elements: Give a category description explicitly linked to the product.
State the active substance explicitly in relation to the product.
If a production method is included, present it as a product descriptor.

all_of: A product-name mention is available.
A treatment or product-category mention is available.
required_information: Verified information linking the named product to its category.
Verified information identifying the product's active substance.
A verified production-method statement if production is included.

skills.name: Mechanism is explained through a role-to-deficiency-to-replacement sequence
skills.action: When the relevant relationships are supplied, explains a mechanism in a connected progression from a factor's role, through the consequences of its absence, to the product's stated action.

all_of: A product or treatment is being explained.

preserve: Keep the stated explanatory sequence and causal relationships intact.
Preserve the target's degree of certainty and qualifications.
Do not infer a mechanism from mentions of a product, factor, or symptom alone.

not_an_attempt: Listing factor, clotting, bleeding, and product mentions without explaining their relationships.
Inferring a mechanism or causal link from entity co-occurrence alone.
required_elements: Connect the supplied factor role to the relevant process.
Describe the supplied consequence of the factor's absence.
Describe the supplied product action in relation to that process.

all_of: A factor- or clotting-related mention is available.
A deficiency- or bleeding-related mention is available.
A product or treatment mention is available.
required_information: Verified information describing the factor's role in the process.
Verified information linking its absence to the stated consequence.
A verified mechanism linking the product's action to the stated process.

skills.name: Age eligibility is stated explicitly at the close
skills.action: When age-eligibility information is supplied, states it explicitly, here as a brief closing sentence.

all_of: A product or treatment is being described.

preserve: Retain the scope of age eligibility without narrowing or broadening it.
Do not treat “all age groups” as a reusable default.

not_an_attempt: Inferring age eligibility from the presence or absence of age mentions.
Adding an age-eligibility statement without supplied eligibility information.
required_elements: State the supplied age eligibility explicitly.
Preserve its scope.
When following the target's placement pattern, put the statement at the close.

all_of: A product-name mention is available.
required_information: Verified information specifying the age groups eligible for use.

skills.name: Product identity paired with a hormone effect
skills.action: Introduce a product by naming its active substance, then state the supplied effect on a named hormone.

all_of: A product and its active substance are supplied.
An effect on a named hormone is supplied.
exclude_if: The active-substance relationship or hormone effect is not supported by the source.

preserve: Keep the product-to-substance relationship explicit.
Do not strengthen or otherwise alter the stated hormone effect.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product and substance without identifying their relationship.
Naming a hormone without stating the supplied effect on it.
required_elements: Name the product and identify its active substance.
State the supplied effect on the named hormone.

all_of: A product and a substance are mentioned.
The supplied information explicitly identifies the substance as an active substance of that product.
The supplied information states the product/substance's effect on a named hormone.
exclude_if: The substance is only co-mentioned with the product.
No effect on a named hormone is supplied.
required_information: Verified product-to-active-substance relationship.
Verified effect of the product or substance on the named hormone.

skills.name: Treatment purpose with qualified patient context
skills.action: State that a product is used to treat a condition, retaining supplied patient or treatment-circumstance qualifications and, when available, a plain-language purpose for a procedure.

all_of: A product and a condition with a source-supported treatment relationship are available.
exclude_if: The source does not support the product-to-condition treatment relationship.

preserve: Keep treatment distinct from prevention, symptom relief, or cure.
Preserve the scope of the patient group and the stated role or purpose of any procedure.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a product and condition without stating that the product is used to treat the condition.
Dropping or broadening a supplied patient or treatment-circumstance qualification.
required_elements: Explicitly state the supplied treatment purpose.
Retain relevant patient or treatment-circumstance qualifications when supplied.
If a procedure's purpose is stated, retain it without turning it into an instruction to administer the product.

all_of: A product and a candidate condition are mentioned.
The supplied information explicitly states the product is used to treat that condition.
The supplied information explicitly states any patient-group or treatment-circumstance qualifications and, if included, the purpose of the procedure.
exclude_if: No product-to-indication relationship is supplied.
A patient restriction or procedure qualification is not supplied but would be needed to reproduce the target's qualified-use wording.
required_information: Verified therapeutic indication for the product.
Verified patient eligibility restrictions.
Verified relationship between any stated procedure and its role or purpose.

skills.name: Contextual definition of a disease qualifier
skills.action: Explain a technical qualifier by stating its meaning in context and, when available, giving a qualified example of the condition or cause it refers to.

all_of: A technical qualifier in a condition name and a source-supported contextual meaning are available.
exclude_if: The proposed meaning or any included example relationship is unsupported.

preserve: Tie the explanation to the qualifier and the named condition.
Keep illustrative examples distinct from universal claims.

not_an_attempt: Repeating the qualifier without explaining its contextual meaning.
Presenting an example as a universal cause or an unqualified definition.
required_elements: Identify the qualifier being explained.
State its supplied meaning in context.
When an example is included, retain its example framing and qualification.

all_of: A technical qualifier within a condition name is mentioned.
A verified contextual definition of the qualifier is supplied.
If an example condition is included, its example relationship is supplied.
exclude_if: Only the condition or example is mentioned, with no supplied definition.
The relationship between the qualifier and the example condition is not supplied.
required_information: Verified meaning of the qualifier in the named condition.
Verified relationship and example status for any condition used as an illustration.

skills.name: Qualified causal chain of possible consequences
skills.action: Present a source-supported causal sequence from a condition to an intermediate effect and from that effect to possible consequences.

all_of: A condition-to-effect relation and an effect-to-consequence relation are supplied.
exclude_if: The source does not support one or both causal links.

preserve: Keep the two causal links distinct.
Retain the target's qualified wording, including “can cause” and “can lead to,” rather than making the outcomes certain.

not_an_attempt: Listing associated conditions or effects without expressing the supplied links.
Changing a qualified causal statement into an unconditional outcome.
required_elements: Express the supplied relation from the condition to the intermediate effect.
Express the supplied relation from the intermediate effect to one or more consequences.
Retain the source's degree of certainty for each link.

all_of: A condition and an intermediate effect are mentioned.
The supplied information verifies a causal relation from the condition to the intermediate effect.
The supplied information verifies a causal relation from the intermediate effect to one or more consequences.
Any stated uncertainty or possibility is supplied.
exclude_if: The entities are merely co-mentioned without verified causal relations.
The source does not support the stated degree of certainty.
required_information: Verified clinical-effect relations for each causal link.
Verified qualification or certainty for each link.

skills.name: Mechanism-linked closing summary with qualified effect
skills.action: Close with a concise summary that links control of a named mediator to a qualified effect on named body substances or levels.

all_of: A source-supported action on a mediator and a source-supported downstream effect are available.
exclude_if: The source does not support the mediator-to-effect relationship or the stated degree of effect.

preserve: Maintain the mediation through PTH levels.
Preserve “helps to control” as qualified wording.
Use the closing-summary position only when the surrounding report structure makes it appropriate.

not_an_attempt: Merely mentioning a product, mediator, and downstream substances without expressing their relationship.
Stating a stronger downstream effect than the source supports.
required_elements: State the supplied action on the mediator.
Connect that action to the supplied downstream effect.
Preserve the supplied qualification of the effect.

all_of: A product and a mediator are mentioned.
The supplied information verifies the product's or treatment's action on the mediator.
The supplied information verifies how that action relates to the named downstream effect.
The degree of effect, including any qualification such as “helps,” is supplied.
exclude_if: The mediator and downstream substances are only co-mentioned.
The mechanism or downstream effect is not supplied.
The wording would overstate the supplied degree of effect.
required_information: Verified mechanism connecting the product or treatment to the mediator and the downstream effect.
Verified qualification and scope of the downstream effect.

skills.name: Mechanism explained as a qualified causal sequence
skills.action: Explain a supplied medicine mechanism by linking the medicine’s interaction with a target to a downstream effect, using the source’s qualifications.

all_of: A medicine mechanism is supplied for explanation.

preserve: The stated target interaction and direction of the proposed effect.
Relevant intermediate links supplied by the source.
The degree of certainty expressed by wording such as “may.”

not_an_attempt: Listing a medicine, target, and outcome without expressing their supplied relationships.
Presenting a qualified possible effect as certain.
Adding a mechanism or effect not supplied by the source.
required_elements: State the supplied medicine–target interaction.
Link that interaction to a supplied downstream explanation or effect.
Retain the source’s degree of certainty or other qualifications.

all_of: A medicine mention and a target mention are available.
exclude_if: The source does not supply a mechanism linking the medicine, target, and stated effect.
required_information: Verified mechanism information linking the named medicine to the target, including the stated recognition or attachment and downstream effect.
The source’s qualification or uncertainty for the proposed effect.

skills.name: Purpose statement with combination and eligibility qualifications
skills.action: State a treatment purpose while integrating a supplied combination-treatment relationship and relevant eligibility or prior-treatment qualifications.

all_of: A treatment purpose is available.
Combination-treatment or eligibility details are included when supplied.

preserve: Treatment purpose rather than a different kind of benefit.
The source-supplied combination relationship.
Any stated population and prior-treatment qualifications, including what treatment the restriction concerns.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition and another medicine without stating a supplied combination relationship.
Omitting a population or prior-treatment qualification that is included in the source.
Changing the stated treatment purpose to a different benefit, such as cure or prevention.
required_elements: State the supplied treatment purpose.
When supplied, state the combination relationship and retain the relevant population and prior-treatment qualifications.

all_of: A condition mention and a treatment or medicine mention are available.
exclude_if: The source does not supply a treatment indication or does not verify the combination and eligibility relationships being expressed.
required_information: Verified indication for the product or medicine.
Verified relationship specifying whether treatment is in combination with the named medicine.
Verified eligible population and any stated prior-treatment restriction, including the treatment and timing to which that restriction applies.

skills.name: Condition explanation with grouped symptoms
skills.action: After naming a condition, provide a supplied brief characterization and organize associated symptoms into groups when the source distinguishes them, such as joint symptoms and other symptoms affecting the body.

all_of: A condition is named.
The source supplies a condition-specific characterization and/or condition-linked symptom information.

preserve: Keep the explanation and symptom statements attached to the condition they describe.
Preserve the source's distinction between joint symptoms and other symptoms affecting the entire body.
Do not turn a characterization into a stronger clinical claim.

not_an_attempt: Listing symptoms without attributing them to the named condition.
Presenting a supplied grouping as a different symptom relationship.
Adding a characterization, symptom, or grouping not supplied by the source.
required_elements: The explanatory material is connected to the named condition.
When symptom groups are presented, the symptoms are attributed to that condition and the source's distinctions between groups are retained.

all_of: A condition mention and one or more symptom or explanatory mentions are available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify the relationship between the condition and the explanatory statements or symptoms.
required_information: A supplied disease explanation and verified links between the named condition and each symptom group presented.

skills.name: Condition definition followed by symptoms
skills.action: Explain a named condition through a supplied relationship to component conditions or concepts, then give a symptom list attributed to it when symptom information is available.

all_of: A condition is named.
The source supplies an explanatory relationship between that condition and component conditions or concepts.

preserve: Preserve the specific relationship used to explain the condition, without changing it into causation or another medical claim.
Keep any following symptom list attributed to the condition and preserve its supplied content.

not_an_attempt: Listing related condition names without stating their supplied relationship to the named condition.
Listing symptoms without attributing them to the named condition.
Turning a stated combination or other relationship into a causal, diagnostic, or treatment claim.
required_elements: The named condition is explicitly explained through a relationship supplied by the source.
When a symptom list is available and presented, it follows the explanation and is attributed to the named condition.

all_of: A condition mention and mentions of its proposed explanatory components are available; symptom mentions are also required if a symptom sentence is produced.
exclude_if: The source does not verify the proposed relationship between the condition and its components.
The source does not verify any condition-to-symptom relationships that would be stated.
required_information: A supplied, verified explanation of the named condition's relationship to its components and, if symptoms are listed, verified attribution of those symptoms to the condition.

skills.name: Accessible explanation of the condition
skills.action: Follow a named condition with an accessible explanation that links it to supplied characteristics, such as duration, symptoms, or course.

all_of: A condition and a verified patient-accessible explanation of it are available.
exclude_if: The explanation or its relationship to the condition would have to be inferred from separate mentions.

preserve: Preserve the explicit link between the condition and its explanation.
Retain the target's direction and pace of change without strengthening them.
Do not require every possible explanatory detail for other conditions.

not_an_attempt: Repeating the condition name without explaining it.
Listing characteristics without relating them to the condition.
Adding explanatory details or a course of change that are not supplied.
required_elements: Name the condition.
Give an accessible explanation linked to the condition using the supplied details.

all_of: A condition is available.
A verified, patient-accessible explanation of that condition is available.
exclude_if: The explanation or its relationship to the condition would have to be inferred from separate mentions.
required_information: Verified explanation of the condition, including any duration, symptoms, or course to be stated.
Verified relationship between the condition and each explanatory detail.

skills.name: Conditional, qualified benefit wording
skills.action: Present a supplied benefit as qualified, and retain any supplied condition on use, such as regular use.

all_of: A medicine and a verified benefit are available.
exclude_if: The benefit or a condition attached to it would have to be inferred.

preserve: Retain the target's qualified “can help” framing and any supplied use condition.
Preserve the stated benefit rather than strengthening or replacing it.
Do not require discussion of cure, prevention, or alternatives.

not_an_attempt: Presenting a supplied qualified benefit as guaranteed or unconditional.
Omitting a supplied use condition attached to the benefit.
Changing the stated benefit into a stronger or different outcome.
required_elements: State the supplied benefit using its qualified degree of certainty.
Retain a supplied condition on use when one is attached to the benefit.

all_of: A medicine and a verified clinical effect are available.
Any condition on use attached to that effect is explicitly supplied.
exclude_if: The effect or its condition is inferred rather than supplied.
required_information: Verified information about the clinical effect being claimed.
Verified information about the use condition attached to the effect, such as regular use.

skills.name: Acute-use restriction with specified next steps
skills.action: State a supplied restriction on using a medicine for an acute event, then give any supplied conditional next-step and follow-up instructions.

all_of: A medicine and acute event are available with a verified use restriction.
exclude_if: The restriction or instructions would have to be inferred from mentions of symptoms or treatments.

preserve: Preserve the distinction between the medicine's stated use and relief of the specified acute event.
Retain the conditions and strength of any supplied instruction, including a stated example or follow-up step.
Do not generalize the restriction or advice to other symptoms, treatments, or circumstances.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning an acute symptom without stating the supplied restriction.
Stating a restriction while changing its scope.
Adding an alternative treatment or follow-up instruction that is not supplied.
required_elements: State the supplied restriction and its scope for the acute event.
Include supplied conditional next-step or follow-up instructions when available, preserving their conditions.

all_of: A medicine and acute event are available, with an explicit verified restriction on use for that event.
Verified instructions for the stated alternative and any follow-up condition are available.
exclude_if: The restriction or instructions are inferred from the names of symptoms or treatments.
required_information: Verified information specifying whether the medicine is or is not used for the acute event.
Verified information specifying the alternative treatment, its condition of use, and any follow-up instruction and condition.

skills.name: Connect indication and co-use, with parenthetical alternatives
skills.action: When stating an indication and co-use, lead with the treatment purpose, connect the product to the medicine used with it, and place optional regimen or formulation detail in parentheses when available.

all_of: The report is to state a product's treatment purpose and its use together with another medicine.

preserve: Do not infer indication, co-use, or formulation relationships from co-occurring entity mentions.
Preserve the stated regimen or formulation distinctions.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a product, condition, or medicines without stating the intended indication and co-use relation.
required_elements: State the treatment purpose and connect the product to the condition.
Connect the product to the medicine used with it.
Use a parenthetical for regimen or formulation detail if that detail is included.

all_of: A product mention and a condition mention are available.
A second medicine and any parenthetical alternatives or forms to be named are available when that detail is expressed.
Verified information explicitly links the product to the condition and states the co-use and any alternative/form relationship.
exclude_if: The input does not verify the indication or the stated medicine-use relationship.
required_information: Verified treatment indication for the named product.
Verified use together with the named medicine.
If naming parenthetical alternatives or forms, verified information identifying them as alternatives or forms in that relationship.

skills.name: Qualify use by the stated limitation of alternatives
skills.action: State a product-use conditionally, tying it to the stated circumstance that other medicines cannot stabilise the patient's condition.

all_of: The report is to describe a condition or restriction on when a product is used.

preserve: Keep the qualification conditional and limited to the supplied use criterion.
Do not infer the restriction from mentions of a condition or alternative medicines.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning alternative medicines without stating how their effect or limitation qualifies product use.
required_elements: State when the product is used in conditional terms.
Tie that condition to the stated limitation of other medicines and the condition they fail to stabilise.

all_of: A condition and other medicines are mentioned.
Verified information explicitly states the relevant limitation on those medicines and connects it to when the product is used.
exclude_if: The input does not verify the use restriction or the relation between the other medicines and the condition.
required_information: Verified circumstances under which the product is used, including the stated limitation of alternative medicines and the condition to which it applies.

skills.name: Present the mechanism as a linked breakdown-and-blocking sequence
skills.action: Explain a mechanism by identifying what breaks down a substance and then stating that the product blocks that agent, thereby slowing the breakdown.

all_of: The report is to explain a product mechanism involving breakdown of a substance.

preserve: Keep the causal direction and the stated relationship between blocking and slower breakdown.
Do not infer mechanism relations from co-occurring product, enzyme, and substance mentions.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a product, agent, or substance without stating the mechanism relations between them.
required_elements: Identify the agent that breaks down the substance.
State that the product blocks that agent and connect the blocking to slower breakdown.

all_of: A product and the relevant enzyme or other mechanism component are mentioned.
The relevant substance is mentioned.
Verified mechanism information supplies each breakdown, blocking, and resulting-slowing relation used.
exclude_if: The input supplies only the component mentions without verified mechanism relations.
required_information: Verified mechanism identifying what acts on what, what the product blocks, and the resulting effect on breakdown.

skills.name: Express the stated symptom benefit as qualified expectation
skills.action: Connect a stated treatment use or co-use to its supplied symptom benefit, expressing the benefit with the source's degree of qualification, such as an expected improvement rather than a certainty.

all_of: The report is to describe a treatment-related effect on a symptom or condition.

preserve: Preserve the distinction between an expected improvement and a certain outcome.
Do not infer clinical effects or co-use conditions from a mechanism or entity mentions alone.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning symptoms without connecting them to a supplied treatment effect.
Stating an unqualified or guaranteed outcome when the source qualifies it.
required_elements: State the supplied symptom or condition benefit and connect it to the relevant treatment use.
Retain the source's degree of qualification.

all_of: A condition or symptom and the relevant treatment are mentioned.
Verified information states the clinical effect and its degree of certainty.
If co-use is stated, verified information establishes that condition.
exclude_if: The input provides no verified clinical effect or does not establish the co-use condition being stated.
required_information: Verified clinical effect on the named symptom or condition, including its qualification and any verified co-use condition.

skills.name: Identity and uses together in the introduction
skills.action: In the opening, identify the product and, when available, state its active substance or medicine group and its stated uses together, preserving only source-supported relationships.

all_of: A product is to be introduced.
Relevant substance or medicine-group information and at least one use are available for the introduction.
exclude_if: The opening does not introduce the product.

preserve: The source-supported links among the product, substance or medicine group, and uses.
Any population qualification actually stated.

not_an_attempt: Naming the product and listing uses in separate, unconnected parts of the text.
Mentioning a substance or medicine group without connecting it to the product in the introductory statement.
required_elements: An opening product-identification statement.
The statement links the product to its substance or medicine group and to at least one stated use.

all_of: A product mention is available.
At least one substance or medicine-group mention is available.
At least one intended-use mention is available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify the product-to-substance or product-to-class relationship being stated.
The source does not verify the product-to-use relationship or any population qualification included.
required_information: Verified product-to-active-substance and/or product-to-medicine-group relationship, as applicable.
Verified therapeutic use for the product.
Verified population eligibility if a population is stated.

skills.name: Direct, qualified explanation of add-on use
skills.action: Explain a qualified use in patient-facing language: address the reader, state the supplied circumstance for use, and describe the supplied relationship to current or other treatment, such as add-on or combination use.

all_of: A product and a use are to be explained to the patient.
exclude_if: There is no source-supported circumstance or treatment relationship to communicate.

preserve: The direct patient-facing address.
The conditional nature of any stated prescribing circumstance.
The exact distinction among additional, combined, alternative, and stand-alone treatment when supplied.

not_an_attempt: Directly addressing the reader without explaining a use.
Mentioning another treatment without stating a source-supported relationship to the product.
required_elements: Patient-facing address in the explanation.
A source-supported circumstance or qualification for the use.
A source-supported relationship to current or other treatment when that relationship is part of the explanation.

all_of: A product and relevant condition are mentioned.
A current or other treatment is mentioned.
The source supplies a prescribing circumstance and a relationship between the product and the other treatment.
exclude_if: The source does not support the stated condition for use.
The source does not specify the prescribing condition or combination relationship being expressed.
required_information: Verified therapeutic indication and any condition under which prescribing is described.
Verified whether the product is additional to, combined with, or used instead of another treatment, and whether use alone is excluded.
Verified instructions if the wording states how the patient should take the product.

skills.name: Accessible condition explanation with acronym and examples
skills.action: Explain a condition in accessible terms by presenting its name and acronym when available, describing source-supported associated experiences, glossing technical or less familiar wording where useful, and including a supplied distinction from ordinary experience when relevant.

all_of: A condition or technical label is being explained.
Source-supported explanatory content about the condition is available.
exclude_if: There is no explanatory content to associate with the condition.

preserve: The source-supported meaning of the condition name and acronym.
The relationship between the condition and the experiences described.
Any qualifications or contrast with everyday experiences stated by the source.

not_an_attempt: Listing experiences without presenting them as related to the condition.
Giving an acronym or an everyday-life comparison that the source does not support.
required_elements: A condition label and, when available, its acronym or short form.
A source-supported explanation of associated experiences in accessible language.

all_of: A condition or technical label is available.
The source supplies an explanation of that label or associated experiences.
exclude_if: The acronym expansion, symptom relationship, or everyday-life contrast is not verified in the source.
required_information: Verified definition or expansion for any acronym used.
Verified explanation linking the listed experiences to the named condition.
Verified basis for any comparison with ordinary stresses.

skills.name: Product identity with a compact term gloss
skills.action: Introduce the product by stating supplied information about its source or composition, and give a brief parenthetical or similarly compact gloss for a technical term when a definition is available.

all_of: A product is being introduced.
Supplied information establishes at least one source or composition relationship.
exclude_if: A proposed source or ingredient relationship is not established by the supplied information.
A proposed gloss has no supplied definition.

preserve: Keep source information distinct from information about active substances or contents.
Keep any gloss faithful to the supplied definition and concise.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product and substances without stating their supplied relationship.
Adding an unsupported source, ingredient relationship, or definition.
required_elements: Identify the product and state at least one supplied source or composition relationship.
If a technical term is glossed, give its supplied definition compactly.

all_of: A product mention and source information establishing the product's composition or source.
A technical term with a supplied definition if a gloss is included.
exclude_if: Ingredient or source relationships are not verified in the supplied information.
A proposed gloss has no supplied definition.
required_information: Verified information identifying which substances are product ingredients and whether a material is the product's source.
A verified definition for each technical term that is to be glossed.

skills.name: Purpose linked to condition and cause
skills.action: State a product’s supplied purpose in terms of an outcome, connecting it to any supplied qualifying condition or cause and preserving any population qualification.

all_of: A product and a therapeutic purpose are supplied.
exclude_if: The supplied information does not establish the product’s purpose or a relationship being stated.

preserve: Distinguish prevention from stopping an event.
Preserve supplied cause-condition relationships and population qualifications without adding them.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition or outcome without stating the product’s purpose.
Changing prevention into stopping an event, or vice versa.
Adding a cause, condition, or population qualification that is not supplied.
required_elements: State the supplied purpose and outcome.
Connect any included condition or cause to the purpose as supplied.
Retain any population qualification that is included.

all_of: A product mention and supplied information stating its therapeutic purpose.
If a condition, cause, or population is named, verified information linking it to the purpose and establishing the applicable population.
exclude_if: The source provides only condition or symptom mentions without a verified indication.
The source does not verify a stated cause-condition relationship or population qualification.
required_information: Verified indication and outcome, including whether use is preventive or intended to stop an event.
Verified relationships between the indication, any stated cause or condition, and the product.
Verified eligibility information for any stated population.

skills.name: Conditional restriction involving an alternative medicine
skills.action: Qualify a product’s use with a condition involving another medicine, stating the supplied circumstance or circumstances under which the product is used.

all_of: A product and another medicine are relevant to the supplied use information.
exclude_if: The supplied information only co-mentions the medicines without establishing a conditional-use relationship.

preserve: Retain the conditional nature of the restriction.
Keep distinct the stated alternatives of ineffectiveness alone and inability to give the other medicine.

not_an_attempt: Simply listing another medicine alongside the product.
Turning a conditional restriction into an unconditional recommendation or preference.
Adding a treatment relationship or circumstance that is not supplied.
required_elements: State the supplied condition on use in relation to the other medicine.
Preserve the stated circumstance or circumstances and their logical relationship.

all_of: A product mention and a mention of another medicine.
Verified information explicitly stating the condition under which the product is used in relation to that medicine.
exclude_if: The input only co-mentions medicines without a verified treatment relationship.
The effectiveness or inability-to-use condition is absent or unspecified.
required_information: The verified relationship between the product and the other medicine, including whether use is conditional, alternative, prior, or concurrent.
Verified effectiveness and/or administration information supporting each stated condition.

skills.name: Accessible, qualified mechanism explanation
skills.action: Explain a supplied medical mechanism through linked, accessible statements—for example, a factor’s role in a process, the consequence of a shortage, and a qualified effect of replacement, when those details are available.

all_of: A relevant medical process, factor, or treatment is being explained.
Supplied information establishes at least one relationship that can be explained.
exclude_if: The input only co-mentions factors, processes, conditions, or treatments without supplying the relationship to be stated.

preserve: Keep the stated direction of causal or explanatory links.
Preserve any stated consequence of a shortage and any qualification of a treatment effect.
Do not imply that a temporary effect is permanent or curative.

not_an_attempt: Listing factors and process terms without explaining a supplied relationship between them.
Adding a deficiency consequence or treatment effect that is not supplied.
Changing a qualified or temporary effect into an unqualified, permanent effect or cure.

exclude_if: The source does not supply or verify the term-to-gloss relationship.
required_information: A verified definition or equivalent wording for the technical term.

skills.name: Qualified and grouped use statement
skills.action: Present supplied treatment uses with their stated population and scope, grouping related conditions in a list when appropriate and adding any further use with its stated relationships and qualifications.

all_of: A medicine or product has one or more supplied treatment indications.
exclude_if: Condition mentions are supplied without a stated relationship to the medicine's use.

preserve: The adult restriction and “certain serious” scope when supplied.
The distinction between the listed infections and the further blood-infection use.
The stated association with infections mentioned above and the modal qualification “may not be able to kill.”

not_an_attempt: Listing conditions without presenting them as supplied treatment uses.
Omitting qualifications that the source includes for a use.
required_elements: State the supplied treatment use and any population or scope restriction included with it.
When the source groups conditions, present them as a grouped list or equivalent.
When an additional use or qualification is supplied, retain its stated relationship and qualification.

all_of: A medicine or product mention and condition mentions explicitly related to its use.
Any population restriction and additional qualifications used in the statement are explicitly supplied.
exclude_if: Condition mentions are present without verified treatment-indication relationships.
The stated population, associations, or qualifications are not verified.
required_information: Verified indications and their relationship to the medicine.
Verified eligible population and severity restrictions.
Verified relationships among the listed infections and any additional use.
Verified meaning and scope of the qualification concerning other antibiotics.

skills.name: Product identity through a contained medicine
skills.action: Introduces a product by stating that it contains a medicine and naming that medicine.

all_of: A product and a medicine or substance can be named.
The passage is introducing the product or identifying its medicine.
exclude_if: The source does not verify that the named medicine or substance is contained in the product.

preserve: The explicit contains relationship.
The distinction between the product name and the name of the medicine it contains.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product and medicine without relating them.
Listing a medicine without stating that the product contains it.
required_elements: Name the product.
State that it contains a medicine or substance.
Name that medicine or substance.

all_of: A product mention and a medicine or substance mention are available.
Verified information explicitly links the product to the medicine or substance as something it contains.
exclude_if: The source does not verify that the named medicine or substance is contained in the product.
required_information: The verified product-to-ingredient relationship.

skills.name: Broad purpose followed by separated use situations
skills.action: Frames a treatment purpose broadly, then presents distinct use situations separately in a bullet-like structure, keeping conditions and any stated populations attached to their respective situations.

all_of: A product or treatment purpose is being described.
At least two distinct use situations are available to present separately.
exclude_if: The source does not support treating the available situations as distinct uses.

preserve: The separation between the broad purpose statement and the specific use situations.
The association of each supplied condition and population with its corresponding use situation.
The source's scope and qualifications; do not imply that the examples exhaust all possible uses.

not_an_attempt: Listing conditions without framing them as uses of the product.
Combining distinct use situations in a way that obscures which conditions or populations belong to each.
required_elements: Give a broad treatment-purpose framing.
Present distinct use situations separately.
Keep supplied qualifying conditions and populations associated with the relevant situation.

all_of: A product mention and at least two distinct candidate use situations are available.
Verified information establishes the product's indication and the conditions and populations belonging to each use situation.
exclude_if: The conditions or populations are merely mentioned without verified indication and eligibility relationships.
The source does not support separating the material into distinct use situations.
required_information: The verified therapeutic indication for the product.
The verified condition and eligible population for each use situation.

skills.name: Sequenced treatment stages with parenthetical phase labels
skills.action: Describes treatment stages in sequence, distinguishes use together with another treatment from use alone when applicable, and places supplied phase labels parenthetically next to the stages they label.

all_of: A treatment sequence is being described.
exclude_if: The source does not establish an order for the stages being described.

preserve: The stated order, including “first” and “after that” where appropriate.
The distinction between combined use and use alone.
The phase labels and their parenthetical placement without inventing definitions or meanings.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning treatments or phase labels without expressing a sequence.
Presenting the sequence as unconditional when the source qualifies it.
required_elements: State the supplied order of the treatment stages.
Preserve whether treatment is combined with another treatment or used alone at each stage, when supplied.

all_of: A medicine and treatment-stage mentions are available.
Verified information supplies the order and combination status of the stages.
Any phase labels used are supported by supplied definitions or verified terminology.
exclude_if: The source does not establish the treatment sequence or whether stages are combined or used alone.
The source does not supply the meaning of a phase label used in the text.
required_information: The verified order of treatment stages.
Whether the medicine is used with another treatment or alone at each stage.
The verified meaning of each parenthetical phase label.

skills.name: Use qualified by disease course and prior treatment
skills.action: Qualifies a use situation by stating the disease-course and prior-treatment circumstances under which it applies.

all_of: A use situation is being described.
A disease-course or prior-treatment qualification is available.
exclude_if: The source does not link the qualification to the use situation.

preserve: The conditional relationship to use.
The distinction between tumours returning and getting worse.
The reference to prior standard treatment and the source's degree of qualification.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning recurrence, worsening, or prior treatment without linking it to the use situation.
Omitting a supplied disease-course or prior-treatment qualification.
required_elements: State the supplied disease-course condition.
State the relevant prior-treatment qualification, when supplied.
Link those circumstances to the use situation.

all_of: A product and condition-specific use situation are available.
Verified information explicitly links a disease-course qualification and prior-treatment history to that use.
exclude_if: The source only mentions the condition or prior treatment without establishing the qualification for use.
required_information: The verified condition under which the product is used.
The verified relationship between recurrence or worsening, prior treatment, and eligibility for that use.

skills.name: Identity-to-purpose information order
skills.action: Organize available information in the observed progression: product identity, explanation of action and any stated condition on working, then treatment purpose and any supplied explanation of the condition.

all_of: There is appropriate supplied content for at least two of the information types in the observed sequence.
exclude_if: There is no orderable content from the relevant information types.

preserve: Treat this as a provisional ordering choice, not a universal leaflet requirement.
Do not require inclusion of every information type when it is unavailable.
Preserve the target’s progression from identity/action and qualified use to purpose and condition explanation when those items are included.

not_an_attempt: Treating headings alone as evidence that the body follows this sequence.
Claiming the sequence is mandatory for all leaflets.
Reordering material without following the relative order of the available information types.
required_elements: Put at least two available information types in the observed relative order: identity; action or condition on working; treatment purpose; condition explanation.

all_of: The input supplies content for product identity, action or use condition, and treatment purpose; a condition explanation is supplied if that final element is included.
exclude_if: The input lacks one or more of the content types needed for the sequence.
required_information: Supplied identity information and, when used, verified action, use-condition, treatment-purpose, and condition-explanation content.

skills.name: Opening with a product effect
skills.action: When product-specific effect or purpose information is available, open with a brief statement of what the product does before moving to administration or indications. Preserve the source’s degree of qualification.

all_of: A product is being described.
Product-specific effect or purpose information is available.

preserve: Retain qualifiers such as “helps to”; do not make the effect more certain than the source.
Do not add a mechanism or effect not supplied.

not_an_attempt: Naming the product without stating an effect or purpose.
Stating an effect or purpose without placing it in the opening before later administration or indication information.
required_elements: An opening statement names the product and states its supplied effect or purpose.
The statement precedes later administration or indication information when those sections are included.

all_of: A product mention is available.
Verified product-specific information states an effect or purpose.
exclude_if: No verified product-specific effect or purpose is supplied.
required_information: The verified effect or purpose attributable to the product, including any qualification such as “helps to.”

skills.name: Combining administration details in one sentence
skills.action: Group available administration details in a concise, patient-facing sentence, using direct address where appropriate. Include only details and relationships supplied for the product.

all_of: A product’s administration is being described.
At least two related administration details are available to present together.

preserve: Keep the stated administration details and their relationships accurate.
Do not infer provider, route, setting, or administration form from isolated mentions.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning administration details in separate, unrelated statements without grouping them.
Listing administration terms without expressing how the supplied details relate to the product.
required_elements: One sentence groups at least two supplied, related administration details about the product’s administration.
The sentence uses patient-facing language where appropriate and does not add unsupported details.

all_of: A product mention is available.
Verified administration information is available for that product.
exclude_if: The supplied information does not verify the administration form, route, provider, or setting included in the proposed sentence.
required_information: Which provider gives the product, its administration form and route, and the setting, to the extent each is included in the sentence.

skills.name: Making a condition-specific combination explicit
skills.action: State a supplied combination with the other medicine named explicitly; include the treatment context when supplied. A phrase such as “another medicine called [name]” can introduce that medicine to the reader.

all_of: A product and another medicine are being discussed together.
The source supplies a combination relationship between them.

preserve: Name the other medicine accurately.
Do not infer combination therapy or a condition-specific combination from co-occurrence.

not_an_attempt: Merely co-mentioning a product and another medicine.
Naming another medicine without stating the supplied combination relationship.
required_elements: The statement explicitly says the product is combined with the supplied other medicine.
Any included condition or treatment context is the one supplied for that combination.

all_of: A product mention and another medicine mention are available.
Verified information states that the product is combined with the other medicine.
A condition-specific context is included only if that relationship is verified.
exclude_if: The source merely co-mentions the product, another medicine, or a condition without verifying the combination and any stated condition-specific link.
required_information: The verified combination relationship between the product and the named medicine, and the verified treatment context for the combination if one is stated.

skills.name: Explicit, logically structured use restrictions
skills.action: Present source-supplied restrictions on use as conditions, preserving whether they are alternatives, cumulative requirements, or a combination.

all_of: The source supplies one or more conditions that restrict use of a medicine.

preserve: The distinction between the alternative circumstances and the additional absence-of-options requirement in the target.
The conditional force and logical relationships of any criteria used in generation.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning circumstances or treatment options without presenting them as restrictions on use.
Presenting conditions without preserving their stated logical relationship.
required_elements: A statement that source-supplied criteria qualify use.
Wording that preserves the criteria's stated alternative or cumulative structure.

all_of: A product mention and at least one use-restriction detail are available.
The source explicitly states that the details are conditions for use of the product.
The source specifies whether the conditions are alternatives, cumulative requirements, or a combination.
exclude_if: The input mentions possible restrictions but does not relate them to product use or specify their logical relationship.
required_information: Verified product-to-restriction relationship.
The complete set of applicable conditions and whether they are alternatives or cumulative.

skills.name: Accessible causal explanation of mechanism
skills.action: Explain a supplied mechanism through a readable sequence of stated relationships, framing technical terms with a plain-language description or identifying phrase when the source provides one.

all_of: The source supplies mechanism information that can be expressed as a relationship or sequence.

preserve: The stated causal sequence and its qualifications, including possibility rather than certainty.
The distinction between a technical term and the plain-language description supplied for it.
Do not turn a possible effect into a guaranteed outcome.

not_an_attempt: Inferring a mechanism or causal link from entity mentions alone.
Adding a term definition or causal relationship not supplied by the source.
required_elements: At least one source-supplied mechanism relationship expressed intelligibly.
Any technical-term explanation included must be source-supported.

all_of: A product mention and relevant mechanism entities are available.
The source explicitly supplies the mechanism and the relationships among its steps.
If technical terminology is glossed, the source supplies its definition.
exclude_if: Only the relevant entities are mentioned, with no supplied mechanism or causal relationship.
A technical term would need a definition that is absent from the source.
required_information: Verified mechanism of action, including the stated relationships between the medicine, any target, and any resulting effects.
A verified definition for each technical term that is explained.

skills.name: Progression from use information to explanation
skills.action: When use information and mechanism information are both available, present the use information first and the mechanism explanation separately afterward; place any supplied eligibility or checking details with the use information, and use a patient-directed closing after the explanation when available.

all_of: There is suitable supplied content for an ordered presentation of medicine-use information and mechanism information.

preserve: The separation and sequence of the use and mechanism sections.
The target's placement of its pre-treatment test with the use information.
The patient-directed nature and closing position of the final instruction, when used.
Do not require the target's specific headings or every section component.

not_an_attempt: Copying the target's exact headings or requiring every stage in all reports.
Claiming an ordering pattern when only one relevant content block is available.
required_elements: When both content blocks are supplied, a discernible presentation of use information before mechanism information.
When a patient-directed close is supplied, placing it after the explanation.

all_of: A product-use description and a mechanism explanation are both supplied.
Any eligibility or checking detail placed in the use portion is explicitly supplied as such.
exclude_if: The input lacks either use information or a mechanism explanation, or combining them would misrepresent the supplied relationships.
required_information: Verified product indication and any supplied eligibility or pre-treatment checking details.
Verified mechanism of action.

skills.name: Indication followed by an accessible condition description and qualified-use context
skills.action: State the supplied treatment indication and population qualification, then give a brief accessible description of the condition when available; add supplied co-treatment and control qualifications when available.

all_of: A product-to-indication relationship is supplied.
exclude_if: The source does not support a relationship the proposed wording would assert.

preserve: Keep treatment purpose distinct from prevention or other purposes.
Retain stated population limits and the exact conditions on use with other medicines.
Keep a condition description faithful to the supplied definition.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition without stating the supplied treatment purpose.
Adding a population, condition description, or treatment-use qualification that the source does not supply.
required_elements: State the supplied treatment indication.
Retain any supplied population qualification.
Include a supplied accessible condition description or use qualification when presenting that content.

all_of: A product mention and a condition mention are available.
If defining the condition, a supplied definition is available.
If describing adjunct use, mentions of the other treatment(s) and the relevant control condition are available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify that the product is used to treat the condition.
The source does not verify any stated population restriction or combination-use qualification.
A condition explanation is attempted but no definition is supplied.
required_information: Verified product-to-indication relationship and whether the use is treatment, prevention, or another purpose.
Verified population eligibility, if stated.
For any condition description, a supplied definition of that condition.
For adjunct-use wording, verified combination-therapy relationship and the exact qualifying condition, such as whether other treatment alone provides adequate control.

skills.name: Progressive section order from identity to potential benefits
skills.action: When multiple relevant content types are available, order them as a patient-facing progression from product identity to purpose, mechanism, and potential benefits, omitting unavailable sections while retaining the relative order of those included.

all_of: At least two of product identity, purpose, mechanism, and potential-benefit content are available.
exclude_if: The proposed ordering would require a section for which no content is available.

preserve: Keep identity, purpose, mechanism, and benefits distinct where included.
Preserve their relative progression without requiring all four sections or any fixed length.

not_an_attempt: Using headings without arranging the relevant content in the stated progression.
Requiring every content type to be present.
required_elements: Place at least two available content types in the observed relative order: identity, purpose, mechanism, potential benefits.

all_of: Source material is available for at least two of the identity, purpose, mechanism, and potential-benefit content types.
exclude_if: The source does not contain distinct content for a proposed section in the sequence.
required_information: No external medical information is needed for ordering supplied content; any factual content placed in the sections must have its own source support.

skills.name: Qualified potential benefits and conditional co-medication outcomes
skills.action: Present supplied potential benefits with their stated degree of certainty, grouping related outcomes when appropriate; frame a co-medication change conditionally on the supplied circumstance, such as the reader already taking that medicine.

all_of: A product-to-outcome relationship and its stated degree of certainty are supplied.
exclude_if: The source does not support an outcome, its modality, or a condition the proposed wording would assert.

preserve: Retain modal wording such as “may” without strengthening or weakening the stated certainty.
Keep conditional outcomes tied to their stated circumstance and retain reader address when used.
Preserve the stated distinction between dose reduction and stopping, if both are supplied.

not_an_attempt: Presenting a possible outcome as guaranteed.
Turning a conditional medicine change into universal advice or an instruction.
Adding an outcome or condition not supplied by the source.
required_elements: Preserve the supplied outcome and its degree of certainty.
Preserve any supplied condition on a co-medication outcome.

all_of: A product mention and at least one potential-outcome mention are available.
For a conditional co-medication outcome, the relevant treatment mention and condition are available.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly supply the product-to-outcome relationship and its degree of certainty.
A co-medication outcome is stated without verified conditional context.
required_information: Verified clinical effects, including their modality and whether they concern symptom relief, event reduction, or another outcome.
For any co-medication outcome, verified combination-therapy information specifying the relevant medicine and the condition under which the outcome may occur.
For any dose-change claim, the exact supplied change and its unit or schedule, if specified.

skills.name: Scannable uses with purpose distinctions
skills.action: When multiple distinct uses are available, present them as separate, scannable bullets, optionally under a population introduction; preserve distinctions such as prevention versus treatment and include supplied eligibility qualifications.

all_of: Multiple distinct use statements are available for presentation as separate items.
exclude_if: The source does not establish the product-to-use relationships.

preserve: Keep prevention distinct from treatment and recurrence prevention.
Retain population and eligibility qualifiers when supplied.
Do not require a fixed number or type of indications beyond the distinct uses available.

not_an_attempt: Presenting unrelated condition mentions as product indications.
Combining distinct uses so that prevention and treatment distinctions are lost.
Omitting an eligibility qualification that the source states.
required_elements: Separate presentation of the supplied distinct uses.
Preservation of each use's stated purpose and any stated eligibility qualification.

all_of: A product or medicine mention is available.
At least two distinct use statements are supplied, or one use has multiple purposes that need distinction.
The source explicitly states the product-use relation and any population or eligibility qualification.
exclude_if: Only conditions, procedures, or age mentions are available without explicit product-use and eligibility relations.
required_information: Verified product-to-indication relationships, each use's prevention or treatment purpose, and any stated population restriction or additional eligibility condition.

skills.name: Qualified second-person risk description
skills.action: In a patient-facing risk or symptom explanation, address the reader directly where appropriate and retain the source's qualifications, including possible outcomes and symptom alternatives.

all_of: A patient-facing risk or symptom explanation is available.
exclude_if: The source does not provide the risk or symptom relationship being described.

preserve: Keep reader address and uncertainty faithful to the source.
Do not generalize a specific risk or symptom relationship beyond the supplied context.

not_an_attempt: Using second-person address without a suitable patient-facing context.
Turning a qualified possibility into a certainty.
Removing a stated symptom alternative or other qualification.
required_elements: A patient-directed reference where used in the source pattern.
Retention of the source's degree of uncertainty and any stated alternatives.

all_of: A patient-facing risk or symptom statement is supplied.
The source explicitly states the relevant population and qualifies the risk or effects.
exclude_if: The input only co-lists a procedure, symptom, or anatomical site without explicitly stating the risk or effect relationship.
required_information: Verified information specifying who is at risk, the stated risk or effect relationship, and any uncertainty or symptom alternatives that must be retained.

skills.name: Progression followed by seriousness or urgency
skills.action: Describe a source-supported progression by connecting an event to its possible consequences; follow it with a supplied seriousness or urgency statement when available.

all_of: The source explicitly links an event to one or more consequences.
exclude_if: The source only co-lists an event, symptoms, condition, or anatomy without stating a progression or causal link.

preserve: Retain the source's causal sequence and degree of certainty.
Preserve any stated seriousness or urgency without strengthening it.

not_an_attempt: Listing an event and consequences without a source-supported progression link.
Presenting a possible outcome as certain.
Adding a seriousness label or urgency instruction not supplied by the source.
required_elements: A linked event-to-consequence progression.
Preservation of possibility wording where the source qualifies the outcome.

all_of: The source explicitly links an event to one or more consequences.
A seriousness or urgency statement is supplied if the output includes one.
exclude_if: The input provides only event, symptom, condition, or anatomy mentions without an explicit progression or urgency statement.
required_information: Verified explanation of the event-to-consequence relationship and any source-provided seriousness or urgency wording.

skills.name: Direct treatment-purpose statement
skills.action: State a medicine's treatment purpose with a direct phrase such as “is used to treat,” linking the product to a named condition.

all_of: The source supplies a product and a condition.
exclude_if: The source does not state a treatment-purpose relationship between them.

preserve: The target's treatment wording and the indication's stated scope.
Any qualifications supplied with the indication; do not turn treatment into a different purpose.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a medicine and condition without stating their treatment relationship.
required_elements: Name the product and condition.
State the supplied treatment-purpose relationship.

all_of: A product and a condition are mentioned.
A verified treatment indication relating that product to that condition is supplied.
exclude_if: The source mentions a condition but does not state that the product is used to treat it.
The source's stated purpose is prevention, symptom relief, or another purpose rather than treatment.
required_information: Verified indication linking the product to the condition.
Any population or purpose qualifications attached to that indication.

skills.name: Progression from identity to explanation
skills.action: When the relevant content is available, progress from medicine identity and classification to treatment purpose, then disease explanation and course or impact, and finally mechanism.

all_of: The source supplies content for at least two of these topics: medicine identity or classification, treatment purpose, disease explanation or course, and mechanism.
exclude_if: There is no supplied content from these topics to arrange.

preserve: The observed progression from identity/classification, through purpose and disease information, to mechanism.
Optional topics remain optional when available; ordering does not establish clinical relationships.

not_an_attempt: Presenting topics in a different sequence without the described progression.
required_elements: Order the supplied topics consistently with the target's progression, without requiring every topic to be present.
Keep each supplied clinical relationship explicit rather than implying it through order.

all_of: The source supplies information for at least two of these topics: medicine identity, treatment purpose, disease explanation, mechanism.
exclude_if: A topic's necessary relationship is absent from the source; do not infer it from sequence or co-occurrence.
required_information: For each included topic, the verified information needed to state it: product–substance and substance–group relationships, indication, disease explanation, or mechanism, as applicable.

skills.name: Follow identity with a medicine-group label
skills.action: After introducing active substances, follow with a concise shared medicine-group label when a source-supported classification is available.

all_of: Medicine or active-substance information is being presented.
The source identifies a group to which the relevant medicine(s) belong.
exclude_if: No source-supported group classification is available.

preserve: The relationship between the medicines and the stated group.
The source's scope of group membership.

not_an_attempt: Assigning a medicine to a group based only on co-occurring medicine names.
required_elements: State a source-supported medicine-group label.
Connect the label to the relevant medicine(s).

all_of: Medicine or substance mentions are available.
The source explicitly assigns the relevant medicine(s) to the stated shared group.
exclude_if: The source provides no verified medicine-group relationship.
required_information: Verified information identifying the medicine group and which medicine(s) belong to it.

skills.name: Combine route and purpose
skills.action: Combine a medicine's route of administration and treatment purpose in one concise patient-facing sentence when both are available.

all_of: A medicine is being described.
A source-supported route and treatment purpose are available for that medicine.
exclude_if: Either the route or the treatment purpose is unavailable.

preserve: The stated route and its relationship to the medicine.
The stated treatment purpose without extending the indication.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a route and condition separately without linking both to the medicine.
required_elements: State the route as applying to the medicine.
State the treatment purpose as applying to the medicine.
Present both links together in a concise sentence.

all_of: A medicine mention, a route mention, and a condition mention are available.
The source explicitly links the route to the medicine and the therapeutic indication to the medicine.
exclude_if: Either route or indication is absent, or either relationship to the medicine is not explicitly supplied.
required_information: Verified administration route for the medicine and verified therapeutic indication for the medicine.

skills.name: Explain the condition through a reader-facing bodily description
skills.action: Explain a condition in reader-addressed, accessible language by conditionally describing a relevant bodily process; state a consequence separately when available.

all_of: A condition is being explained.
The source supplies a condition-related bodily process that can be described for the reader.
exclude_if: The source supplies only a condition label, with no supported explanatory process.

preserve: The conditional framing about having the condition.
The alternatives concerning insufficient insulin production or difficulty using produced insulin.

not_an_attempt: Listing anatomy or substances without explaining a source-supported process.
Stating a disease mechanism based only on entity mentions.
required_elements: Use reader-addressed language where appropriate.
Describe a source-supported bodily process in relation to the condition.

all_of: A condition mention and relevant body-part, substance, or measurement mentions are available.
The source supplies an explanation linking the relevant process to the condition or its consequence.
exclude_if: The source provides only condition or anatomy mentions without a verified explanation of their relationship.
required_information: Verified disease-specific explanation of the bodily process and the stated consequence.

skills.name: Describe medicine action through its supplied mechanism
skills.action: Explain a medicine's stated outcome with a brief source-supported mechanism, preserving alternative pathways when the source presents them.

all_of: A medicine or treatment is being described.
The source provides an outcome and a mechanism for that medicine or treatment.
exclude_if: The source provides neither a supported outcome nor a mechanism.

preserve: The outcome of lowering blood sugar.
The causal explanation and the two alternative pathways.

not_an_attempt: Inferring an effect or mechanism from medicine names or co-occurring entities alone.
Replacing source-stated alternatives with one pathway.
required_elements: State the source-supported outcome.
Explain it using the source-supported mechanism.
Retain alternatives as alternatives when present.

all_of: Medicine, outcome, and relevant body-site or substance mentions are available.
The source explicitly links the medicine to the stated outcome and supplies the mechanism or alternative pathways.
exclude_if: The source does not supply the medicine-to-outcome relationship or the mechanism.
required_information: Verified clinical effect and mechanism of action for the medicine, including whether any stated pathways are alternatives.

skills.name: Product identity introduced through class and substance
skills.action: Introduce a product by pairing its name with a medicine-class description and a named substance in a compact identity statement.

all_of: A product name is available.
Verified source information links the product to a medicine class and a named substance.

preserve: The identity-first construction.
The distinctions between the product name, class description and named substance.
The source's exact relationship among them; do not imply ingredient status unless supplied.

not_an_attempt: Naming the product without linking it to the class or substance.
Listing a class and substance without linking them to the product.
required_elements: A product name.
A class description and named substance linked to that product.
A compact introductory statement presenting those details together.

all_of: A product name, a medicine-class description, and a substance name are available.
Verified information links the product to both the class description and the named substance.
required_information: Which named substance is the product's active ingredient or otherwise correctly linked substance.
The verified medicine-class description applicable to the product.

skills.name: Qualified dosing-time flexibility
skills.action: State a dosing frequency, then describe any qualified timing flexibility and its stated rationale.

all_of: Verified dosing information is available for the product.

preserve: The order of frequency followed by timing flexibility.
The stated conditions and limits on changing timing.
The source's rationale and any cross-reference when included; do not strengthen or generalize the permission.

not_an_attempt: Presenting a number as a dosing frequency when the source does not identify it as such.
Stating only a frequency without describing any supplied timing exception as part of this pattern.
Describing timing flexibility as unrestricted when the source limits it.
required_elements: A source-specified dosing frequency.
A source-specified timing exception or flexibility, with its limits retained.

all_of: A product is mentioned.
Verified administration information supplies a dosing frequency and any permitted timing variation.
If a reason for timing flexibility is stated, verified information supplies that reason.
required_information: The verified dosing frequency and what the number measures.
The exact conditions and limits for any timing change.
The verified mechanism or other stated rationale for the timing flexibility.

skills.name: Patient-group-specific combination qualifications
skills.action: Organize combination-use information by patient group when available, preserving each group's options, exclusions and degree of qualification.

all_of: Verified combination-use information for the product is available.

preserve: The distinction between “may” and “must always.”
Which options or requirement apply to each group.
The explicit insulin exclusion where stated.
The target's progression from a general combination statement to group-specific details.

not_an_attempt: Listing co-treatments without stating their applicable patient group when group-specific information is supplied.
Flattening distinct source qualifications, such as permissive and required use, into the same strength.
Omitting a stated exclusion from a combination option.
required_elements: The supplied combination-use relationship or relationships.
Patient-group distinctions when supplied.
The source's qualifications and any stated exclusions.

all_of: A product, patient-group or condition mentions, and co-treatment mentions are available.
