skills.name: Purpose with use and population qualifications
skills.action: State that a product is used to treat a named condition, adding treatment-mode and population qualifications when available.

all_of: A source supplies a product-to-treatment indication relationship.
exclude_if: No treatment indication for the product is supplied.

preserve: Retain the treatment purpose without changing it to prevention, symptom relief, or cure.
Preserve any stated treatment-mode and population qualifications without broadening them.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a product and condition without stating a treatment relationship.
required_elements: A statement that the product is used to treat the named condition.

all_of: A product-name mention, a condition mention, and a treatment-use mention are available.
exclude_if: The product’s indication, population eligibility, or monotherapy status is not explicitly supplied for any such claim.
required_information: Verified information linking the product to treatment of the named condition.
Verified information specifying the eligible population.
Verified information establishing monotherapy or another treatment-combination status.

skills.name: Link a qualified effect to its mechanism
skills.action: Explain a stated effect by giving a source-supplied mechanism, using an accessible causal construction.

all_of: A product and an outcome can be referred to in the description.

preserve: The effect’s degree of qualification, including “helps.”
The direction and extent of the effect, including “towards a normal level.”
The source’s causal link between effect and mechanism; do not strengthen it into a guarantee.

not_an_attempt: Stating an effect without explaining it through a mechanism.
Inferring an effect or mechanism from product or entity mentions alone.
required_elements: A stated effect.
A mechanism explicitly presented as explaining that effect.

all_of: A product mention and an outcome mention are available.
A source-supplied mechanism is available.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly link the product to the stated effect and mechanism.
The effect or mechanism would have to be inferred from entity co-occurrence.
required_information: Verified information stating the product’s relevant effect, its degree of qualification, and the mechanism explicitly offered to explain that effect.

skills.name: Use second person for the reader’s outcome
skills.action: Address the reader in second person when referring to a patient-relevant outcome or body measure.

all_of: A patient-relevant outcome or body measure is available to refer to.

preserve: The reader-directed form of address.
The source’s stated outcome and its qualifications; second-person wording does not itself establish a clinical effect.

not_an_attempt: Using second person without applying it to a patient-relevant outcome or body measure.
Adding a personal effect not stated in the source.
required_elements: A patient-relevant outcome or body measure.
A second-person reference to that outcome or measure.

all_of: A patient-relevant outcome or body measure is mentioned in the source wording.
exclude_if: No patient-relevant outcome is supplied.
Second-person wording would introduce an unsupported personal effect.
required_information: Source wording identifying the outcome to which the second-person reference will apply.

skills.name: Accessible class explanation
skills.action: Explain a medicine-class term with a brief, accessible statement of what members of that class are used for.

all_of: A medicine class or other term is supplied along with an explanation explicitly linked to it.

preserve: The source's stated meaning and degree of qualification.
The connection between the explanation and the term.

not_an_attempt: Merely naming a medicine class.
Stating a function without linking it to the term being explained.
required_elements: Name the term or class.
Connect it to a brief, accessible description or use.

all_of: A medicine class or technical term is mentioned.
A definition or description of use is supplied and explicitly linked to that term.
required_information: A verified definition or description of use for the named class or term, including the relationship between the class and the stated use.

skills.name: Accessible mechanism followed by an example
skills.action: Explains a medicine’s stated action in accessible terms and, when the source makes the link, names an example within the broader target group.

all_of: A medicine and a source-stated action are available.
exclude_if: The source supplies only medicine or condition mentions and no action to explain.

preserve: Retain the target’s stated action and scope without strengthening them.
Keep any example within the relationship and group stated by the source.

not_an_attempt: Naming a condition or virus without explaining a source-stated action.
Inferring an action or an example-to-group relationship from co-occurring mentions.
required_elements: Express the source-stated action in accessible terms.
If an example is included, relate it to the broader group only as the source does.

all_of: The source supplies a medicine mechanism in patient-understandable terms.
If an example is named, the source explicitly relates it to the broader group.
exclude_if: The source provides only medicine and condition mentions, without a mechanism.
required_information: Verified mechanism of action and, when an example is included, verified information that the example belongs to the stated target group.

skills.name: Explicit and bounded use qualifications
skills.action: States an explicit restriction on use, then separately presents any source-stated safety or efficacy information gap for other treatments or forms without turning that gap into a clinical conclusion.

all_of: The source states a restriction on use or a required co-use relationship.
exclude_if: The source merely co-mentions treatments without stating a restriction.
The source does not state an information gap that would be reported.

preserve: Keep a restriction distinct from an information gap.
Preserve the limited claim that information is absent; do not recast it as evidence of harm, lack of efficacy, or a prohibition.

not_an_attempt: Inferring required co-use from mentions of multiple medicines.
Presenting absent safety or efficacy information as proof of harm, ineffectiveness, or prohibition.
required_elements: State a use restriction only when the source explicitly supplies it.
When the source also supplies an information-gap statement, distinguish it from the restriction and retain its stated scope.

all_of: The source explicitly states a use restriction or required treatment combination.
For an information-gap statement, the source explicitly identifies what information is absent and the treatments or forms it concerns.
exclude_if: The source merely co-mentions treatments.
The source gives no explicit evidence limitation but the target would imply one.
required_information: Verified details of any required co-use or restriction on use alone.
For an information-gap statement, verified scope and wording of the absent safety or efficacy information.

skills.name: Parenthetical explanation of a patient term
skills.action: Pairs a technical patient label with a plain-language explanation in parentheses.

all_of: The source provides a technical patient label and its intended plain-language equivalent.
exclude_if: The source does not supply the gloss or the gloss would add an unsupported population restriction.

preserve: Keep the gloss equivalent in meaning to the technical term.
Retain any population restrictions stated by the source.

not_an_attempt: Adding parenthetical text that does not explain the technical label.
Supplying a definition not established by the source.
required_elements: Use the source-supplied technical patient label.
Give its source-supplied plain-language equivalent in parentheses.

all_of: The source provides a technical patient term and its intended plain-language equivalent.
exclude_if: The source does not define the term or the proposed gloss would add a population restriction.
required_information: Verified definition of the technical patient term, including the population it denotes.

skills.name: Mechanism explained through a causal sequence
skills.action: Explain a mechanism in a linked sequence, moving from receptor location or selectivity to receptor blocking and the resulting tissue response.

all_of: Relevant receptor, anatomical-site, and tissue-response content is available.

preserve: The distinction between receptor location or selectivity, receptor blocking, and the resulting tissue response.
The causal link and the response as stated in the supplied information.

not_an_attempt: Listing anatomical sites and a tissue response without connecting them to receptor action.
Mentioning receptor blocking without linking it to the stated tissue response.
required_elements: Present supplied receptor location or selectivity information.
Connect receptor blocking to the supplied tissue response.

all_of: Relevant anatomical-site mentions are available.
A tissue or response mention is available.
Verified information supplies the receptor and causal relationships expressed.
required_information: Verified information about receptor location or selectivity, receptor blocking, and the resulting tissue response. Entity mentions alone do not supply these relations.

skills.name: Linking mechanism to patient-facing effects
skills.action: Link a preceding treatment action or mechanism to patient-facing effects, phrasing the effects directly for the reader when appropriate.

all_of: A treatment action or mechanism and a patient-facing effect are available.

preserve: The link between the preceding mechanism and its stated effects.
The distinction between easier passage of water and symptom relief.
The target’s direct address to the reader.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning an effect without linking it to the preceding action or mechanism.
Adding an effect or a causal relationship not supported by supplied information.
required_elements: State the supplied action or mechanism.
Link it to a supplied patient-facing effect.

all_of: A treatment response or mechanism is available.
A patient-facing effect or symptom-relief mention is available.
Verified information links the response to the stated effect.
required_information: Verified information linking the stated treatment response or mechanism to the particular patient-facing effect.

skills.name: Qualified use with condition and symptom examples
skills.action: State a treatment use with its supplied population and condition qualifications, and introduce available symptom examples as examples of that use.

all_of: A product and a treatment-use statement are available.

preserve: The adult-men qualification and the association between the urinary symptoms and benign prostate enlargement as stated in the target.
The “such as” framing for symptom examples.
Any supplied qualifications on examples, including the frequency detail “even at night.”

not_an_attempt: Naming a condition or symptom without stating its relationship to the treatment use.
Listing symptoms without presenting them as examples of the stated use when that example relationship is supplied.
required_elements: State the supplied treatment use.
Retain any supplied population or condition qualifications.
When symptom examples are given, frame them as examples and retain their supplied qualifications.

all_of: A product mention is available.
A condition or symptom mention is available.
Verified information supplies the product's treatment indication and the relevant population qualification.
For symptom examples, verified information identifies the examples as symptoms within that indication.
required_information: Verified information identifying the product's treatment indication, the relationship between that indication and the named condition or symptoms, and any population restriction. If symptom examples are included, their relationship to the indication must also be verified.

skills.name: Product identity followed by substance composition
skills.action: Introduce a named product as a medicine, then identify its active substance; describe materials making up that substance when the source supplies them.

all_of: A product and its medicine/treatment identity are available.
The source states a relationship between the product and an active substance.
exclude_if: The source does not relate the product to an active substance.
Materials are presented as constituents without a source-stated relationship to the active substance.

preserve: Keep the product distinct from its active substance and from materials said to make up that substance.
Keep the source's ingredient wording and any qualifications; do not imply that a list is exhaustive unless the source does.

not_an_attempt: Listing a product and substance without relating them.
Listing materials without presenting them as constituents of the active substance.
required_elements: Identify the product as a medicine or treatment.
State the source-supplied product–active-substance relationship.
When constituents are described, relate them to the active substance.

all_of: A product mention and a medicine/treatment mention are available.
The source explicitly relates the product to an active substance.
If constituents are named, the source explicitly relates them to that active substance.
exclude_if: The source does not establish the product–active-substance relationship.
Constituents are presented without a source-supported relationship to the active substance.
required_information: Verified product–active-substance relationship; verified constituent relationship for each listed constituent.

skills.name: Qualified causal chain with consequences and examples
skills.action: Explain a source-stated risk or consequence in sequence, linking an initial condition to a bodily change and, when supplied, to further consequences or illustrative effects.

all_of: The source supplies an initial condition and at least one related change or consequence.
The source states the links used in the explanation.
exclude_if: Only related conditions, anatomy, or symptoms are mentioned without source-stated links.
The proposed wording would make a possible consequence certain or present examples as exhaustive when the source does not.

preserve: The sequence from excess phosphorus to calcium deposition and then to stated consequences.
The target's distinct qualifications “can” and “may.”
The illustrative status of the listed effects, rather than treating them as exhaustive.

not_an_attempt: Listing conditions, bodily changes, or symptoms without expressing their source-stated relationships.
Adding causal links or effects not supplied by the source.
required_elements: State the source-supplied initial condition.
Link it to at least one source-supplied change or consequence.
Retain qualifications such as “can” or “may” when present.

all_of: A source-supplied initial condition and at least one consequence or effect are available.
The source explicitly supplies the causal or consequential links used in the explanation.
Any possibility or uncertainty qualification is available in the source.
exclude_if: The source provides only co-occurring condition, anatomy, test or symptom mentions without the relevant links.
The source does not establish the effects presented as examples.
required_information: Verified disease explanation establishing each causal or consequential link; verified clinical effects and their relationship to the stated condition.

skills.name: Accessible mechanism followed by its stated outcome
skills.action: Explain a medicine's action in accessible terms by stating what it acts on and where, then connecting that action to a downstream change or outcome when the source supplies the link. A parenthetical anatomical clarification and direct reader address may be used when appropriate.

all_of: A product or treatment action is relevant to the supplied content.
The source states the action and any location or downstream relationship expressed.
exclude_if: The source provides only co-occurring substances, body sites, or measurements without stating the action or the relationships to be expressed.

preserve: The target's binding action and stated digestive location.
The sequence from binding to reduced absorption and then lower phosphorus levels.
The parenthetical naming the stomach and intestines and the direct address in “your digestive tract” and “your blood,” without making either a fixed requirement.
The target's degree of certainty.

not_an_attempt: Listing a substance, body site, and outcome without connecting them.
Inferring a mechanism or outcome from entity co-occurrence.
Stating a guaranteed outcome where the source describes a qualified mechanism or reduction.
required_elements: State the source-supplied action and its target.
State the location when supplied and relevant.
Connect the action to a downstream change or outcome when that relationship is supplied.

all_of: A product and mechanism-related substance or process are available.
The source explicitly supplies the product's mechanism and location.
The source explicitly links the mechanism to an absorption change and the stated level outcome.
exclude_if: The source provides only co-occurring substances, anatomical sites or test mentions without a stated mechanism and outcome relationships.
required_information: Verified mechanism of action, including the relevant location and binding/process relationship; verified link from that mechanism to absorption change and clinical or measured outcome.

skills.name: Closing population statement
skills.action: When a population statement is available, close with a concise statement naming the population for whom the product is used.

all_of: A population statement is included in the description.

preserve: Keep the target's non-exclusive wording: use in adults does not by itself mean adult-only use.
Do not infer a population or eligibility claim from product identity or other mentions.

not_an_attempt: Inferring a population from unrelated details.
Changing a statement of use in a population into an exclusive restriction.
required_elements: State the supplied population and its relationship to product use.
Place the concise statement at the close when following the observed pattern.

all_of: A product and an explicitly supplied population-eligibility statement are available.
exclude_if: The source lacks an explicit population statement or does not establish its relationship to the product.
required_information: Verified information specifying the population for whom the product is used.
Any qualification on that population that the source explicitly states.

skills.name: Product identity with category and substance
skills.action: Introduce a named product by stating its supplied medicine category or purpose and explicitly identifying its active substance.

all_of: A product is being introduced.
The source supplies a category or purpose for the product and identifies its active substance.
exclude_if: The source only lists a product, category-like phrase, and substance without supplying their relationships.

preserve: The supplied category or purpose.
The explicit relationship between the product and its active substance.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product without stating its category or purpose and active substance.
Mentioning a category or substance without relating it to the product.
required_elements: Name the product.
State its supplied category or purpose and identify its active substance in relation to it.

all_of: A product is identified and supplied information explicitly states both its medicine category or purpose and its active substance.
exclude_if: The source supplies names or category-like phrases but does not state their relationships to the product.
required_information: Verified identification of the product's active substance and the product's medicine category or purpose.

skills.name: Use and eligibility in a single description
skills.action: Describe a supplied intended use together with relevant population and eligibility conditions, expressing thresholds, alternatives, and accompanying requirements in patient-facing prose.

all_of: The source supplies an intended use and relevant population or eligibility conditions.
exclude_if: Conditions or numbers are merely listed without supplied relationships to the intended use or eligibility.

preserve: The target's distinction between intended use and diet and exercise used in addition to it.
The adult population qualification, threshold values and units, alternatives, and accompanying health-problem requirement when supplied.
The logical structure of the eligibility criteria.

not_an_attempt: Listing conditions or numbers without relating them to use or eligibility.
Changing whether stated criteria are alternatives or cumulative requirements.
required_elements: State the supplied intended use.
Relate the supplied population and eligibility conditions to that use.
Retain the source's logical relationships among thresholds and conditions.

all_of: The source explicitly supplies an intended use, the population and eligibility logic, and whether other measures are used alongside the medicine.
exclude_if: Numbers or conditions are mentioned without explicit eligibility relationships, or other measures are mentioned without an explicit relationship to the medicine's use.
required_information: Verified therapeutic indication; population restrictions; the meaning, units, and logical relationships of any thresholds; any required health-condition criteria; and whether diet, exercise, or other measures accompany the medicine.

skills.name: Brief gloss of a technical measure
skills.action: Briefly gloss a technical measure by naming it and explaining its supplied meaning or the relationship between the quantities it uses.

all_of: A technical measure is used and the source supplies a definition suitable for a concise explanation.
exclude_if: The source only mentions the measure and related quantities without supplying their definitional relationship.

preserve: The supplied meaning of the measure.
The relationship between weight and height expressed in the target.
Concise, patient-facing wording.

not_an_attempt: Only expanding an abbreviation without explaining the measure.
Listing quantities without stating their supplied relationship.
required_elements: Name the measure.
Give its supplied definition or explanation in concise, accessible wording.

all_of: A technical measure is used and a definition relating it to its components is supplied.
exclude_if: The source merely mentions a measure or related quantities without providing their definitional relationship.
required_information: A verified, patient-suitable definition of the technical measure and the relationships among its components.

skills.name: Conditional continuation rule with qualification
skills.action: State a supplied conditional continuation rule using its response threshold, time period, and regimen details; include any supplied clinician-consultation advice before continuation.

all_of: The source supplies a condition governing whether use should continue.
exclude_if: Numbers or treatment mentions occur without an explicit continuation relationship.

preserve: The conditional rather than unconditional form.
The source's response measure, threshold, period, dose, and units.
Any supplied advice to consult a clinician before continuing.

not_an_attempt: Turning a conditional rule into an unconditional instruction.
Inferring threshold, timing, or regimen relationships from isolated numbers.
required_elements: Express continuation as conditional on the supplied criterion.
Retain the response measure, threshold, period, and regimen details that the source provides.

all_of: The source provides an explicit response-based condition for continuation, the associated period and regimen details, and any clinician-consultation qualification to be stated.
exclude_if: Numbers or treatment mentions occur without explicit relationships specifying the response criterion, time period, and regimen.
required_information: Verified continuation criterion and response measure; threshold and units; period; regimen and dose details; and whether clinician consultation is specified before continuing.

skills.name: Accessible, patient-directed effect description
skills.action: Describe a product-linked effect in accessible language, connect it to the relevant body site, and address the patient or caregiver directly when appropriate.

all_of: A product-linked effect and a relevant body site are available.

preserve: The stated effect, body site, and relationship between them.
The limitation to the child’s remaining tract.
The scope of the claim; do not extend it beyond the supplied wording.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a body site without describing an effect there.
Stating a treatment purpose without describing the effect.
Describing an effect without connecting it to the relevant site when that relationship is supplied.
required_elements: Describe the effect and its relevant body site in accessible language.
Use direct patient- or caregiver-facing wording when appropriate to the supplied context.

all_of: A product or treatment and an effect are mentioned.
A body site relevant to the effect is mentioned.
The source explicitly links the product or treatment to the effect at that site.
exclude_if: The source does not supply the product-or-treatment-to-effect relationship.
required_information: Verified effect attributable to the product or treatment.
Verified relationship between the effect and the named body site, including any stated limitation such as remaining tissue.

skills.name: Condition explanation followed by a qualified cause
skills.action: When an explanation and a qualified cause are available, explain the named condition through its supplied defining or functional features, then state the cause in a following sentence using the supplied qualification.

all_of: A named condition and information explaining it are supplied.

preserve: The distinction between the condition’s explanation and its cause.
The qualifier “often” or any other source-supplied qualification.
The specific causal and definitional relationships only when supplied by the source.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition and body part without explaining the condition.
Presenting a supplied cause as certain or exclusive when the source qualifies it.
Adding a cause or qualification not supplied by the source.
required_elements: Explain the named condition using supplied information.
When a cause and its qualification are supplied, state them in a following sentence after the explanation.

all_of: A named condition and information explaining it are supplied.
The source gives a cause and explicitly qualifies how commonly it causes the condition.
exclude_if: The source does not explicitly link the cause to the condition.
The source does not supply the qualification on the cause.
required_information: Verified explanation of the named condition and its relationship to any stated functional difficulty.
Verified causal relationship and its stated frequency or qualification.

skills.name: Accessible mechanism comparison
skills.action: Explain a medicine's action by comparing it with a named natural substance and stating the resulting effect in accessible terms.

all_of: A medicine and a relevant comparison substance are available in the source.

preserve: Preserve the target's similarity wording rather than implying the medicine and natural substance are identical.
Preserve the stated vessel effect and its scope.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning the comparison substance without relating it to the medicine's action.
Stating an effect without making the comparison to the named substance.
required_elements: Relate the medicine's action to the named substance using the relationship supplied by the source.
State the resulting effect in accessible terms.

all_of: A product mention and a candidate comparison-substance mention are available.
exclude_if: No verified mechanism connects the product's action to the comparison substance and stated effect.
required_information: A verified mechanism specifying the comparison to the named substance and the resulting effect.

skills.name: Purpose stated with eligibility qualifications
skills.action: State a treatment's purpose and condition, retaining the population, duration, and other eligibility qualifications that the source supplies.

all_of: A product and a treatment purpose are available in the source.

preserve: Preserve stated duration and population qualifications.
Preserve the insufficient-control condition and named medicine classes when supplied.
Do not add qualifications not supplied by the source.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product and condition without stating the treatment purpose.
required_elements: State the supplied treatment purpose and condition.
Retain any population, duration, or other eligibility qualifications included in the statement.

all_of: A product mention and a condition mention are available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify the indication and each qualification included in the sentence.
required_information: A verified product indication, treatment duration if stated, eligible population, and any treatment-history or named-medicine conditions being expressed.

skills.name: Conditional standalone-use alternative
skills.action: Present a source-supported option to use a product on its own as a separate statement, retaining the condition attached to that option.

all_of: A product and an option concerning its use on its own are available in the source.

preserve: Preserve possibility rather than certainty, as in can be used.
Preserve the source's condition and what it refers to.

not_an_attempt: Saying the product can be used on its own while omitting a condition that the source attaches to that option.
required_elements: State the source-supported possibility of use on its own.
Retain the condition attached to that possibility, if one is supplied.

all_of: A product mention and a mention of the other medicine or medicines are available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify standalone use and the condition for that use.
required_information: A verified statement that the product may be used on its own and the precise eligibility or treatment-combination condition for that option.

skills.name: Progression from disease explanation to medicine effects
skills.action: Arrange connected explanatory content as a progression from disease-related changes and their consequences, through symptoms when available, to the medicine's stated actions and effects when available.

all_of: The source supplies connected explanatory content about a condition and relevant consequences or effects.

preserve: Preserve the target's sequence from vessel narrowing and increased heart workload to possible symptoms, then to medicine action and effects.
Preserve qualifications such as may cause; do not strengthen uncertain claims.

not_an_attempt: Merely listing condition, symptom, anatomy, or medicine mentions without organizing supplied explanatory content into a progression.
required_elements: Order the supplied disease-related explanation and consequences before the medicine action and effects when both are included.
Use symptom information in the progression when it is available.
Retain the relationships and qualifications expressed by the source.

all_of: A condition, relevant body-site or symptom mentions, and a product mention are available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify the disease-process links, product mechanism, and claimed effects used in the progression.
required_information: Verified relationships connecting the disease process to its consequences and symptoms, and connecting the product's mechanism to the effects being stated.

skills.name: Purpose-led uses with population qualifications
skills.action: Present multiple uses as separate purpose-led clauses, retaining distinctions between their purposes and placing any supplied population or condition qualifications with the relevant use.

all_of: More than one relevant use is available to present.
exclude_if: The uses or their purposes cannot be stated without inferring unsupported clinical relationships.

preserve: Keep each purpose linked to its relevant use.
Preserve the distinction between prevention and reduction when those purposes are supplied.
Do not generalize or omit supplied qualifications.

not_an_attempt: Listing multiple conditions without stating their respective purposes.
Collapsing distinct supplied purposes into an unspecified general benefit.
required_elements: Present the supplied uses in separate purpose-led clauses.
Preserve distinctions among the stated purposes.
Include qualifications alongside the relevant use when supplied.

all_of: At least one condition or problem mention is available.
Verified therapeutic-use information explicitly supplies each purpose and its relation to the condition.
Verified population information supplies any stated eligibility restriction.
exclude_if: The indication, purpose, or population restriction would have to be inferred from mentions alone.
required_information: Verified indication for each use, including whether it is prevention or reduction.
Verified population eligibility and the use to which each restriction applies.
Verified clinical effect or purpose expressed by each use.

skills.name: Causal explanation followed by condition naming
skills.action: Explain a supplied causal or disease process with its stated qualifications, then identify the condition it explains; give an abbreviation after the name when one is supplied.

all_of: A causal or disease-process explanation and a condition it explains are relevant.
exclude_if: The causal relation or the identification of the condition is not supplied or verified.

preserve: Preserve the target’s qualified wording, including “can.”
Keep the explanation before the condition naming.
Do not assert a stronger causal relationship than the supplied information supports.

not_an_attempt: Listing a cause, process, and condition name without explaining their supplied relationship.
Giving an abbreviation without identifying the condition by its full name.
required_elements: State the supplied causal or disease-process relationship with its qualifications.
Identify the condition that the explanation describes.
Give the supplied abbreviation after the condition name, if one is available.

all_of: A cause or process mention and a condition-name mention are available.
Verified information explicitly links the cause to the described process and identifies the resulting condition.
A verified abbreviation is available if the sentence is to include one.
exclude_if: The causal relation, resulting condition, or any included abbreviation is not supplied and verified.
required_information: Verified causal or disease-explanation sequence, including the direction and qualification of the stated effects.
Verified identification of the condition explained by that sequence.
Verified full-name-to-abbreviation relationship if an abbreviation is used.

skills.name: Product name followed by common name
skills.action: Introduce the medicine by its product name, then identify its common name in a following sentence.

all_of: A product name and another name for the same medicine are available.
exclude_if: The source does not establish that the second name is a common name for that medicine.

preserve: Keep the names linked to the same medicine and retain the common-name relationship.
Preserve the product-name-then-common-name sequence.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning the product and another name without linking the second name to the same medicine.
Giving only the product name.
required_elements: State the product name as the medicine's name.
Identify the linked second name as its common name.

all_of: A product-name mention is available.
A generic-name mention is available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify that the second name refers to the same medicine.
required_information: Verified identification of the product and its common or generic name as names for the same medicine.

skills.name: Class introduction linked to broad purpose
skills.action: Introduce a medicine class by saying the medicine belongs to it, and state a broad treatment purpose for that class when available.

all_of: A medicine and a relevant class are available.

preserve: Keep the medicine-to-class relationship distinct from the class-to-purpose relationship.
Do not infer either relationship from co-occurring entity mentions.

not_an_attempt: Listing a class and a condition without connecting the medicine to the class or the class to a treatment purpose.
Stating a treatment purpose without introducing the medicine's class.
required_elements: State that the medicine belongs to the named class.
When a class treatment purpose is included, connect the class to that purpose.

all_of: A product-name mention is available.
A medicine-class mention is available.
A condition mention is available.
exclude_if: The source does not verify both the product's class membership and the class's treatment purpose.
required_information: Verified relationship between the product and the named medicine class.
Verified treatment-purpose relationship between that class and the condition or condition category.

skills.name: Qualified, specific treatment purpose
skills.action: State a specific treatment use and retain any supplied progression and prior-treatment qualifications.

all_of: A medicine and a treatment indication are available.

preserve: Preserve the distinction between the indication and its progression or prior-treatment qualifications.
Do not turn the qualified indication into an unqualified use, or infer the relations from entity co-occurrence.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a condition and prior treatment without stating the medicine's use for that condition.
Stating an indication while omitting a progression or prior-treatment qualification that the source supplies.
required_elements: State the medicine's use for the specified condition.
Retain any progression and prior-treatment qualifications included in the source.

all_of: A product-name mention is available.
A condition mention is available.
A prior-treatment mention is available when the indication is qualified by prior treatment.
exclude_if: The source does not verify that the product treats the condition.
The source does not verify any stated progression or prior-treatment qualification.
required_information: Verified indication for the product.

exclude_if: The meaning of a number or the population eligibility is not supplied by the source.

Do not extend eligibility beyond the source's stated population.

not_an_attempt: Inferring an age threshold from a number alone.
Dropping or broadening a population qualification stated by the source.
required_elements: State the population qualification supplied for the use.
Retain the distinct restrictions actually stated, such as a minimum age and a separate adolescent qualification, when present.

all_of: A stated use and a population restriction are available.

exclude_if: Population eligibility or the meaning of a number is not explicitly supplied.
required_information: Verified population eligibility linked to the medicine’s use.
The exact age threshold, age unit, and any additional population qualification, such as growth status.

skills.name: Introduce the product and explain delivery
skills.action: Introduce a named product with its supplied form and explain in patient-accessible language how the supplied substance is delivered.

all_of: A product, form, substance, and delivery description are available.
exclude_if: The information does not establish the relationship between the product, form, substance, and delivery pathway.

preserve: Do not infer product formulation, substance membership, or delivery mechanism from co-occurring entities alone.

not_an_attempt: Naming a product, form, and substance without explaining their relationship or delivery.
Describing delivery without identifying the product or substance when those are available.
required_elements: Identify the product and its supplied form.
Explain the substance's supplied delivery pathway in accessible language.

all_of: A product and a dosage form are mentioned.
A substance and a delivery pathway are mentioned.
Verified information explicitly links the product, form, substance, and delivery pathway.
required_information: Verified information that the named product has the stated dosage form and contains or releases the stated substance.
Verified information describing the substance's delivery pathway.

skills.name: Move from patient-facing description to a technical label

all_of: A patient-facing description and a technical condition term are available.
exclude_if: The supplied information does not establish how the description relates to the condition term.

preserve: Keep association, causation, and possibility language at the degree of certainty supplied.
Do not infer a diagnosis, symptom relationship, or abbreviation definition from co-occurring mentions.

not_an_attempt: Listing symptoms without connecting the description to a condition term.
Giving a condition term without a preceding patient-facing description when one is available.
Expanding or using an abbreviation whose meaning is not supplied.
required_elements: Present a patient-facing description before the technical condition term.
Use an abbreviation only when its relationship to the condition term is supplied.

all_of: At least one patient-facing symptom or problem description and a technical condition term are available.
Verified information links the description to the condition.
If an abbreviation is used, its expansion is supplied.
required_information: Verified explanation of how the described symptoms or problems relate to the named condition.
A supplied definition for the technical term and, if used, its abbreviation.

skills.name: Connect purpose to qualified eligibility
skills.action: Introduce an intended use and present applicable population or eligibility conditions as a coordinated list.

all_of: Intended-use information and at least one population or eligibility condition are available.
exclude_if: The supplied information does not establish that the listed conditions define intended use or how multiple conditions combine.

preserve: Retain supplied population restrictions and logical relationships among conditions.
Do not infer age limits, eligibility, or treatment purpose from entity co-occurrence alone.

not_an_attempt: Listing patient attributes as eligibility requirements based only on entity co-occurrence.
Presenting conditional eligibility as universal use.
Imposing a fixed number of eligibility items or requiring a separate treatment-purpose sentence when none is supplied.
required_elements: Frame the information as an intended use.
Present supplied eligibility conditions as a coordinated list when multiple conditions are available.

all_of: A product, condition or problem, and intended population are mentioned.
Verified information supplies the product's treatment purpose.
Verified information supplies each eligibility requirement and how the requirements combine.
required_information: Verified therapeutic indication linking the product to the condition or problem.
Verified intended population and eligibility criteria, including any age limit, procedure history, or concomitant therapy requirement.
Verified logical relationship among eligibility criteria, including whether all are required.

skills.name: Qualify expectations and conditional follow-up
skills.action: Qualify when an effect may be noticed and, when supplied, state a conditional follow-up tied to an interval and the appropriate next step.

all_of: Information about an expected effect or response and its timing is available.
exclude_if: The source does not supply a conditional follow-up or next step when the action would state one.

preserve: Retain the target's qualified timing and conditional wording.

Do not infer timing, effects, or treatment recommendations from entity mentions alone.

not_an_attempt: Turning variable or qualified timing into a guarantee.
Giving an unconditional discontinuation instruction when the source makes the follow-up conditional or attributes it to a clinician.
Inventing a response threshold, interval, or next step.
required_elements: Retain supplied qualification about when an effect may be noticed.

required_information: Verified information about the expected effect and any uncertainty in its timing.

source_quotes: the enos ( or nos3 ) human gene , locus 7q35 - 36 , encodes for a protein of 1203 amino acids ; in addition , several polymorphisms have been reported , of which 3 ( -786 t > c , enos 4a / b , and 894 g > t ) are the most studied and are associated with different diseases , including cancer ( 8) .

although the biological impact of the vntr 4a / b polymorphism is unclear , it has been suggested that this polymorphism would regulate the expression of enos by the formation of small rnas ( sirrnas ) .
endothelial cells containing five copies present higher quantities of sirrna and lower levels of mrna of enos , when compared with cells that contain four copies ( 8 , 14 ) .
the enos 4a / b polymorphism has been associated with different pathologies ( 6 , 7 , 19 , 20 ) , including cancer ( 11 , 21 ) .

no metabolism has been proposed to act as a pleiotropic regulator that is involved in carcinogenesis ; the high concentrations of no and its metabolites contribute as promoters of gene transcription and protein activation that join specific dna sequences , producing dna breakage and promoting tumor angiogenesis and metastasis ( 7 ) .
no promotes cancer progression by activating several oncogenic signaling pathways , such as extracellular signal - regulated kinases and phosphoinositide 3-kinases .

the enos 4a / b polymorphism could most likely be related to breast carcinogenesis due to the overproduction of enos and no levels and , consequently , the overproduction of ros , which could lead to genetic instability , tumor progression , and metastasis by triggering an oncogene pathway that , in turn , activates glycolysis metabolism ( 34 , 35 ) .

source_quotes: the amplification of the enos 4a / b polymorphism of intron 4 was performed by pcr using the following primers : 5'-agg ccc tat ggt agt gcc ttt-3 ' and 5'-tct ctt agt gct gtg gtc ac-3 ' ( 24 ) .

the pcr reactions were performed in a total volume of 15 l , which contained 0.2 mm dntps ( invitrogen , carlsbad , ca usa ) , 5 pm of primers , 2.0 mm mgcl2 , 2.5 u taq polymerase ( invitrogen ) , and 50 ng of genomic dna .
the pcr conditions were 95 ( 4 min ) , followed by 35 cycles of 94 ( 1 min ) , 57 ( 1 min ) , and 72 ( 1.5 min ) , and then a final extension at 72 ( 7 min ) .
using this procedure , we obtained fragments of 393 and 420 base pairs ( bp ) .
for the allelic discrimination of the enos 4a / b polymorphism , the amplified products were separated on 6% polyacrylamide gels ( 29:1 ) , followed by silver staining ( 25 ) .
we determined that the 393-bp fragment represented a polymorphic genotype ( a / a , 4 repeats ) .
two fragments at 393- and 420-bp indicated a heterozygous genotype ( a / b ) , and one fragment at 420-bp represented the wild - type genotype ( b / b ; 5 repeats ) ( fig .
hardy - weinberg equilibrium was tested by a chi - square goodness - of - fit test to compare the observed genotype frequencies with the expected frequencies among control subjects .
the odds ratio ( or ) and 95% confidence intervals ( 95% ci ) were also calculated .
all statistical analyses were performed using the pasw statistic base 18 software , 2009 ( chicago , il , usa ) .
this study was approved by the institutional review board of cibo , imss ( # 1305 ) .
summary_quotes:
the endothelial nitric oxide synthase ( enos ) gene plays an important role in several biological functions . 
 polymorphisms of the enos gene have been associated with cancer . 
 it has been suggested that the vntr 4 a / b polymorphism may affect the expression of enos and contributes to tumor promotion in the mammary gland . 
 we examined the role of the enos4 a / b polymorphism by comparing the genotypes of 281 healthy mexican women with the genotypes of 429 mexican women with breast cancer ( bc ) . 
 the observed genotype frequencies for control and bc patients were 0.6% and 0.7% for a / a ( polymorphic ) ; 87% and 77% for a / a ( wild type ) ; and 12% and 22% for a / b respectively . 
 we found that the odds ratio ( or ) was 1.9 , with a 95% confidence interval ( 95%ci ) of 1.29 - 2.95 , p = 0.001 for genotypes a / a - a / b , b / c . 
 the association was also evident when comparing the distribution of the a / a - a / b genotypes in patients with high levels of glutamate - oxaloacetate transaminase ( sgot ) ( or , 1.93 ; 95% ci , 1.14 - 3.28 ; p = 0.015 ) ; undergoing menopause with high levels of sgot ( or , 2.0 ; 95% ci , 1.1 - 3.84 ) ; and with high levels of glutamic - pyruvic transaminase ( sgpt ) ( or , 3.5 ; 95% ci , 1.56 - 8.22 ) . 
 the genotypes a / a - a / b are associated with bc susceptibility in the analyzed samples from the mexican population .

source_quotes: for the asd group , however , the contrast between the positive effect of support on spatial source and the absence of its effect on temporal source are consistent with the idea that individuals with asd have specific difficulties in time processing .

an alternative explanation of the current findings hinges on the intrinsically ephemeral nature of temporal phenomena and the consequent difficulty in operationalising an adequate representation of different time periods to use as support at test .

whereas the position of stimuli presented at the top , middle or bottom of a screen can easily be represented at test by markers in those positions , stimuli presented in the 1st , 2nd or 3rd block of trials can only be labelled using the words block 1 etc .

source_quotes: transposable elements ( tes ) are dna sequences that are capable of autonomous replication and insertion at new locations in a genome ( kidwell and lisch 2001 ) .

the remarkable evolutionary success of tes is attributed to their ability to become overrepresented among an organism 's offspring through proliferation within the genome , even though they impose fitness costs ( doolittle and sapienza 1980 ; orgel and crick 1980 ; hickey 1982 ) .
consequently , organisms have developed a variety of genome defenses that restrict the activity of tes , such as dna methylation ( miura et al .
2008 ) , and repeat - induced point mutation ( rip ; selker 1990 ; selker 2002 ) .

source_quotes: presbycusis , or age - related hearing impairment , is the most prevalent sensory disorder in aging people.1,2 presbycusis is defined as the progressive decline of hearing ability during aging and causes symmetrical , bilateral , high - frequency sensorineural hearing impairment.3 as a multifactorial disorder , presbycusis is associated with a combination of environmental factors , medical history , and nuclear and mitochondrial genome variation.46 presbycusis has a great impact on the quality of life of patients as it impairs communication skills and independent daily activity and , therefore , gradually diminishes psychosocial functioning.7 patients with the disorder frequency experience decreased self - esteem and increased dependency , isolation , and frustration .

a study by lin et al8 using the definition of the world health organization and information from the national health and nutritional examination survey demonstrated that 63.1% of the population more than 70 years old suffer from a hearing impairment of 25 db .
currently , socioeconomic development and health care improvement have led to increased longevity .
in contrast , while the elderly population exhibits exponential growth , fertility has reduced .

due to the growing elderly population , the prevalence of age - related disorders , such as presbycusis , is also increasing.9 mitochondria are considered one of the main factors in the progression of presbycusis;4 these organelles are responsible for vital cellular functions , including energy production , apoptosis , cell signaling , and calcium storage .

variants in the mtdna control region are associated with different disorders , including cancer , huntington disease , and -thalassemia.1012 the control region is composed of three hypervariable regions ( hvr ) , hvr - i at 16,02416,383 , hvr - ii at 57372 , and hvr - iii at 438574 ( numbering according to ncbi accession no nc_0122920.1).13 a strong relationship between mtdna coding region variation and presbycusis has also been reported in the literature;1416 however , little is known about the relationship between variation in the mtdna control region and the progression of presbycusis .

advances in the understanding of the intracellular mechanisms underlying presbycusis could lead to the development of diagnostic markers and therapies to slow or reverse the adverse changes in the auditory system characteristic of this disorder .

in the present study , to determine the role of mtdna in the intracellular mechanism underling the development of presbycusis , we compared the frequency of variants in the mtdna control region sequences of presbycusis patients with those of control subjects .
summary_quotes: backgroundthe prominent role of mitochondria in the generation of reactive oxygen species , cell death , and energy production contributes to the importance of this organelle in the intracellular mechanism underlying the progression of the common sensory disorder of the elderly , presbycusis .
reduced mitochondrial dna ( mtdna ) gene expression and coding region variation have frequently been reported as being associated with the development of presbycusis .
the mtdna control region regulates gene expression and replication of the genome of this organelle .

to comprehensively understand of the role of mitochondria in the progression of presbycusis , we compared variations in the mtdna control region between subjects with presbycusis and controls.methodsa total of 58 presbycusis patients and 220 control subjects were enrolled in the study after examination by the otolaryngologist and audiology tests .

source_quotes: presbycusis and control subjects were enrolled in this study by ear - nose - and - throat ( ent ) specialists at the ent and head & neck research center of iran university of medical sciences .

for all participants , ent examination , conventional pure - tone audiometry , tympanometry , speech discrimination scores , and speech reception thresholds were carried out , as described previously.17 briefly , an amplaid 319 audiometer ( amplaid inc .
, calibration was performed according to the american national standards institute .

a multifrequency admittance meter ( amplaid 728 ) patients with symmetric , bilateral , sensorineural hearing impairment with pure - tone average ( pta ) frequencies of 30 db hl at 1 , 2 , 4 , and 8 khz were defined as having presbycusis and were included in the study .
control subjects had normal ear examinations and pta frequencies of < 25 db hl .

exclusion criteria were history of early sensorineural hearing impairment , any ear disease or otological surgery , conductive hearing impairment , exposure to noise or ototoxic drugs , and a medical history that could have affected hearing sensitivity , such as brain tumor , kidney or liver failure , cardiovascular disease , or stroke.18 finally , 58 presbycusis and 220 control subjects were enrolled in this study .
peripheral blood samples ( 5 ml ) were collected from all participants in edta collection tubes .
total dna samples were extracted from peripheral blood using a qiaamp dna mini kit ( qiagen , hilden , germany ) according to the manufacturer s instructions .
the quality and purity of extracted dna were measured using a nanodrop 2000c spectrophotometer ( thermo fisher scientific , waltham , ma , usa ) .

the mtdna control region was amplified using a set of specific primers with sequences as follows ( numbering according to ncbi accession no nc_0122920.1 ) : pf , 5-atcattggacaagtagcatc-3 ( 15,79115,810 bp ) and pr , 5-gagctgcattgctgcgtgct-3 ( 780761 bp ) ( figure 1).12 polymerase chain reaction ( pcr ) amplification was carried out using tempase hot start 2x master mix a blue ( ampliqon , odense , denmark ) in a final reaction volume of 50 l , containing 100 ng of dna , 0.32 l of each primer ( 10 pmol ) , 25 l of tempase 2x master mix , and 23.2 l rnase - free water .

pcr amplification was performed with the following program : pre - pcr incubation at 95c for 15 min , 35 cycles of 95c for 20 s , annealing at 60c for 45 s , and extension at 72c for 30 s , with a final extension at 72c for 5 min .
the specific amplification of a 1,550 bp fragment was confirmed by 1.5% agarose gel electrophoresis ( figure 2 ) .
next , pcr products were sequenced by direct dna sequencing ( bioneer , south korea ) .

due to a cytosine nucleotide repeat in the target region , to obtain good quality sequence two further primers were used in addition to those used for pcr amplification , with sequences as follows : pf2 , 5-gat cac agg tct atc acc ct-3 ( 120 bp ) and pr2 , 5-tag taa gta tgt tcg cct gt-3 ( 200181 bp ) ( figure 1 ) .
sequencing results were analyzed using codon code aligner 6.0.2 software ( codon code , centerville , ma , usa ) .
sequences were compared to the revised cambridge reference sequence ( rcrs ) ( accession no nc_012920.1 ) using the blast sequence analysis tool ( ncbi , bethesda , md , usa ) .
the mitomap ( http://www.mitomap.org ) and mtdb ( http://www.mtdb.igp.uu.se/ ) databases were also checked for mitochondrial genome sequence variants .
and fisher s exact tests were used to determine the significance of differences in mtdna variant frequencies between presbycusis patient and control subjects .
statistical analyses were performed using spss 22 for windows ( ibm , armonk , ny , usa ) .

exclusion criteria were history of early sensorineural hearing impairment , any ear disease or otological surgery , conductive hearing impairment , exposure to noise or ototoxic drugs , and a medical history that could have affected hearing sensitivity , such as brain tumor , kidney or liver failure , cardiovascular disease , or stroke.18 finally , 58 presbycusis and 220 control subjects were enrolled in this study .
a 1,550 bp fragment of the mtdna control region was amplified by pcr from all presbycusis and control subjects ( figure 2 ) .

four variants ( 16,223 c > t , 16,311 t > c , 16,249 t > c , and 15,954 a > c ) were present at statistically significant different frequencies in presbycusis patients and healthy subjects , all of which were more frequent in presbycusis subjects ( table 1 ) .

in conclusion , the statistically significant differences in the frequencies of variants in the mitochondrial control region sequence between presbycusis patients and controls at four positions provide new evidence and contribute to the construction of a comprehensive picture of the role of the mitochondria in the progression of presbycusis .

the results of this study , together with those of previous reports , demonstrate the pressing need for further functional investigation of the mitochondrial genome to identify novel therapies for prevention , delay , or treatment of this common impairment .
our data also demonstrate that mitochondrial research could enable development of biomarkers to assist in identification of individual at high risk of developing presbycusis .
summary_quotes:
backgroundthe prominent role of mitochondria in the generation of reactive oxygen species , cell death , and energy production contributes to the importance of this organelle in the intracellular mechanism underlying the progression of the common sensory disorder of the elderly , presbycusis . 
 reduced mitochondrial dna ( mtdna ) gene expression and coding region variation have frequently been reported as being associated with the development of presbycusis . 
 the mtdna control region regulates gene expression and replication of the genome of this organelle . 
 to comprehensively understand of the role of mitochondria in the progression of presbycusis , we compared variations in the mtdna control region between subjects with presbycusis and controls.methodsa total of 58 presbycusis patients and 220 control subjects were enrolled in the study after examination by the otolaryngologist and audiology tests . 
 variations in the mtdna control region were investigated by polymerase chain reaction and sanger sequencing.resultsa total of 113 sequence variants were observed in mtdna , and variants were detected in 100% of patients , with 84% located in hypervariable regions . 
 the frequencies of the variants , 16,223 c > t , 16,311 t > c , 16,249 t > c , and 15,954 a > c , were significantly different between presbycusis and control subjects.conclusionthe statistically significant difference in the frequencies of four nucleotide variants in the mtdna control region of presbycusis patients and controls is in agreement with previous experimental evidence and supports the role of mitochondria in the intracellular mechanism underlying presbycusis development . 
 moreover , these variants have potential as diagnostic markers for individuals at a high risk of developing presbycusis . 
 the data also suggest the possible presence of changes in the mtdna control region in presbycusis , which could alter regulatory factor binding sites and influence mtdna gene expression and copy number .

source_quotes: several studies have been conducted underscoring the important role of dietary habits in influencing the risk of developing mets , the majority of which , however , have focused on single nutrients or food items [ 5 , 6 ] .
this conventional approach has several limitations mainly the interaction between nutrients , confounding by foods / nutrients not eaten and the problem of collinearity .

although few studies have investigated the association of dietary patterns with mets in various populations , there is still no consensus as to which dietary patterns would confer the lowest risk of mets [ 912 ] .
in the east mediterranean region , studies evaluating this association are scarce .
findings from the study could inform prevention strategies as well as prognosis among subjects with high risk of mets .
summary_quotes:
purposethe main objective of this study was to evaluate the association between dietary patterns and the metabolic syndrome ( mets ) and its metabolic abnormalities among lebanese adults , using data from a national nutrition survey.methodsa cross - sectional analysis involving adults aged 18  years ( n  =  323 ) with no prior history of chronic diseases was conducted . 
 participants completed a brief sociodemographic and 61-item food frequency questionnaire . 
 anthropometric measurements and fasting blood samples were also obtained . 
 the international diabetes federation criteria were used to classify study participants with the metabolic syndrome . 
 dietary patterns were identified by factor analysis . 
 multivariate logistic regression analysis was used to evaluate the associations of extracted patterns with mets and its metabolic abnormalities.resultsout of 323 participants , 112 ( 34.6% ) were classified as having mets . 
 three dietary patterns were identified :  fast food / dessert ,   traditional lebanese ,  and  high protein .  compared with participants in the lowest quintile of the fast food / dessert pattern , those in the highest quintile had significantly higher odds for mets ( or , 3.13 ; 95% ci : 1.367.22 ) and hyperglycemia ( or , 3.81 ; 95% ci : 1599.14 ) . 
 subjects with the highest intake of the high protein pattern had an increased risk for hypertension ( or , 2.98 ; 95% ci : 1.267.02 ) . 
 the traditional lebanese pattern showed no association with mets or its components.conclusionsthe findings of this study demonstrate a positive association of the fast food / dessert pattern with mets and hyperglycemia among lebanese adults . 
 these results may guide the development of improved preventive nutrition interventions in this adult population .

source_quotes: the  rubber hand illusion  ( rhi ) is an experimental paradigm that can manipulate body ownership via congruent touching on the rubber hand and the subject 's real hand .
psychologically disrupting the sense of body ownership decreased the awareness of physical self and the physiological regulation of self .
generally , the change in body representation induced by the rhi is considered a temporary phenomenon rather than convincing recalibration of one 's bodily representation .

given that models of bodily self - perception are explained by basic spatiotemporal principles of multisensory integration as the key mechanism underlying self - attribution of the body , we propose two plausible reinstantiation methods from the disowned bodily states : one involves novel tactile information from the real hand and the other involves novel visual information about the artificial hand .
a stimulating acupuncture needle on the body is known to produce unique sensations and common activation in the sensorimotor cortical network in the brain .
furthermore , visual manipulation in the acupuncture stimulation was an important factor for autonomic responses , even without somatosensory tactile stimulation .
when needle rotations are provided to the real hand as tactile stimuli , the subject could recover from the disowned bodily state with direct tactile information from his / her own body .
thus , it is assumed that the brain networks in the disowned bodily states induced by the rhi could recover in different ways based on two different external information sources .
summary_quotes:
we used functional magnetic resonance imaging to investigate how causal influences between brain regions during the rubber hand illusion ( rhi ) are modulated by tactile and visual stimuli . 
 we applied needle rotations during the rhi in two different ways : one was with the real hand ( reinstantiation by tactile stimuli , r - ts ) and the other was with the rubber hand ( reinstantiation by visual stimuli , r - vs ) . 
 we used dynamic causal modeling to investigate interactions among four relevant brain regions : the ventral premotor cortex ( pmv ) , the intraparietal sulcus ( ips ) , the secondary somatosensory cortex ( sii ) , and the lateral occipitotemporal cortex ( loc ) . 
 the tactile aspects of needle rotations changed the effective connectivity by directly influencing activity in the sii , whereas visual aspects of needle rotation changed the effective connectivity by influencing both the sii and the loc . 
 the endogenous connectivity parameters between the ips and the pmv were reduced significantly in the r - ts condition . 
 the modulatory parameters between the ips and the pmv were enhanced significantly in the r - ts condition .

source_quotes: during the last years , endodontics has been searching for new instruments , instrumentation techniques , irrigants and drugs to achieve the best cleaning and disinfection of root canals12 .

within this context philippas16 mentioned that physiological or pathological continuous and progressive dentin formation in the pulp chamber floor created interferences that reduced the root canal diameter , especially at the cervical third , and thus it should be removed during endodontic treatment .

estrela , et al.5 mentioned the main advantages of cervical flaring in endodontics : reducing pressure during irrigation due to the possibility of overflow ; deeper penetration of irrigant ; effective removal of cervical contamination ; reduced possibility of ledges , apical deviation or instrument fracture ; better control of the active tip of the instrument , thus overcoming the influence from apical curvature by a straighter access ; and an improvement of the obturation steps , especially lateral condensation .

these constrictions should be removed by accomplishment of cervical preparation , thus allowing more accurate working length determination and more precise establishment of the initial apical instrument diameter ( iai ) .

these authors concluded that the removal of cervical dentin projections improved the insertion of larger files to the working length , thus providing criteria that should allow the achievement of a adequate biomechanical preparation .

therefore , the objective of this study was to investigate the influence of three different rotary systems for cervical flaring on establishment of the rwl , testing the hypothesis that there is no difference between the systems studied .

source_quotes: idiopathic hypoparathyroidism is an endocrine disorder characterized by hypocalcemia and hyperphosphatemia due to impaired secretion of parathyroid hormone ( pth ) .
it may occur as part of a polyglandular autoimmune disorder or as a complex congenital defect , such as in digeorge 's syndrome .
in addition , it may occur as a solitary endocrinopathy which is called isolated hypoparathyroidism .
isolated hypoparathyroidism may be caused by a mutation in the pth gene , glial cells missing ( gcm)2 gene or calcium - sensing receptor ( casr ) gene ( 1 , 2 ) .
gain - of - function mutations in the casr gene cause familial hypocalcemia ( 3 ) .

theoretically , hypocalcemic disorders can be caused by deficiency of pth , by a defect in the pth / pthrp receptor , or by insensitivity to pth caused by defects downstream of the pth / pthrp receptor .
the mutations in several genes such as casr ( 4 ) , pth ( 5 ) , gcm2 and gata3 ( 6 ) have been shown to cause hypoparathyroidism .

subsequently , it was learned that a loss - of - function mutation causes hypercalcemia and gain - of - function mutation causes hypocalcemia ( 4 ) , which is called autosomal dominant hypocalcemia ( adh ) .
gain - of - function mutations in the casr gene are associated with a familial hypocalcemia ( 3 ) .
summary_quotes: hypoparathyroidism is an abnormality of calcium metabolism characterized by low serum levels of parathyroid hormone in spite of hypocalcemia .
the causes of hypoparathyroidism are numerous .
activating mutations in the calcium - sensing receptor ( casr ) gene are well - known causes of familial isolated hypoparathyroidism , also known as autosomal dominant hypocalcemia ( adh ) .
we describe members of a korean family with a heterozygous pro221leu mutation causing adh .

summary_quotes:
the 2008 who classification of tumors of haematopoietic and lymphoid tissues has introduced two new categories of high - grade b - cell lymphomas : entities in which features of diffuse large b - cell lymphoma ( dlbcl ) overlap with burkitt lymphoma ( dlbcl / bl ) or classical hodgkin lymphoma ( dlbcl / hl ) . 
 the dlbcl / bl category encompasses cases that resemble burkitt lymphoma morphologically , but have one or more immunophenotypic or molecular genetic deviations that would exclude it from the bl category ; conversely , some cases have immunophenotypic and/or genetic features of bl , but display cytologic variability unacceptable for bl . 
 many of the cases in the dlbcl / bl category contain a translocation of myc as well as either bcl2 or bcl6 ( so - called double - hit lymphomas ) and have a very aggressive clinical behavior . 
 the dlbcl / hl category encompasses lymphomas that exhibit the morphology of classical hodgkin lymphoma but the immunophenotype of dlbcl , or vice versa . 
 most dlbcl / hl cases described present as mediastinal masses , but this category is not limited to mediastinal lymphomas . 
 these new categories acknowledge the increasing recognition of cases that display mixed features of two well - established diseases . 
 whether the existence of such cases reflects shortcomings of our current diagnostic armamentarium or a true disease continuum in which such hybrid or intermediate neoplasms actually exist remains to be determined .

the characteristic immunophenotype of bl is that of strong cd10 expression , expression of bcl6 , negativity for bcl2 , and a ki67 proliferation index ( pi ) of near 100% ( at least 90% of tumor cells ) .
immunohistochemistry for myc protein is non - specific and is not useful for diagnostic purposes .
the myc rearrangement in bl usually occurs in a background of a relatively simple karyotype and should lack concomitant rearrangements of bcl2 or bcl6 [ 2 , 4 ] .

distinctive morphological features of pmbl include fine compartmentalizing sclerosis , the presence of cells with abundant clear cytoplasm and/or multilobated nuclei , and the presence of large reed  sternberg - like cells .
the neoplastic b - cells express b - cell antigens , but often lack surface immunoglobulin ( ig ) , despite expression of the ig - associated transcription factors bob1 , oct2 , and pu1 .
the majority of tumors express cd30 , usually heterogeneously and with weak to moderate intensity .

the diagnosis of nshl requires a nodular growth pattern , broad bands of fibrosis , and lacunar variants of reed  sternberg cells that have a characteristic immunophenotype ( cd45 , cd30 + , cd15+/ ) .
cd30 expression , when present , is typically weaker compared to the uniformly strong cd30 expression in chl .
conversely , expression of b - cell associated antigens is strong and uniform in pmbl , and is usually weaker and more heterogeneous in the neoplastic cells of chl .
while ig is not typically expressed in the neoplastic cells of either entity , ig transcription factors such as oct2 and bob1 are maintained in pmbl , and may be absent in chl .

source_quotes: in case of simultaneous pyoderma gangrenosum and ulcerative colitis , treatments are delivered directly targeting the skin lesions as well as systemic agents to control ulcerative colitis .
topical therapeutics include highly potent steroids , calcineurin inhibitors ( tacrolimus , pimecrolimus ) , human platelet releasing growth factor , and intralesional injection of cyclosporine .
systemic treatment for pyoderma gangrenosum involves cyclosporine ( 3 - 5 mg / kg / day ) which is effective for extensive pyoderma gangrenosum and is usually administered with steroids .
in most cases , cyclosporine could be applied instead of steroids .
dapsone ( maximum dose of 200 mg / day ) is effective in mild cases .

summary_quotes:
the subject of this paper is to analyze the impact of radiotherapy and anthracyclines on the cardiovascular system , based on a survey of contemporary literature . 
 currently , high efficiency of anticancer therapies has increased the rate of survival in patients treated for cancer . 
 it should be emphasized , however , that these treatments damage not only the affected but also the healthy tissue . 
 consequently , with the increase of survival rate in these patients , the number of patients with complaints regarding numerous organs and systems also increases as a result of earlier treatment . 
 thus , during the first decade of the 21st century , a number of concerns about the relationship between cancer treatment and dysfunction of the cardiovascular system were resolved . 
 anthracyclines , as well as radiotherapy , are capable of damaging the cardiovascular system , both at the central level , by the deterioration of cardiac function , and at peripheral levels , by increasing the hemodynamic and thrombotic changes .

source_quotes: in order to make progress in this area , the aim of this study was to describe hcas perspectives on detecting mental health problems and promoting mental health among community - dwelling seniors with multimorbidity in order to meet this study s aim , we chose a descriptive and qualitative design in which focus group interviews were used in the process of data collection.48 qualitative research is designed to describe , interpret , and understand human experience and to describe the meaning that this experience has for the participant.49 a focus group interview gives the researcher an opportunity to understand several informants differing points of view.50 the data from the focus group interviews were analyzed using a content analysis technique inspired by graneheim and lundman.51 the study examined the municipal home help services in one urban district in sweden .
the codes were compared based on differences and similarities and organized into three categories , each with two subcategories which constituted the manifest content .

analysis of the data revealed an overarching theme that described how mental health problems may be detected and how to improve mental health : continuity provided by an accessible and competent team may increase social and physical activity .

we suggest multidisciplinary and interprofessional approaches as means of facilitating the early detection of mental health problems and of increasing hcas competence in mental health promotion among their clients .
summary_quotes: mental health promotion by hcas needs to be studied further because they may be among the first to observe changes in clients mental health status.aimto describe hcas perspectives on detecting mental health problems and promoting mental health among homebound seniors with multimorbidity.methodswe applied a descriptive qualitative study design using semi - structured interviews .

content analyses were performed on five focus group interviews conducted in 2014 with 26 hcas.resultsmost hcas stated that they were experienced in caring for clients with mental health problems such as anxiety , depression , sleep problems , and high alcohol consumption .

observation , collaboration , and social support emerged as important means of detecting mental health problems and promoting mental health.conclusionthe hcas had knowledge of risk factors , but they seemed insecure about which health professionals had the primary responsibility for mental health .

the results indicate that the hcas seemed dependent on supervision by district nurses and on care managers decisions to support the needed care , to schedule assignments related to the detection of mental health problems , and to promote mental health .
